Investigation results:

Should do a light sanity check on whether staffApiDataGateway and usersApiDataGateway are using the endpoints that actually exist. Also verify that EmployeesPage is using the API. 2. Currency:
- settings-currencies-api.gateway.ts is correctly calling /api/v1/currencies.
- However, `supabase.from('currency')` / `from('cur_price')` is being called directly in the finance services/components: financialEntryService.ts, EntryForm.tsx, CompoundEntryForm, GeneralEntryForm, VoucherEntryForm — these are the "currency/exchange rate calls in every interface of the system" that the user is asking to be migrated. Note: since supabase access was removed (REVOKE) by migration 0018, these direct `.from('cur_price')` calls may now fail or be blocked. These are also part of the Finance scope.

- useExchangeRates.ts and useAccountBalances — check how they're fetching rates.

Read the key files: currencyService.ts, SettingsContext.tsx, settings.routes.ts (permission for GET settings), useExchangeRates.ts.

43	let _state: ExchangeRatesState = {

51	  updatedAt: 0,

54	const _subscribers = new Set<() => void>();
55	let _initialized = false;
56	let _pollTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

59	  _subscribers.forEach(cb => cb());
60	}

62	async function _refresh() {
63	  const result = await runQuery<ExchangeRatesData>(
64	    async () => {
65	      const [rates, currencies] = await Promise.all([
66	        currencyService.getLatestExchangeRates(),
67	        currencyService.getAllCurrencies(false),
68	      ]);
69	      return {
70	        rates,
71	        currencies,
72	        activeCurrencies: currencies.filter(c => c.isActive || c.is_active),
73	      };
74	    },
75	    (queryState) => {
76	      if (queryState.status === 'loading') _state = { ..._state, loading: true, queryState };
77	    },
78	    (data) => Object.keys(data.rates).length === 0 && data.currencies.length === 0
79	  );
80	
81	  if (result.status === 'success') {
82	    _state = { ...result.data, loading: false, queryState: result, updatedAt: Date.now() };
83	  } else if (result.status === 'empty') {
84	    _state = { rates: {}, currencies: [], activeCurrencies: [], loading: false, queryState: result, updatedAt: Date.now() };
85	  } else if (result.status === 'error') {
86	    _state = { ..._state, loading: false, queryState: result, updatedAt: Date.now() };
87	  }
88	  _notify();
89	}

91	/**

93	 * Initialize singleton: initial load + polling instead of Supabase realtime
94	 */
95	function _initSingleton() {
96	  if (_initialized) return;
97	  _initialized = true;
98	
99	  // التحميل الأولي / Initial load
100	  void _refresh();
101	
102	  // إعداد polling دوري / Setup periodic polling
103	  if (_pollTimer) clearInterval(_pollTimer);
104	  _pollTimer = setInterval(() => void _refresh(), POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
105	}

109	export function useExchangeRates() {
110	  const [, forceUpdate] = useState(0);
111	
112	  useEffect(() => {
113	    _initSingleton();
114	
115	    const cb = () => forceUpdate(n => n + 1);
116	    _subscribers.add(cb);
117	    return () => {
118	      _subscribers.delete(cb);
119	    };
120	  }, []);
121	
122	  return _state;
123	}

27	      const body = updateSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
28	      const actor = principal(response);
29	      if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات الإعدادات غير صالحة.', requestId(response));

37	    try { const record = await repository.getUser(actor.userId); return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'USER_SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'إعدادات المستخدم غير موجودة.', requestId(response)); }
38	    catch (error) { return next(error); }

The SettingsContext is now using only the API. Remaining causes of the 403 "لا تملك الصلاحية المطلوبة" (You do not have the required permission) in the currency-related UI:

1. GET /api/v1/settings/general requires `view_general_settings` (admin only). SettingsContext is called on every page load for every user → console warnings fire repeatedly, but it degrades gracefully (doesn't show the message to the user). The user is reporting that this error message is "displayed" when they call currencies — maybe the API client is surfacing errors as toasts? Check ApiClient's error handling — it might be showing alerts on 403. Let me grep the client.

2. GET /api/v1/settings/user requires view_interface_settings — but shouldn't every authenticated user be able to read their own UI settings? This is also a cause of 403 for non-admins, and theme/language won't be persisted.

3. FinanceEntriesPage is calling `/api/v1/settings/currencies` — an invalid route (does it match /api/v1/settings/:category? No — "currencies" isn't in the general/logistics/whatsapp category list, and the GET route is /api/v1/settings/{general,logistics,whatsapp}, so /api/v1/settings/currencies → 404). Silently caught → empty currencies.

Approach to fixing permissions (preserve security; don't weaken writes):
- Currencies reads: already auth-only locally (staged) ✓.
- Settings general reads: used in SettingsContext on every page for every user (systemName, currency, defaults used in order forms). These are shared reference data. Options: make GET /api/v1/settings/:category auth-only (reads) while keeping PATCH permission-gated. This reflects the decision on currencies, and if the app calls these reads globally, it resolves the "لا تملك الصلاحية المطلوبة" 403 everywhere. For GET on user settings: should be auth-only (a user's own settings). PATCH on user settings: auth-only (the user themselves) — currently userEdit requires edit_interface_settings, which non-admins don't have → theme save returns 403. The user's own UI settings should be writable by the user themselves. Make reads for /settings/user auth-only.

- Also, grant the view-series permissions to other roles? Simpler and safer: settings reads are shared configuration needed for UI rendering, so auth-only. The repository just returns a jsonb settings blob. But caution: settings contain security-ish flags (protectSensitiveOrderDelete), but those aren't secrets. Acceptable.

However, the migration has already granted view_general_settings only to admin. Changing routes to auth-only is a code decision consistent with the earlier currency comments (there's precedent).

#### Thinking

The test "requires the settings read permission" expects 403 with no permission — change this to: reading settings requires only authentication (200 for any authenticated user), unauthenticated → 401. Also, GET for user settings should be auth-only.

Design decision (documented similarly to currencies): shared settings is reference data used by all UIs → reads are auth-only. Writes to general settings are gated by edit_general_settings. User settings: read/write is auth-only (scoped to actor.userId).

import type { Pool } from 'pg';
import type {
  CurrenciesRepository,
  CurrencyCreateInput,
  CurrencyRateRecord,
  CurrencyRecord,
  CurrencyUpdateInput,
} from './currencies.contracts';

const currencyColumns = `
  c.cur_id AS "currencyId", c.code, c.main_name_ar AS "mainNameAr",
  c.sub_name_ar AS "subNameAr", c.main_name_en AS "mainNameEn", c.sub_name_en AS "subNameEn",
  c.symbol, c.flag, c.is_default AS "isDefault", c.is_active AS "isActive", c.created_at AS "createdAt",
  CASE WHEN c.is_default THEN 1 ELSE latest.price END AS "currentPrice",
  latest.seq AS "lastSeq", latest.updated_by AS "lastUpdateBy", latest.day_date AS "lastUpdateDate"
`;

function mapRate(row: Record<string, unknown>): CurrencyRateRecord {
  return {
    rateId: Number(row.rateId),
    currencyId: Number(row.currencyId),
    price: Number(row.price),
    dayDate: String(row.dayDate),
    sequence: Number(row.sequence),
    updatedBy: row.updatedBy === null ? null : String(row.updatedBy),
    createdAt: row.createdAt === null ? null : String(row.createdAt),
  };
}

export function createCurrenciesRepository(pool: Pool): CurrenciesRepository {
  const findQuery = `SELECT ${currencyColumns}
    FROM public.currency c
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT cp.price, cp.seq, cp.updated_by, cp.day_date
      FROM public.cur_price cp WHERE cp.cur_no = c.cur_id
      ORDER BY cp.seq DESC, cp.cur_price_id DESC LIMIT 1
    ) latest ON true`;
  return {
    async list(activeOnly: boolean): Promise<readonly CurrencyRecord[]> {
      const result = await pool.query<CurrencyRecord>(`${findQuery} ${activeOnly ? 'WHERE c.is_active IS TRUE' : ''} ORDER BY c.cur_id ASC`);
      return result.rows.map((row) => ({ ...row, currentPrice: row.currentPrice === null ? null : Number(row.currentPrice) }));
    },
    async findById(currencyId: number): Promise<CurrencyRecord | null> {
      const result = await pool.query<CurrencyRecord>(`${findQuery} WHERE c.cur_id = $1 LIMIT 1`, [currencyId]);
      const row = result.rows[0];
      return row ? { ...row, currentPrice: row.currentPrice === null ? null : Number(row.currentPrice) } : null;
    },
    async create(input: CurrencyCreateInput, actorId: string): Promise<CurrencyRecord> {
      const client = await pool.connect();
      try {
        await client.query('BEGIN');
        if (input.isDefault) await client.query('UPDATE public.currency SET is_default = FALSE, updated_by = $1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE is_default IS TRUE', [actorId]);
        const inserted = await client.query<{ currencyId: number }>(
          `INSERT INTO public.currency
             (code, main_name_ar, sub_name_ar, main_name_en, sub_name_en, symbol, flag, is_default, is_active, created_at, created_by, updated_by)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, NOW(), $10, $10) RETURNING cur_id AS "currencyId"`,
          [input.code, input.mainNameAr, input.subNameAr ?? '', input.mainNameEn ?? '', input.subNameEn ?? '', input.symbol, input.flag ?? '', input.isDefault, input.isActive, actorId],
        );
        const insertedRow = inserted.rows[0];
        if (!insertedRow) throw new Error('CURRENCY_CREATE_FAILED');
        await client.query('COMMIT');
        const row = await this.findById(insertedRow.currencyId);
        if (!row) throw new Error('CURRENCY_CREATE_READBACK_FAILED');
        return row;
      } catch (error) {
        await client.query('ROLLBACK');
        throw error;
      } finally { client.release(); }
    },
    async update(currencyId: number, input: CurrencyUpdateInput, actorId: string): Promise<CurrencyRecord | null> {
      const client = await pool.connect();
      try {
        await client.query('BEGIN');
        if (input.isDefault) await client.query('UPDATE public.currency SET is_default = FALSE, updated_by = $1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE is_default IS TRUE AND cur_id <> $2', [actorId, currencyId]);
        const result = await client.query(
          `UPDATE public.currency SET
            code = COALESCE($1, code), main_name_ar = COALESCE($2, main_name_ar), sub_name_ar = COALESCE($3, sub_name_ar),
            main_name_en = COALESCE($4, main_name_en), sub_name_en = COALESCE($5, sub_name_en), symbol = COALESCE($6, symbol),
            flag = COALESCE($7, flag), is_default = COALESCE($8, is_default), is_active = COALESCE($9, is_active),
            updated_by = $10, updated_at = NOW()
           WHERE cur_id = $11 RETURNING cur_id`,
          [input.code ?? null, input.mainNameAr ?? null, input.subNameAr ?? null, input.mainNameEn ?? null, input.subNameEn ?? null, input.symbol ?? null, input.flag ?? null, input.isDefault ?? null, input.isActive ?? null, actorId, currencyId],
        );
        if ((result.rowCount ?? 0) === 0) { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); return null; }
        await client.query('COMMIT');
        return this.findById(currencyId);
      } catch (error) {
        await client.query('ROLLBACK');
        throw error;
      } finally { client.release(); }
    },
    async delete(currencyId: number, actorId: string): Promise<boolean> {
      const result = await pool.query('UPDATE public.currency SET is_active = FALSE, updated_by = $2, updated_at = NOW() WHERE cur_id = $1 AND is_default IS FALSE', [currencyId, actorId]);
      return (result.rowCount ?? 0) > 0;
    },
    async listRates(currencyId: number): Promise<readonly CurrencyRateRecord[]> {
      const result = await pool.query(
        `SELECT cur_price_id AS "rateId", cur_no AS "currencyId", price, day_date AS "dayDate", seq AS sequence,
                updated_by AS "updatedBy", created_at AS "createdAt"
         FROM public.cur_price WHERE cur_no = $1 ORDER BY seq DESC, cur_price_id DESC LIMIT 500`,
        [currencyId],
      );
      return result.rows.map(mapRate);
    },
    async addRate(currencyId: number, price: number, dayDate: string | undefined, actorId: string): Promise<CurrencyRateRecord> {
      const result = await pool.query(
        `INSERT INTO public.cur_price (cur_no, price, day_date, seq, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, created_by)
         SELECT $1, $2, COALESCE($3::timestamptz, NOW()), COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) + 1, $4, NOW(), NOW(), $4
         FROM public.cur_price WHERE cur_no = $1
         RETURNING cur_price_id AS "rateId", cur_no AS "currencyId", price, day_date AS "dayDate", seq AS sequence,
                   updated_by AS "updatedBy", created_at AS "createdAt"`,
        [currencyId, price, dayDate ?? null, actorId],
      );
      if (!result.rows[0]) throw new Error('CURRENCY_RATE_CREATE_FAILED');
      return mapRate(result.rows[0]);
    },
  };
}

I'll add a helper to currencyService:

```ts
export interface PriceReference { price: number; reference: { id: number; seq: number }; }
async getLatestPriceReference(curNo: number): Promise<PriceReference | null> {
  const rates = await settingsCurrenciesApiGateway.getCurrencyRates(curNo);
  const latest = rates.find(r => Number(r.price) > 0); // in seq DESC order
  return latest ? { price: latest.price, reference: { id: latest.rateId, seq: latest.sequence } } : null;
}
async getLatestRateEntry(curNo): returns the full rate (dayDate) or null.
```

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.financial_entry_permission_for_payload(p_entry jsonb, p_action text)
RETURNS text
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY INVOKER
SET search_path = public, auth
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_type_code text;
  v_category text := COALESCE(p_entry->>'entryCategory', 'General');
BEGIN
  SELECT code INTO v_type_code FROM public.entry_type WHERE id = NULLIF(btrim(p_entry->>'entryTypeId'), '');
  IF p_action = 'create' THEN
    IF v_type_code IN ('RECEIPT_VOUCHER', 'ORDER_PAYMENT') THEN RETURN 'create_receipt_vouchers'; END IF;
    IF v_type_code IN ('PAYMENT_VOUCHER', 'OPERATING_EXPENSE', 'SALARY_PAYMENT') THEN RETURN 'create_payment_vouchers'; END IF;
    IF v_category = 'Compound' THEN RETURN 'create_compound_entries'; END IF;
    IF v_category = 'Temp' THEN RETURN 'create_temporary_entries'; END IF;
    RETURN 'create_general_entries';
  END IF;
  IF v_type_code IN ('RECEIPT_VOUCHER', 'ORDER_PAYMENT') THEN RETURN 'edit_receipt_vouchers'; END IF;
  IF v_type_code IN ('PAYMENT_VOUCHER', 'OPERATING_EXPENSE', 'SALARY_PAYMENT') THEN RETURN 'edit_payment_vouchers'; END IF;
  IF v_category = 'Compound' THEN RETURN 'edit_compound_entries'; END IF;
  IF v_category = 'Temp' THEN RETURN 'edit_temporary_entries'; END IF;
  RETURN 'edit_general_entries';
END;
$$;

app.patch('/api/v1/finance/entries/:id', authenticate, async (request, response, next) => {
  const id = idParam(...); if (!id) return;
  const actorId = principalId(response); if (!actorId) 401...
  const body = createEntrySchema.safeParse(request.body);
  if (!body.success) 400 INVALID_FINANCIAL_ENTRY
  try {
    const context = await repository.getEntryPermissionContext(id);
    if (!context) return 404 ENTITY_NOT_FOUND
    const required = editPermissionFor(context.typeCode, body.data.entryCategory);
    const permissions = auth ? await auth.listPermissions({ userId: actorId }) : [];
    if (!permissions.includes(required)) return sendFailure(403, 'AUTH_FORBIDDEN', 'لا تملك الصلاحية المطلوبة.', ...);
    return sendSuccess(response, await repository.replaceDraft(id, { ...body.data, createdByUid: actorId }), ...);
  } catch (e) { return writeError(e, response, next); }
});

#### Thinking

alx_api is at the project root. Alright. Next, design the rewrite of financeAccountingMainEntryActions.ts.

Key questions:
1. Edit journal: Legacy would modify legs (account_trans by ref_number or name) and update main_entry. With the API, is the correct route financialEntryService.replaceDraft / replacePosted(entryId, FinancialEntryInput)? The edit modal's data is limited (amount, currency, notes, createdAt, debitAccountId, creditAccountId). Constructing a complete FinancialEntryInput requires entry lines. selectedEditEntry has allLegs with accountId, plus debit/credit.

Let me check how selectedEditEntry is constructed (FinanceAccounting.tsx / data gateway) to understand which fields are available (entryTypeId/typeCode? entryNumber?). Also, read the shape of FinancialEntryInput inside financialEntryService.

2. Deletion: entryToDelete.mainEntryId → financialEntryService.deleteDraft or deletePosted. Which one? Legacy deletes the legs + main_entry document, which is a hard delete of draft or posted. The API's delete_financial_entry_draft handles this atomically. There's also DELETE /:id routed by category/type. deleteDraft and deletePosted exist — the gateway's deleteEntry maps to the DELETE route either way; the service picks the route? Line 548 deletePosted and line 519 deleteDraft. Both probably call gateway.deleteEntry, and maybe posted goes through unpost? Actually, according to the summary: deletePosted→gateway.deleteEntry. So both hit DELETE /api/v1/finance/entries/:id. No problem — in the actions, use the service's delete method with mainEntryId and let the API/RPC do the cleanup; then the frontend recalculation is unnecessary (DB is atomic) — though it might be harmless to leave recalculation in? Legacy's recalculateAndSyncBalance is based on financialAccountService — check whether that still exists / supports API. The RPC handles balances atomically. But to preserve behavior safely, calling recalculate is fine as long as it works API-based. Keep it simple: leave it? financialAccountService.recalculateAndSyncBalance probably still works (reads account_trans via API). I'd like to remove the client-side recalculation since the RPC atomically maintains balances, but as a safety measure leave it. Let me check whether recalculateAndSyncBalance is already API-based.

3. handleAddAdjustment: already uses financialAccountService.recordSalaryPayment / recordDoubleEntryTransaction. Need to verify these are now API-based (according to the summary, "handleAddAdjustment: already delegates to financialAccountService.recordSalaryPayment/recordDoubleEntryTransaction (now API-backed)"). So no changes needed there — but the dependencies include legacy db handles; we can drop them from the interface.

4. handleCustomerFIFOPayment: need to update orders. Is there an orders API? Check src/services order update paths — the app has an orders module; FinanceAccounting's orders state probably comes from the API data gateway or the legacy. FIFO loops batch.update against the orders document. API option: financeApiWriteGateway.recordOrderPayment(orderId, paymentAmount, entryPayload) calls record_order_payment_v2 — this atomically updates the order's paid/remaining/status AND posts the payment voucher! That's exactly the right primitive. So FIFO becomes: for each order, call financialEntryService.recordOrderPayment(orderId, allocAmount, entry) with a built entry payload (debit cash, credit customer). Per-order Voucher: the API creates its own entry. Legacy created a single voucher for the total; record_order_payment_v2 creates per-order entries — acceptable, and actually more accurate (matches the 'ORDER_PAYMENT' type code in the receipts permission mapping).

Need the shape of FinancialEntryInput for recordOrderPayment's entry: probably minimum lines with accounts? Let me read financialEntryService's relevant parts (FinancialEntryInput type, buildFinancialEntryPayload) and how recordOrderPayment is used elsewhere in the UI (maybe the Orders page already uses this path).

Let me search for other usages of recordOrderPayment in the frontend.

alx_api is at the repo root. Let me examine the entry payload shapes and existing usages before rewriting.

#### Thinking

With this, I've grasped the shape of the ledger rows: `selectedEditEntry` (LedgerEntry) has mainEntryId, refNumber, debitAccountId/creditAccountId, amountOriginal, currencyOriginal, module, allLegs, createdByUid, notes.

The edit modal lets the user change the amount, original currency, notes, createdAt, and the debit/credit accounts. Legacy was editing the legs in place.

API approach for `handleEditJournalSubmit`: build a new `FinancialEntryInput` and call `financialEntryService.replacePosted(mainEntryId, entry)` (PATCH /finance/entries/:id → replace_financial_entry_draft RPC — does the RPC itself do the leg/balance handling? replace_financial_entry_draft($1,$2::jsonb) probably swaps the legs and re-syncs balances atomically). Lines: need debit and credit lines with accountId, accountCurNo, transType, amount, amountOriginal, currencyOriginalNo. Can use the debit/credit of postingFinancialAccounts (they have currency code, entityType, entityId), similar to how collectOrderPaymentHandler computes `amount` via convertToTargetCurrency.

But the line payload also requires moduleId/entryTypeId. From entryToDelete/selectedEditEntry we have `module` (e.g., 'adjustment', 'payment'...). The legacyModuleRoute mapping in financialEntryService handles module→{moduleId, entryTypeId}. But legacyModuleRoute isn't exported… it's a local const. Can use `createFromLegacyVoucher` for creation. But for replacement, we need `replacePosted(entryId, FinancialEntryInput)`. Could export legacyModuleRoute or build a similar mapping in the action file. Better: add a service helper `replaceFromLegacyVoucher(voucher, debitAccount, creditAccount)` that mirrors createFromLegacyVoucher and calls replaceDraft? Hmm — but caution: replace_financial_entry_draft — from the name, draft-only; the API PATCH route maps to replaceDraft, but it works against atomic RPCs. Does the RPC handle posted entries? The name says draft, but in an earlier design (per summary) PATCH /:id uses the edit permission mapping (like edit_receipt_vouchers) against posted entries in the ledger — i.e., it's the generic "replace the entry" operation. I'll trust this.

Also, need currency code → curNo: line requires accountCurNo: number and currencyOriginalNo: number. resolveCurrency is a private service method that takes a currency code string. buildLegacyVoucherLine is also private. Cleanest way: add a public service method `replaceFromLegacyVoucher(voucher: LegacyVoucherInput, debitAccount: LegacyVoucherAccountTarget, creditAccount: LegacyVoucherAccountTarget)` to FinancialEntryService. It builds lines exactly like createFromLegacyVoucher and then calls this.replace(voucher.entryNumber…)? Wait, replacePosted requires entryId = main_entry's id. selectedEditEntry.mainEntryId exists.

Hmm, but the edit modal allows swapping accounts and changing amount/date — the payload is built from editJournalData: amountOriginal, currencyOriginal (code), notes, createdAt, debitAccountId/creditAccountId (financial account IDs within postingFinancialAccounts). If debitAccountId is empty, fall back to the selectedEditEntry.debitAccountId leg.

Design: within the actions file:
```ts
const debitTarget = postingFinancialAccounts.find(a => a.id === (editJournalData.debitAccountId || selectedEditEntry.debitAccountId));
const creditTarget = ...
await financialEntryService.replaceFromLegacyVoucher({
  entryNumber: selectedEditEntry.refNumber,
  createdAt: parsedCreatedAt,
  description: editJournalData.notes || selectedEditEntry.title,
  amount: rawAmt, currency: editJournalData.currencyOriginal, module: selectedEditEntry.module, createdByUid: currentUser?.id,
  postingStatus: 'posted',
}, debitAcc, creditAcc);
```
LegacyVoucherInput requires entryNumber, amount, currency, module, refNumber?; refNumber is on LegacyVoucherInput (required). OK.

But if debit/credit target isn't found in postingFinancialAccounts (e.g., the account isn't loaded), should the fallback account object be built from the legs of selectedEditEntry (accountId, currency)? Legacy was handling missing target by keeping the tx's account. Simpler: throw notification error if accounts missing. Legacy behavior: if newDebitAcc not provided, kept original account, only amount/description changed. To preserve that: if account not found, build LegacyVoucherAccountTarget from original legs (id=debitLeg.accountId, currency=leg.currency). selectedEditEntry has debitLeg/creditLeg (FinanceTransactionRow with accountId, currency…). But the FinanceEntryRecord interface in actions is generic; the row has debitLeg/creditLeg fields via index signature. Can type them.

Note: replace via buildFinancialEntryPayload requires moduleId/entryTypeId from legacyModuleRoute(module). The module string from ledger is like 'payment', 'adjustment', 'order' — matches the legacyModuleRoute keys. Good.

Also, balance recalculation: the legacy code was manually running recalculateAndSyncBalance per affected account; the atomic RPC handles this server-side. Remove client recalc.

Delete: `handleDeleteJournalSubmit` — keep PIN check UX (existing in-memory check), then call financialEntryService.deleteDraft(mainEntryId)? The API DELETE route checks category/type-based permission via getEntryPermissionContext — single endpoint; the service's deleteDraft/deletePosted both hit gateway.deleteEntry. Use entryToDelete.mainEntryId; if missing → error notification (legacy handled EXP-UNLINKED etc. — if no mainEntryId, show error 'لا يمكن حذف القيد عبر API'). Note: delete_financial_entry_draft RPC deletes legs + head and re-syncs. But wait — legacy list rows come from account_trans legs; mainEntryId = tx.entryId (normalized from API's account-movements), so it exists for API-sourced data. Good. Remove client-side batch delete and recalc.

Adjustment: already API-compliant via financialAccountService.recordSalaryPayment/recordDoubleEntryTransaction. Need to check whether these methods of financialAccountService use API now (not legacy). Check financialAccountService for legacy-compat imports.

FIFO payment: replace batch order updates + recordTransaction with a loop calling financialEntryService.recordOrderPayment per order. Each order needs: debit cash account (from ensureSystemAccounts('YER') → sys_cash_account, with curNo), credit party account (linkedAccountId). Lines need accountCurNo — postingFinancialAccounts entries have `currency` code; accountCurNo requires numeric curNo. financialAccountService.financial accounts probably have curNo. Check PostingAccount interface — currently only id, accountCode, currency, entityType, entityId, entityName. System accounts via ensureSystemAccounts return ID. Hmm, recordOrderPayment entry needs lines with accountCurNo numbers.

resolveCurrency in service maps code→curId. buildLegacyVoucherLine takes LegacyVoucherAccountTarget {id, curNo?, currency, entityType?, entityId?} and resolves. But recordOrderPayment takes raw FinancialEntryInput; needs explicit lines with accountCurNo. Alternative: use buildFromLegacy helper to build lines? buildLegacyVoucherLine is private (not exported? it's a class method `this.buildLegacyVoucherLine` — private or public?). Defined around line ~290; probably public on the class but service is exported as instance, so accessible? TS private? Need to check.

Also, does record_order_payment_v2 require orderId matching on the entry, amount in order currency (orderPaymentAmountInOrderCurrency in handler), paymentStatus update — RPC updates order row amountPaid/amountRemaining/paymentStatus in the DB? In collectOrderPaymentHandler, yes: after recordOrderPayment, no separate orders update — RPC returns amountPaid/amountRemaining/paymentStatus, so it updates orders itself.

Also, orders list in FinanceAccounting: are `orders` from legacy or API? The component loads orders (probably via data gateway). FIFO computes allocations client-side from order.amountRemaining, and per-order recordOrderPayment updates DB. Orders refresh: orders data is polled? If it comes via legacy gateway stub… check where orders state in FinanceAccounting comes from. Previous note: CustomerFifoPaymentModal receives orders. Check how orders are fetched.

Also, currency curNo for FIFO: payment currency is YER (legacy hardcoded 'YER' and converted amount). If same currency, line's `amount` = amountOriginal. In collectOrderPaymentHandler's pattern, they used currencyRecord.cur_id for currencyOriginalNo and account.curNo for accountCurNo. We have the accounts list; can look up curNo from financialAccounts/postingFinancialAccounts rows. PostingAccount interface doesn't have curNo but rows have index signature? financialAccounts rows from API include curNo. Extend PostingAccount with curNo.

Need cash account's curNo: systemAccs from ensureSystemAccounts — check its return shape.

Things to read: legacy imports of financialAccountService (if any), signature of ensureSystemAccounts, definition of buildLegacyVoucherLine (is it public?), and how FinanceAccounting fetches `orders`, `postingFinancialAccounts`, `dbRates`.

Now checking `financialAccountService` (legacy status, `ensureSystemAccounts`) and how `orders`/`dbRates` are sourced in FinanceAccounting.

-- API access for existing shared system settings, currencies, rates, and user UI preferences.
-- This migration intentionally does NOT create or move any table.

REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.settings, public.currency, public.cur_price, public.user_settings
  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON TABLE public.settings, public.currency, public.cur_price, public.user_settings
  TO alx_api_runtime;

ALTER TABLE public.settings ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.currency ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.cur_price ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.user_settings ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.settings FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.currency FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.cur_price FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.user_settings FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS api_runtime_settings_all ON public.settings;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS api_runtime_currency_all ON public.currency;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS api_runtime_cur_price_all ON public.cur_price;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS api_runtime_user_settings_all ON public.user_settings;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow all" ON public.user_settings;

CREATE POLICY api_runtime_settings_all ON public.settings
  FOR ALL TO alx_api_runtime USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY api_runtime_currency_all ON public.currency
  FOR ALL TO alx_api_runtime USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY api_runtime_cur_price_all ON public.cur_price
  FOR ALL TO alx_api_runtime USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY api_runtime_user_settings_all ON public.user_settings
  FOR ALL TO alx_api_runtime USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.settle_custody_advance(p_custody_id text, p_entry jsonb, p_settled_by_uid text DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
  custody_record public.custody_advances%ROWTYPE;
  v_amount numeric;
  v_entry_result jsonb;
  v_new_settled numeric;
  v_new_outstanding numeric;
  v_new_status text;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO custody_record FROM public.custody_advances WHERE id = p_custody_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'العهدة غير موجودة.'; END IF;
  IF custody_record.status IN ('settled', 'cancelled') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن تسوية عهدة مغلقة.'; END IF;
  IF COALESCE(p_entry->>'amountOriginal', '') !~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' OR (p_entry->>'amountOriginal')::numeric <= 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مبلغ قيد التسوية يجب أن يكون موجبًا.';
  END IF;
  v_amount := (p_entry->>'amountOriginal')::numeric;
  IF v_amount > custody_record.amount_outstanding THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'مبلغ التسوية يتجاوز المتبقي من العهدة.'; END IF;
  IF COALESCE(p_entry->>'currencyOriginalNo', '')::integer <> custody_record.currency_original_no THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'عملة قيد التسوية يجب أن تطابق عملة العهدة.';
  END IF;
  IF p_settled_by_uid IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users WHERE id = p_settled_by_uid) THEN p_settled_by_uid := NULL; END IF;

  v_entry_result := public.create_financial_entry_v2(jsonb_set(p_entry, '{custodyId}', to_jsonb(p_custody_id), true));
  v_new_settled := custody_record.amount_settled + v_amount;
  v_new_outstanding := custody_record.amount_original - v_new_settled;
  v_new_status := CASE WHEN v_new_outstanding = 0 THEN 'settled' ELSE 'partial' END;
  UPDATE public.custody_advances
  SET amount_settled = v_new_settled, amount_outstanding = v_new_outstanding, status = v_new_status,
      settlement_entry_id = v_entry_result->>'id', settled_at = CASE WHEN v_new_status = 'settled' THEN now() ELSE NULL END,
      settled_by_uid = CASE WHEN v_new_status = 'settled' THEN p_settled_by_uid ELSE NULL END,
      updated_by_uid = p_settled_by_uid
  WHERE id = p_custody_id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('id', p_custody_id, 'settlementEntryId', v_entry_result->>'id', 'status', v_new_status, 'amountOutstanding', v_new_outstanding);
END;
$$;

const settleCustodyViaApi = async (custody: CustodyRecord): Promise<void> => {
  const outstanding = Number(custody.amountOutstanding ?? 0) || Number(custody.amountOriginal ?? custody.amount ?? 0);
  if (!(outstanding > 0)) throw new Error(isAr ? 'لا يوجد مبلغ معلق لهذه العهدة لتسويته.' : 'Custody has no outstanding amount to settle.');
  const curNo = Number(custody.currencyOriginalNo ?? 0);
  let currencyCode = 'YER';
  if (Number.isInteger(curNo) && curNo > 0) {
    const currencies = await settingsCurrenciesApiGateway.listCurrencies(false);
    currencyCode = String(currencies.find((c: any) => Number(c.currencyId) === curNo)?.code || custody.currency || 'YER');
  } else if (custody.currency) currencyCode = custody.currency;
  const toTarget = ... same as main actions (postingFinancialAccounts lookup).
  const cashId = (await financialAccountService.ensureSystemAccounts(currencyCode))['sys_cash_account'];
  const recipientTarget = toTarget(String(custody.recipientAccountId ?? ''));
  const cashTarget = toTarget(cashId);
  if (!recipientTarget || !cashTarget) throw new Error('حساب العهدة أو حساب الصندوق غير متوفر في الدفتر النشط.');
  const voucherNum = `${String(custody.expenseNumber ?? custody.id ?? 'custody')}-SET`;
  const voucher: LegacyVoucherInput = {
    entryNumber: voucherNum,
    createdAt: Date.now(),
    description: (isAr ? `تسوية عهدة تلقائية: ${custody.expenseNumber ?? ''}` : `Auto custody settlement: ${custody.expenseNumber ?? ''}`).trim(),
    amount: outstanding,
    currency: currencyCode,
    module: 'custody',
    refNumber: voucherNum,
    createdByUid: currentUser?.id || 'system',
    postingStatus: 'posted',
  };
  const entry = await financialEntryService.buildLegacyVoucherInput(voucher, recipientTarget, cashTarget);
  await financialEntryService.settleCustodyAdvance(String(custody.id), entry, currentUser?.id || undefined);

The Manager uses `rules` (rule.id, rule.isActive, rule.autoPost, rule.nameAr/En, descriptionTempAr/En, debitAccount, creditAccount) and `loading`. The hook needs to fetch `/api/v1/finance/auto-entry-rules` via apiClient and map to AutoVoucherRule: id=autoEntryId, nameAr, nameEn, descriptionTempAr=descriptionTemplateAr, debitAccount, creditAccount, isActive, autoPost. actionCode? The interface has actionCode?, requiredEntities?. Probably statusId → actionCode.

Also, handleToggleRuleActive and handleOpenEdit/save probably write via the legacy `doc(db, 'auto_entries', ruleId)` inside the Manager (based on the test asserting component contains `doc(db, 'auto_entries', ruleId)` — i.e., the Manager is still on legacy). The test expects the hook to contain `collection(db, 'auto_entries')` — that test's premise was legacy Supabase compat reads. But our goal is API-only, so the right move is: convert the hook to API reads, and also update the test to assert API reads (asserting the hook contains '/api/v1/finance/auto-entry-rules' and does not contain legacy). The Manager's writes also need converting to the API — this is broader-scope work. Let me read the whole Manager component.

export type ApiCoverageStatus = 'available' | 'partial' | 'missing';
export type ApiOperation = 'read' | 'write' | 'realtime';

export interface ApiDomainContract {
  domain: string;
  status: ApiCoverageStatus;
  operations: readonly ApiOperation[];
  apiOwner: string;
  cutoverPhase: number;
  notes: string;
}

/**
 * Phase 0 baseline. This is intentionally declarative; it does not select a
 * data source or perform a fallback. Each domain must move to `available`
 * before API-only mode is enabled for that domain.
 */
export const API_CONTRACT_MATRIX: readonly ApiDomainContract[] = [
  { domain: 'auth', status: 'available', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/auth', cutoverPhase: 2, notes: 'Session and token contract exists.' },

export function getApiDomainContract(domain: string): ApiDomainContract | undefined {
  return API_CONTRACT_MATRIX.find((contract) => contract.domain === domain);
}

1	import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
2	import type { ApiEnvironment } from '../../config/env';
3	import { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';
4	import { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';
5	import type { AuthPrincipalDto, AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
6	import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
7	import type { CurrenciesRepository } from './currencies.contracts';
8	import { createCurrencyRateSchema, createCurrencySchema, currencyIdSchema, listCurrenciesQuerySchema, updateCurrencySchema } from './settings.schemas';
9	
10	const requestId = (response: Response): string => String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');
11	const principal = (response: Response): AuthPrincipalDto | undefined => response.locals.authPrincipal as AuthPrincipalDto | undefined;
12	
13	export function registerCurrenciesRoutes(
14	  app: Express,
15	  _environment: ApiEnvironment,
16	  auth: AuthUseCases | undefined,
17	  repository: CurrenciesRepository,
18	): void {
19	  const authenticate = requireAuthenticatedUser(auth);
20	
21	  // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
22	  // العملات وأسعار الصرف = بيانات مرجعية عامة.
23	  // القراءة: تتطلب مصادقة فقط — لا صلاحية خاصة (يحتاجها كل مستخدم في نماذج الطلبات والمالية).
24	  // الكتابة والتعديل والحذف: تتطلب صلاحية محددة.
25	  //
26	  // Currencies & exchange rates are reference data.
27	  // Reads: authentication only — no specific permission (needed by every user in orders/finance forms).
28	  // Writes / edits / deletes: require a specific permission.
29	  // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
30	  const edit = requirePermission(auth, 'edit_currencies');
31	  const editRates = requirePermission(auth, 'edit_exchange_rates');
32	  const create = requirePermission(auth, 'add_currencies');
33	  const deletePermission = requirePermission(auth, 'delete_currencies');
34	
35	  // ── GET /api/v1/currencies ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
36	  // قراءة قائمة العملات — مصادقة فقط (لا تحتاج صلاحية view_exchange_rates)
37	  // List currencies — authentication only (no view_exchange_rates permission needed)
38	  app.get('/api/v1/currencies', authenticate, async (request, response, next) => {
39	    const query = listCurrenciesQuerySchema.safeParse(request.query);
40	    if (!query.success) {
41	      return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_CURRENCIES_QUERY', 'معاملات العملات غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
42	    }
43	    try {
44	      return sendSuccess(response, await repository.list(query.data.activeOnly), requestId(response));
45	    } catch (error) {
46	      return next(error);
47	    }
48	  });
49	
50	  // ── POST /api/v1/currencies ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
51	  // إنشاء عملة جديدة — يتطلب صلاحية add_currencies
52	  app.post('/api/v1/currencies', authenticate, create, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
53	    const body = createCurrencySchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
54	    const actor = principal(response);
55	    if (!body.success || !actor) {
56	      return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_CURRENCY_INPUT', 'بيانات العملة غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
57	    }
58	    try {
59	      return sendSuccess(response, await repository.create(body.data, actor.userId), requestId(response));
60	    } catch (error) {
61	      return next(error);
62	    }
63	  });
64	
65	  // ── GET /api/v1/currencies/:currencyId ─────────────────────────────────────
66	  // قراءة عملة واحدة — مصادقة فقط
67	  app.get('/api/v1/currencies/:currencyId', authenticate, async (request, response, next) => {
68	    const id = currencyIdSchema.safeParse(request.params.currencyId);
69	    if (!id.success) {
70	      return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_CURRENCY_ID', 'معرف العملة غير صالح.', requestId(response));
71	    }
72	    try {
73	      const item = await repository.findById(id.data);
74	      return item
75	        ? sendSuccess(response, item, requestId(response))
76	        : sendFailure(response, 404, 'CURRENCY_NOT_FOUND', 'العملة غير موجودة.', requestId(response));
77	    } catch (error) {
78	      return next(error);
79	    }
80	  });
81	
82	  // ── PATCH /api/v1/currencies/:currencyId ───────────────────────────────────
83	  // تعديل عملة — يتطلب صلاحية edit_currencies
84	  app.patch('/api/v1/currencies/:currencyId', authenticate, edit, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
85	    const id = currencyIdSchema.safeParse(request.params.currencyId);
86	    const body = updateCurrencySchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
87	    const actor = principal(response);
88	    if (!id.success || !body.success || !actor) {
89	      return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_CURRENCY_INPUT', 'بيانات العملة غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
90	    }
91	    try {
92	      const item = await repository.update(id.data, body.data, actor.userId);
93	      return item
94	        ? sendSuccess(response, item, requestId(response))
95	        : sendFailure(response, 404, 'CURRENCY_NOT_FOUND', 'العملة غير موجودة.', requestId(response));
96	    } catch (error) {
97	      return next(error);
98	    }
99	  });
100	
101	  // ── DELETE /api/v1/currencies/:currencyId ──────────────────────────────────
102	  // حذف عملة — يتطلب صلاحية delete_currencies

125	class CurrencyService {
126	  /**
127	   * جلب جميع العملات مع آخر سعر صرف لكل منها.

133	    try {

152	   * Returns the default system currency (is_default = true).

156	    try {

158	      return currencies.find(c => c.is_default) || null;

167	   *
168	   * المنطق:
169	   * - العملة ذات is_default=true دائماً = 1 (هي عملة الأساس)
170	   * - كل عملة أخرى: price = كم وحدة من العملة الأساس تساوي 1 وحدة منها
171	   *
172	   * Exchange rate logic:
173	   * - Default currency always = 1 (base currency)
174	   * - Other currencies: price = how many base currency units = 1 unit of that currency
175	   */
176	  async getLatestExchangeRates(): Promise<ExchangeRates> {
177	    try {
178	      const dtos = await settingsCurrenciesApiGateway.listCurrencies(false);
179	      if (!dtos || dtos.length === 0) {
180	        console.warn('[currencyService] getLatestExchangeRates: no currencies returned from API');
181	        return {};
182	      }
183	
184	      const rates: ExchangeRates = {};
185	      dtos.forEach((c: ApiCurrencyDto) => {
186	        if (c.isDefault) {
187	          // العملة الأساس = 1 دائماً / Base currency always = 1
188	          rates[c.code] = 1;
189	        } else {
190	          const price = c.currentPrice;
191	          if (price !== undefined && price !== null && price > 0) {
192	            rates[c.code] = price;
193	          } else {
194	            rates[c.code] = 0;
195	            console.warn(`⚠️ [تنبيـه أسعـار الصـرف] العملة (${c.code}) لا يوجد لها سعر صرف مسجل! سعرها = 0.`);
196	          }
197	        }
198	      });
199	
200	      return rates;
201	    } catch (err) {
202	      console.error('[currencyService] getLatestExchangeRates error:', err);
203	      return {};
204	    }
205	  }
206	
207	  /**
208	   * يُعيد خريطة أسعار الصرف الكاملة — التحويل يتم في convertToTargetCurrency.
209	   * Returns the full exchange rate map — conversion happens in convertToTargetCurrency.
210	   */
211	  async getExchangeRatesFromBetweenTwoCurrencies(
212	    _fromCurrency: string,
213	    _toCurrency: string
214	  ): Promise<ExchangeRates> {
215	    // نُعيد الخريطة الكاملة — التحويل يتم باستخدام: result = amount * rates[from] / rates[to]

217	    return this.getLatestExchangeRates();
218	  }

12	 * Singleton hook that fetches exchange rates and currencies from API.

17	import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
18	import { currencyService } from '../services/currencyService';
19	import type { Currency, ExchangeRates } from '../services/currencyService';
20	import { asyncState, runQuery, type AsyncState } from '../shared/contracts/ui.contracts';
21	
22	// ── Singleton State ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
23	
24	interface ExchangeRatesState {
25	  rates: ExchangeRates;
26	  currencies: Currency[];
27	  activeCurrencies: Currency[];
28	  loading: boolean;
29	  queryState: AsyncState<ExchangeRatesData>;
30	  updatedAt: number;
31	}
32	
33	interface ExchangeRatesData {
34	  rates: ExchangeRates;
35	  currencies: Currency[];
36	  activeCurrencies: Currency[];
37	}
38	
39	// فترة إعادة التحميل بالمللي ثانية (3 دقائق)
40	// Polling interval: 3 minutes
41	const POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 3 * 60 * 1000;
42	
43	let _state: ExchangeRatesState = {
44	  // الحالة الأولية: خريطة فارغة — ستُملأ من API فور الاتصال
45	  // Initial state: empty map — will be filled from API on first call
46	  rates: {},
47	  currencies: [],
48	  activeCurrencies: [],
49	  loading: true,
50	  queryState: asyncState.loading(),
51	  updatedAt: 0,
52	};
53	
54	const _subscribers = new Set<() => void>();
55	let _initialized = false;
56	let _pollTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
57	
58	function _notify() {
59	  _subscribers.forEach(cb => cb());
60	}
61	
62	async function _refresh() {
63	  const result = await runQuery<ExchangeRatesData>(
64	    async () => {
65	      const [rates, currencies] = await Promise.all([
66	        currencyService.getLatestExchangeRates(),
67	        currencyService.getAllCurrencies(false),
68	      ]);
69	      return {
70	        rates,
71	        currencies,
72	        activeCurrencies: currencies.filter(c => c.isActive || c.is_active),
73	      };
74	    },
75	    (queryState) => {
76	      if (queryState.status === 'loading') _state = { ..._state, loading: true, queryState };
77	    },
78	    (data) => Object.keys(data.rates).length === 0 && data.currencies.length === 0
79	  );
80	
81	  if (result.status === 'success') {
82	    _state = { ...result.data, loading: false, queryState: result, updatedAt: Date.now() };
83	  } else if (result.status === 'empty') {
84	    _state = { rates: {}, currencies: [], activeCurrencies: [], loading: false, queryState: result, updatedAt: Date.now() };
85	  } else if (result.status === 'error') {
86	    _state = { ..._state, loading: false, queryState: result, updatedAt: Date.now() };
87	  }
88	  _notify();
89	}
90	
91	/**
92	 * تهيئة Singleton: التحميل الأولي وإعداد polling بدلاً من Supabase realtime
93	 * Initialize singleton: initial load + polling instead of Supabase realtime
94	 */
95	function _initSingleton() {
96	  if (_initialized) return;
97	  _initialized = true;
98	
99	  // التحميل الأولي / Initial load
100	  void _refresh();
101	
102	  // إعداد polling دوري / Setup periodic polling
103	  if (_pollTimer) clearInterval(_pollTimer);
104	  _pollTimer = setInterval(() => void _refresh(), POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
105	}
106	
107	// ── Hook ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
108	
109	export function useExchangeRates() {
110	  const [, forceUpdate] = useState(0);
111	
112	  useEffect(() => {
113	    _initSingleton();
114	
115	    const cb = () => forceUpdate(n => n + 1);
116	    _subscribers.add(cb);
117	    return () => {
118	      _subscribers.delete(cb);
119	    };
120	  }, []);
121	
122	  return _state;
123	}

128	 */
129	export function getLatestRatesSync(): ExchangeRates {

13	export function registerSettingsRoutes(app: Express, _environment: ApiEnvironment, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined, repository: SettingsRepository): void {

15	  const view = requirePermission(auth, 'view_general_settings');
16	  const edit = requirePermission(auth, 'edit_general_settings');
17	  const userView = requirePermission(auth, 'view_interface_settings');
18	  const userEdit = requirePermission(auth, 'edit_interface_settings');

20	    app.get(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, view, async (_request, response, next) => {
21	      try {
22	        const record = await repository.get(category);
23	        return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'الإعدادات غير موجودة.', requestId(response));
24	      } catch (error) { return next(error); }
25	    });
26	    app.patch(`/api/v1/settings/${category}`, authenticate, edit, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
27	      const body = updateSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
28	      const actor = principal(response);
29	      if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات الإعدادات غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
30	      try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.update(category, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
31	      catch (error) { return next(error); }
32	    });
33	  }
34	  app.get('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, userView, async (_request, response, next) => {
35	    const actor = principal(response);
36	    if (!actor) return sendFailure(response, 401, 'AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'بيانات المصادقة غير صحيحة.', requestId(response));
37	    try { const record = await repository.getUser(actor.userId); return record ? sendSuccess(response, record, requestId(response)) : sendFailure(response, 404, 'USER_SETTINGS_NOT_FOUND', 'إعدادات المستخدم غير موجودة.', requestId(response)); }
38	    catch (error) { return next(error); }
39	  });
40	  app.patch('/api/v1/settings/user', authenticate, userEdit, async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
41	    const body = updateUserSettingsSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
42	    const actor = principal(response);
43	    if (!body.success || !actor) return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_USER_SETTINGS_INPUT', 'بيانات إعدادات المستخدم غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
44	    try { return sendSuccess(response, await repository.updateUser(actor.userId, body.data.settings, actor.userId), requestId(response)); }
45	    catch (error) { return next(error); }
46	  });

206	// ── تحويل DTO العملة من API إلى CustomCurrency / Map API currency DTO to CustomCurrency
207	function mapApiCurrencyToCustomCurrency(c: ApiCurrencyDto): CustomCurrency {
208	  return {
209	    id: c.code,
210	    code: c.code,
211	    name: c.mainNameAr || c.mainNameEn || c.code,
212	    symbol: c.symbol || c.code,
213	    rateToYER: c.currentPrice ?? (c.isDefault ? 1 : 0),
214	    flag: c.flag ?? undefined,
215	    isActive: c.isActive,
216	  };
217	}

219	// ── استخراج معرف المستخدم الحالي من sessionStorage / Extract current user ID from sessionStorage
220	function getCurrentUserId(): string | null {
221	  if (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined') return null;
222	  try {
223	    // محاولة جلب userId من رمز الوصول المخزن
224	    // Try to get userId from stored access token
225	    const token = sessionStorage.getItem('alx_access_token') || sessionStorage.getItem('alx_api_access_token');
226	    if (!token) return null;
227	    const parts = token.split('.');
228	    if (parts.length !== 3) return null;
229	    const payload = JSON.parse(atob(parts[1]));
230	    return (payload?.sub as string) || (payload?.userId as string) || null;
231	  } catch {
232	    return null;
233	  }
234	}

237	const SettingsContext = createContext<SettingsContextType | undefined>(undefined);

239	// ── فترة إعادة التحميل الدوري بالمللي ثانية (5 دقائق)
240	// Polling interval for settings refresh (5 minutes)
241	const SETTINGS_POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;

243	export function SettingsProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
244	  const [globalSettings, setGlobalSettings] = useState<Settings>(defaultSettings);
245	  const [userSettings, setUserSettings] = useState<Partial<Settings>>({});
246	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
247	  const pollingTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);
248	
249	  // دمج الإعدادات العامة مع إعدادات المستخدم / Merge global + user settings
250	  const settings: Settings = { ...globalSettings, ...userSettings };
251	
252	  // دالة الترجمة / Translation function
253	  const t = useCallback((key: TranslationKey): string => {
254	    return translations[settings.language]?.[key] || key;
255	  }, [settings.language]);
256	
257	  /**
258	   * جلب الإعدادات العامة من API
259	   * Fetch general settings from API
260	   */
261	  const fetchGlobalSettings = useCallback(async () => {
262	    try {
263	      const dto = await settingsCurrenciesApiGateway.getSettings('general');
264	      if (dto?.settings) {
265	        setGlobalSettings(prev => ({ ...prev, ...dto.settings }));
266	      }
267	    } catch (err) {
268	      console.warn('[SettingsContext] fetchGlobalSettings failed, keeping current settings:', err);
269	    }
270	  }, []);
271	
272	  /**
273	   * جلب العملات وأسعار الصرف من API
274	   * Fetch currencies and exchange rates from API
275	   */
276	  const fetchCurrencies = useCallback(async () => {
277	    try {
278	      const currencies = await settingsCurrenciesApiGateway.listCurrencies(false);
279	      if (currencies && currencies.length > 0) {
280	        const mapped: CustomCurrency[] = currencies.map(mapApiCurrencyToCustomCurrency);
281	
282	        // استخراج أسعار الصرف للعملات الرئيسية
283	        // Extract exchange rates for main currencies
284	        const usdCurrency = currencies.find(c => c.code === 'USD');
285	        const sarCurrency = currencies.find(c => c.code === 'SAR');
286	
287	        setGlobalSettings(prev => ({
288	          ...prev,
289	          customCurrencies: mapped,
290	          exchangeRateUSD: usdCurrency?.currentPrice ?? prev.exchangeRateUSD,
291	          exchangeRateSAR: sarCurrency?.currentPrice ?? prev.exchangeRateSAR,
292	        }));
293	      }
294	    } catch (err) {
295	      console.warn('[SettingsContext] fetchCurrencies failed, keeping current currencies:', err);
296	    }
297	  }, []);
298	
299	  /**
300	   * جلب إعدادات المستخدم الحالي من API
301	   * Fetch current user settings from API
302	   */
303	  const fetchUserSettings = useCallback(async () => {
304	    const userId = getCurrentUserId();
305	    if (!userId) return;
306	    try {
307	      const dto = await settingsCurrenciesApiGateway.getUserSettings();
308	      if (dto?.settings) {
309	        setUserSettings(dto.settings as Partial<Settings>);
310	      }
311	    } catch (err) {
312	      console.warn('[SettingsContext] fetchUserSettings failed:', err);
313	    }
314	  }, []);
315	
316	  /**
317	   * التحميل الأولي عند بدء التطبيق
318	   * Initial load on app start
319	   */
320	  useEffect(() => {
321	    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
322	      // انتهاء المهلة: استخدام الإعدادات الافتراضية
323	      // Timeout: use default settings
324	      console.warn('[SettingsContext] Settings fetch timed out — using defaults');
325	      setLoading(false);
326	    }, 6000);
327	
328	    Promise.allSettled([
329	      fetchGlobalSettings(),
330	      fetchCurrencies(),
331	      fetchUserSettings(),
332	    ]).finally(() => {
333	      clearTimeout(timeout);
334	      setLoading(false);
335	    });
336	
337	    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
338	  }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
339	
340	  /**
341	   * إعادة تحميل دورية للإعدادات والعملات (بدلاً من Supabase realtime)
342	   * Periodic refresh for settings and currencies (replacing Supabase realtime)
343	   */
344	  useEffect(() => {
345	    if (loading) return;
346	    pollingTimerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
347	      void fetchGlobalSettings();
348	      void fetchCurrencies();
349	    }, SETTINGS_POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
350	
351	    return () => {
352	      if (pollingTimerRef.current) clearInterval(pollingTimerRef.current);
353	    };
354	  }, [loading, fetchGlobalSettings, fetchCurrencies]);
355	
356	  /**
357	   * تأثيرات تغيير الإعدادات (اتجاه الصفحة، الثيم، حجم الخط، عنوان الصفحة)
358	   * Side effects when settings change (RTL/LTR, theme, font size, page title)
359	   */
360	  useEffect(() => {
361	    // اتجاه الصفحة واللغة / Page direction and language
362	    if (settings.language === 'ar') {
363	      document.documentElement.dir = 'rtl';
364	      document.documentElement.lang = 'ar';
365	    } else {
366	      document.documentElement.dir = 'ltr';
367	      document.documentElement.lang = 'en';
368	    }
369	
370	    // الثيم / Theme
371	    if (settings.theme === 'dark') {
372	      document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
373	      document.documentElement.classList.remove('light-mode');
374	    } else {
375	      document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
376	      document.documentElement.classList.add('light-mode');
377	    }
378	
379	    // حجم الخط / Font size
380	    const size = FONT_SIZE_MAP[settings.fontSize || 'md'] || '14px';
381	    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--system-font-size', size);
382	    document.documentElement.style.fontSize = size;
383	
384	    // عنوان الصفحة / Page title
385	    document.title = settings.systemName || settings.companyName || 'SwiftShip';
386	  }, [settings.language, settings.theme, settings.fontSize, settings.systemName, settings.companyName]);
387	
388	  /**
389	   * تحديث الإعدادات وإرسالها إلى API
390	   * Update settings and send to API
391	   */
392	  const updateSettings = useCallback(async (newSettings: Partial<Settings>): Promise<void> => {
393	    const userUpdates: Record<string, unknown> = {};
394	    const globalUpdates: Partial<Settings> = {};
395	
396	    // فصل الإعدادات الخاصة بالمستخدم عن الإعدادات العامة
397	    // Separate user-specific settings from global settings
398	    Object.entries(newSettings).forEach(([key, value]) => {
399	      const k = key as keyof Settings;
400	      if (USER_SPECIFIC_KEYS.includes(k)) {
401	        userUpdates[k] = value;
402	      } else {
403	        Object.assign(globalUpdates, { [k]: value });
404	      }
405	    });
406	
407	    // حفظ الإعدادات العامة / Save global settings
408	    if (Object.keys(globalUpdates).length > 0) {
409	      try {
410	        await settingsCurrenciesApiGateway.updateSettings('general', globalUpdates as import('../data/dtos/settings.dto').SystemSettingsData);
411	        setGlobalSettings(prev => ({ ...prev, ...globalUpdates }));
412	      } catch (err) {
413	        console.error('[SettingsContext] updateSettings (general) failed:', err);
414	        throw err;
415	      }
416	    }
417	
418	    // حفظ إعدادات المستخدم / Save user settings
419	    if (Object.keys(userUpdates).length > 0) {
420	      const userId = getCurrentUserId();
421	      if (userId) {
422	        try {
423	          await settingsCurrenciesApiGateway.updateUserSettings(
424	            userUpdates as Parameters<typeof settingsCurrenciesApiGateway.updateUserSettings>[0]
425	          );
426	          setUserSettings(prev => ({ ...prev, ...userUpdates } as Partial<Settings>));
427	        } catch (err) {
428	          console.warn('[SettingsContext] updateUserSettings failed — saving to local state only:', err);
429	          // الحفظ المحلي كاحتياط / Local state fallback
430	          setUserSettings(prev => ({ ...prev, ...userUpdates } as Partial<Settings>));
431	        }
432	      } else {
433	        // المستخدم غير مسجل — الحفظ في الحالة المحلية فقط (صفحة تسجيل الدخول)
434	        // User not logged in — local state only (login screen language)
435	        setUserSettings(prev => ({ ...prev, ...userUpdates } as Partial<Settings>));
436	      }
437	    }
438	  }, []);
439	
440	  return (
441	    <SettingsContext.Provider value={{ settings, updateSettings, loading, t }}>
442	      {children}
443	    </SettingsContext.Provider>
444	  );
445	}
446	
447	/**
448	 * hook للوصول إلى إعدادات النظام / Hook to access system settings
449	 */
450	export function useSettings() {
451	  const context = useContext(SettingsContext);
452	  if (context === undefined) {
453	    throw new Error('useSettings must be used within a SettingsProvider');
454	  }
455	  return context;
456	}

import type { Pool } from 'pg';
import type {
  CurrenciesRepository,
  CurrencyCreateInput,
  CurrencyRateRecord,
  CurrencyRecord,
  CurrencyUpdateInput,
} from './currencies.contracts';

const currencyColumns = `
  c.cur_id AS "currencyId", c.code, c.main_name_ar AS "mainNameAr",
  c.sub_name_ar AS "subNameAr", c.main_name_en AS "mainNameEn", c.sub_name_en AS "subNameEn",
  c.symbol, c.flag, c.is_default AS "isDefault", c.is_active AS "isActive", c.created_at AS "createdAt",
  CASE WHEN c.is_default THEN 1 ELSE latest.price END AS "currentPrice",
  latest.seq AS "lastSeq", latest.updated_by AS "lastUpdateBy", latest.day_date AS "lastUpdateDate"
`;

function mapRate(row: Record<string, unknown>): CurrencyRateRecord {
  return {
    rateId: Number(row.rateId),
    currencyId: Number(row.currencyId),
    price: Number(row.price),
    dayDate: String(row.dayDate),
    sequence: Number(row.sequence),
    updatedBy: row.updatedBy === null ? null : String(row.updatedBy),
    createdAt: row.createdAt === null ? null : String(row.createdAt),
  };
}

export function createCurrenciesRepository(pool: Pool): CurrenciesRepository {
  const findQuery = `SELECT ${currencyColumns}
    FROM public.currency c
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT cp.price, cp.seq, cp.updated_by, cp.day_date
      FROM public.cur_price cp WHERE cp.cur_no = c.cur_id
      ORDER BY cp.seq DESC, cp.cur_price_id DESC LIMIT 1
    ) latest ON true`;
  return {
    async list(activeOnly: boolean): Promise<readonly CurrencyRecord[]> {
      const result = await pool.query<CurrencyRecord>(`${findQuery} ${activeOnly ? 'WHERE c.is_active IS TRUE' : ''} ORDER BY c.cur_id ASC`);
      return result.rows.map((row) => ({ ...row, currentPrice: row.currentPrice === null ? null : Number(row.currentPrice) }));
    },
    async findById(currencyId: number): Promise<CurrencyRecord | null> {
      const result = await pool.query<CurrencyRecord>(`${findQuery} WHERE c.cur_id = $1 LIMIT 1`, [currencyId]);
      const row = result.rows[0];
      return row ? { ...row, currentPrice: row.currentPrice === null ? null : Number(row.currentPrice) } : null;
    },
    async create(input: CurrencyCreateInput, actorId: string): Promise<CurrencyRecord> {
      const client = await pool.connect();
      try {
        await client.query('BEGIN');
        if (input.isDefault) await client.query('UPDATE public.currency SET is_default = FALSE, updated_by = $1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE is_default IS TRUE', [actorId]);
        const inserted = await client.query<{ currencyId: number }>(
          `INSERT INTO public.currency
             (code, main_name_ar, sub_name_ar, main_name_en, sub_name_en, symbol, flag, is_default, is_active, created_at, created_by, updated_by)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, NOW(), $10, $10) RETURNING cur_id AS "currencyId"`,
          [input.code, input.mainNameAr, input.subNameAr ?? '', input.mainNameEn ?? '', input.subNameEn ?? '', input.symbol, input.flag ?? '', input.isDefault, input.isActive, actorId],
        );
        const insertedRow = inserted.rows[0];
        if (!insertedRow) throw new Error('CURRENCY_CREATE_FAILED');
        await client.query('COMMIT');
        const row = await this.findById(insertedRow.currencyId);
        if (!row) throw new Error('CURRENCY_CREATE_READBACK_FAILED');
        return row;
      } catch (error) {
        await client.query('ROLLBACK');
        throw error;
      } finally { client.release(); }
    },
    async update(currencyId: number, input: CurrencyUpdateInput, actorId: string): Promise<CurrencyRecord | null> {
      const client = await pool.connect();
      try {
        await client.query('BEGIN');
        if (input.isDefault) await client.query('UPDATE public.currency SET is_default = FALSE, updated_by = $1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE is_default IS TRUE AND cur_id <> $2', [actorId, currencyId]);
        const result = await client.query(
          `UPDATE public.currency SET
            code = COALESCE($1, code), main_name_ar = COALESCE($2, main_name_ar), sub_name_ar = COALESCE($3, sub_name_ar),
            main_name_en = COALESCE($4, main_name_en), sub_name_en = COALESCE($5, sub_name_en), symbol = COALESCE($6, symbol),
            flag = COALESCE($7, flag), is_default = COALESCE($8, is_default), is_active = COALESCE($9, is_active),
            updated_by = $10, updated_at = NOW()
           WHERE cur_id = $11 RETURNING cur_id`,
          [input.code ?? null, input.mainNameAr ?? null, input.subNameAr ?? null, input.mainNameEn ?? null, input.subNameEn ?? null, input.symbol ?? null, input.flag ?? null, input.isDefault ?? null, input.isActive ?? null, actorId, currencyId],
        );
        if ((result.rowCount ?? 0) === 0) { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); return null; }
        await client.query('COMMIT');
        return this.findById(currencyId);
      } catch (error) {
        await client.query('ROLLBACK');
        throw error;
      } finally { client.release(); }
    },
    async delete(currencyId: number, actorId: string): Promise<boolean> {
      const result = await pool.query('UPDATE public.currency SET is_active = FALSE, updated_by = $2, updated_at = NOW() WHERE cur_id = $1 AND is_default IS FALSE', [currencyId, actorId]);
      return (result.rowCount ?? 0) > 0;
    },
    async listRates(currencyId: number): Promise<readonly CurrencyRateRecord[]> {
      const result = await pool.query(
        `SELECT cur_price_id AS "rateId", cur_no AS "currencyId", price, day_date AS "dayDate", seq AS sequence,
                updated_by AS "updatedBy", created_at AS "createdAt"
         FROM public.cur_price WHERE cur_no = $1 ORDER BY seq DESC, cur_price_id DESC LIMIT 500`,
        [currencyId],
      );
      return result.rows.map(mapRate);
    },
    async addRate(currencyId: number, price: number, dayDate: string | undefined, actorId: string): Promise<CurrencyRateRecord> {
      const result = await pool.query(
        `INSERT INTO public.cur_price (cur_no, price, day_date, seq, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, created_by)
         SELECT $1, $2, COALESCE($3::timestamptz, NOW()), COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) + 1, $4, NOW(), NOW(), $4
         FROM public.cur_price WHERE cur_no = $1
         RETURNING cur_price_id AS "rateId", cur_no AS "currencyId", price, day_date AS "dayDate", seq AS sequence,
                   updated_by AS "updatedBy", created_at AS "createdAt"`,
        [currencyId, price, dayDate ?? null, actorId],
      );
      if (!result.rows[0]) throw new Error('CURRENCY_RATE_CREATE_FAILED');
      return mapRate(result.rows[0]);
    },
  };
}

593	  async deletePosted(entryId: string, deletedByUid?: string): Promise<{ id: string; deleted: true }> {
594	    if (!entryId?.trim()) throw new Error('معرف القيد المرحّل مطلوب للحذف.');
595	    // نحاول أولاً إجراء RPC مخصص للمرحّل، وإن لم يكن موجوداً نعود لحذف المسودة
596	    // Try dedicated RPC first; fall back to draft delete if not available

603	      // If RPC doesn't exist, fall back to direct delete
604	      if (error.message?.includes('does not exist') || error.code === 'PGRST202') {

5	const PERMISSION_CODE_PATTERN = /^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{1,127}$/;

7	export function requirePermission(useCases: AuthUseCases | undefined, permissionCode: string): RequestHandler {
8	  if (!PERMISSION_CODE_PATTERN.test(permissionCode)) {
9	    throw new TypeError('A canonical permission code is required.');
10	  }
11	
12	  return async (_request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
13	    const requestId = String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');

15	    if (!useCases || !principal?.userId) {
16	      sendFailure(response, 401, 'AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'بيانات المصادقة غير صحيحة.', requestId);
17	      return;

19

22	      if (!permissions.includes(permissionCode)) {
23	        sendFailure(response, 403, 'AUTH_FORBIDDEN', 'لا تملك الصلاحية المطلوبة.', requestId);
24	        return;
25	      }
26	      next();
27	    } catch (error) {
28	      next(error);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.financial_entry_permission_for_payload(p_entry jsonb, p_action text)
RETURNS text
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY INVOKER
SET search_path = public, auth
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_type_code text;
  v_category text := COALESCE(p_entry->>'entryCategory', 'General');
BEGIN
  SELECT code INTO v_type_code FROM public.entry_type WHERE id = NULLIF(btrim(p_entry->>'entryTypeId'), '');
  IF p_action = 'create' THEN
    IF v_type_code IN ('RECEIPT_VOUCHER', 'ORDER_PAYMENT') THEN RETURN 'create_receipt_vouchers'; END IF;
    IF v_type_code IN ('PAYMENT_VOUCHER', 'OPERATING_EXPENSE', 'SALARY_PAYMENT') THEN RETURN 'create_payment_vouchers'; END IF;
    IF v_category = 'Compound' THEN RETURN 'create_compound_entries'; END IF;
    IF v_category = 'Temp' THEN RETURN 'create_temporary_entries'; END IF;
    RETURN 'create_general_entries';
  END IF;
  IF v_type_code IN ('RECEIPT_VOUCHER', 'ORDER_PAYMENT') THEN RETURN 'edit_receipt_vouchers'; END IF;
  IF v_type_code IN ('PAYMENT_VOUCHER', 'OPERATING_EXPENSE', 'SALARY_PAYMENT') THEN RETURN 'edit_payment_vouchers'; END IF;
  IF v_category = 'Compound' THEN RETURN 'edit_compound_entries'; END IF;
  IF v_category = 'Temp' THEN RETURN 'edit_temporary_entries'; END IF;
  RETURN 'edit_general_entries';
END;
$$;

297	  /**
298	   * Centralized, unified and strict recordTransaction method.
299	   * Enforces that every transaction defines a source (Credit) and destination (Debit) account,
300	   * checks that the transaction amounts are fully balanced,
301	   * and registers the unified transaction accordingly.
302	   */
303	  async recordTransaction(
304	    transaction: Transaction,
305	    providedRates?: { USD?: number; SAR?: number; YER?: number },
306	  ): Promise<void> {
307	    // 1. Enforce strict requirement: Must explicitly define source (Credit) and destination (Debit)
308	    if (!transaction.debitAccount?.id || !transaction.creditAccount?.id) {
309	      throw new Error(
310	        "Transaction submission rejected: A source (Credit) and destination (Debit) account are explicitly required.",
311	      );
312	    }
313	
314	    // 2. Prevent any transaction submission where totalDebit !== totalCredit
315	    // On the single value amount double entry form, the debit and credit totals are inherently equal to this amount.
316	    const debitTotal = transaction.amount;
317	    const creditTotal = transaction.amount;
318	    if (debitTotal !== creditTotal) {
319	      throw new Error(
320	        "Transaction submission rejected: Sum of Debits must equal Sum of Credits (totalDebit == totalCredit). debitTotal=" + debitTotal + "creditTotal=" + creditTotal,
321	      );
322	    } else if (debitTotal <= 0) {
323	      throw new Error(
324	        "Transaction submission rejected: Debit Amount must be greater than zero.",
325	      );
326	    } else if (creditTotal <= 0) {
327	      throw new Error(
328	        "Transaction submission rejected: Credit Amount must be greater than zero.",
329	      );
330	    }
331	
332	
333	
334	    const debitAccount = await this.getAccountById(transaction.debitAccount.id);
335	    const creditAccount = await this.getAccountById(
336	      transaction.creditAccount.id,
337	    );
338	
339	    if (!debitAccount || !creditAccount) {
340	      throw new Error(
341	        "Transaction submission rejected: Specified accounts do not exist.",
342	      );
343	    }
344	
345	    const journalEntry: Omit<JournalEntry, "id"> = {
346	      entryNumber:
347	        (transaction as any).entryNumber ||
348	        transaction.automationKey ||
349	        `JV-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10).replaceAll('-', '')}-${Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000)}`,
350	      createdAt: transaction.date || Date.now(),
351	      description: transaction.description || "",
352	      attachments: transaction.attachments || [],
353	      notes: transaction.notes || transaction.description || "",
354	
355	      debitAccountId: transaction.debitAccount.id,
356	      debitAccountName: debitAccount.entityName,
357	      debitAccountCode: debitAccount.accountCode,
358	
359	      creditAccountId: transaction.creditAccount.id,
360	      creditAccountName: creditAccount.entityName,
361	      creditAccountCode: creditAccount.accountCode,
362	
363	      amount: transaction.amount,
364	      currency: transaction.currency || debitAccount.currency || "YER",
365	      amountDebitCurrency: 0,
366	      amountCreditCurrency: 0,
367	
368	      module: transaction.module || "adjustment",
369	      refNumber: transaction.refNumber || "",
370	      orderId: transaction.orderId,
371	      orderNumber: transaction.orderNumber,
372	      shipmentId: transaction.shipmentId,
373	      automationKey: transaction.automationKey,
374	      autoRuleId: transaction.autoRuleId,
375	      statusId: transaction.statusId,
376	      isAutomatic: transaction.isAutomatic,
377	      amountSources: transaction.amountSources,
378	      amountBreakdown: transaction.amountBreakdown,
379	      // تمرير postingStatus إذا مُرِّر من القيد التلقائي — forward postingStatus if provided (for autoPost support)
380	      postingStatus: (transaction as any).postingStatus || 'posted',
381	      createdByUid: transaction.createdByUid || "system",
382	      createdByName: transaction.createdByName || "Audit Engine",
383	    };
384	
385	    await this.recordJournalEntry(journalEntry, providedRates);
386	  }

118	const getOrderTimestamp = (value: CustomerOrderRecord['createdAt']): number => {
119	  if (value && typeof value === 'object' && 'toDate' in value) return value.toDate().getTime();
120	  if (typeof value === 'number') return value;
121	  if (typeof value === 'string') return Number(value) || 0;
122	  return 0;
123	};

125	const errorMessage = (error: unknown, fallback: string): string =>
126	  error instanceof Error && error.message ? error.message : fallback;
