128	export function createFinanceAccountingMainEntryActions(dependencies: ActionDependencies) {
129	  const { adjustData, adjustLoading, adjustSalaryMonth, auditedCustomerId, collection, currentUser, customerLedgerDetails, db, dbRates, deletePin, doc, editJournalData, employees, entryToDelete, financialAccountService, getDocs, isAr, isSalaryPayment, notificationService, orders, payAmount, payLoading, payNotes, postingFinancialAccounts, query, selectedEditEntry, setAdjustData, setAdjustLoading, setDeleteLoading, setDeletePin, setDeletePinError, setEditJournalLoading, setEntryToDelete, setIsAdjustmentModalOpen, setIsDeletePinModalOpen, setIsEditJournalOpen, setIsPayModalOpen, setIsSalaryPayment, setPayAmount, setPayLoading, setPayNotes, setSelectedEditEntry, setSourceAccountId, setTargetAccountId, setTargetType, settings, sourceAccountId, targetAccountId, targetType, where, writeBatch } = dependencies;
130	
131	  const handleEditJournalSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
132	    e.preventDefault();
133	    if (!selectedEditEntry) return;
134	    if (!editJournalData.amountOriginal || isNaN(parseFloat(editJournalData.amountOriginal))) {
135	      return notificationService.notify({
136	        title: isAr ? 'خطأ' : 'Error',
137	        message: isAr ? 'قيمة المبلغ غير صالحة' : 'Invalid Amount',
138	        type: 'error'
139	      });
140	    }
141	
142	    setEditJournalLoading(true);
143	    try {
144	      const rawAmt = parseFloat(editJournalData.amountOriginal);
145	      const convertedAmt = financialAccountService.convertToDefaultCurrency(
146	        rawAmt,
147	        editJournalData.currencyOriginal,
148	        settings.currency || 'YER',
149	        dbRates
150	      );
151	
152	      const parsedCreatedAt = editJournalData.createdAt ? new Date(editJournalData.createdAt).getTime() : Date.now();
153	      const batch = writeBatch(db);
154	
155	      const affectedAccountIds = new Set<string>();
156	
157	      {
158	        const txId = selectedEditEntry.id;
159	        const refNum = selectedEditEntry.refNumber;
160	
161	        const txQuery = refNum
162	          ? query(collection(db, 'account_trans'), where('ref_number', '==', refNum))
163	          : query(collection(db, 'account_trans'), where('__name__', '==', txId));
164	
165	        const txSnap = await getDocs(txQuery);
166	        const exchangeRates = dbRates;
167	
168	        const newDebitAcc = editJournalData.debitAccountId ? postingFinancialAccounts.find((a: PostingAccount) => a.id === editJournalData.debitAccountId) : null;
169	        const newCreditAcc = editJournalData.creditAccountId ? postingFinancialAccounts.find((a: PostingAccount) => a.id === editJournalData.creditAccountId) : null;
170	
171	        if (!txSnap.empty) {
172	          for (const txDoc of txSnap.docs) {
173	            const txData = txDoc.data();
174	            if (txData.accountId) affectedAccountIds.add(txData.accountId);
175	
176	            const targetAcc = txData.type === 'Debit' ? newDebitAcc : newCreditAcc;
177	            const targetAccId = targetAcc ? targetAcc.id : txData.accountId;
178	            if (targetAccId) affectedAccountIds.add(targetAccId);
179	
180	            const targetCurrency = targetAcc?.currency || txData.currency || 'YER';
181	
182	            const legNewAmount = financialAccountService.convertToTargetCurrency(
183	              rawAmt,
184	              editJournalData.currencyOriginal,
185	              targetCurrency,
186	              exchangeRates
187	            );
188	
189	            const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
190	              amount: legNewAmount,
191	              amountOriginal: rawAmt,
192	              currencyOriginal: editJournalData.currencyOriginal,
193	              description: editJournalData.notes,
194	              createdAt: parsedCreatedAt,
195	              updatedAt: Date.now()
196	            };
197	
198	            if (targetAcc) {
199	              updateData.accountId = targetAcc.id;
200	              updateData.accountCode = targetAcc.accountCode;
201	              updateData.entityName = targetAcc.entityName;
202	              updateData.entityId = targetAcc.entityId;
203	              updateData.entityType = targetAcc.entityType;
204	              updateData.currency = targetAcc.currency;
205	            }
206	
207	            batch.update(txDoc.ref, updateData);
208	
209	          }
210	        }
211	
212	        // Update master entry doc in main_entry if exists
213	        if (selectedEditEntry.mainEntryId) {
214	          const jvRef = doc(db, 'main_entry', selectedEditEntry.mainEntryId);
215	          batch.update(jvRef, {
216	            amount: rawAmt,
217	            currency: editJournalData.currencyOriginal,
218	            description: editJournalData.notes,
219	            debitAccountId: editJournalData.debitAccountId || selectedEditEntry.debitAccountId,
220	            creditAccountId: editJournalData.creditAccountId || selectedEditEntry.creditAccountId,
221	            createdAt: parsedCreatedAt,
222	            updatedAt: Date.now()
223	          });
224	        }
225	      }
226	
227	      await batch.commit();
228	
229	      // Recalculate & sync balances for all affected accounts
230	      affectedAccountIds.forEach(accId => {
231	        if (accId) {
232	          financialAccountService.recalculateAndSyncBalance(accId).catch(console.error);
233	        }
234	      });
235	
236	      notificationService.notify({
237	        title: isAr ? 'تم الحفظ' : 'Saved',
238	        message: isAr ? 'تم تعديل القيد المالي وتحديث كافة الأرصدة المرتبطة.' : 'Financial entry updated and all associated balances recalculated.',
239	        type: 'success'
240	      });
241	
242	      setIsEditJournalOpen(false);
243	      setSelectedEditEntry(null);
244	    } catch (err: unknown) {
245	      console.error(err);
246	      notificationService.notify({
247	        title: isAr ? 'خطأ' : 'Error',
248	        message: errorMessage(err, 'Could not update entry'),
249	        type: 'error'
250	      });
251	    } finally {
252	      setEditJournalLoading(false);
253	    }
254	  };

256	// Handle Delete Entry with User PIN confirmation
257	  const handleDeleteJournalSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
258	    e.preventDefault();
259	    if (!entryToDelete) return;
260	    setDeletePinError('');
261	
262	    const trimmedPin = deletePin.trim();
263	    if (!trimmedPin) {
264	      setDeletePinError(isAr ? 'يرجى إدخال رمز PIN' : 'Please enter PIN code');
265	      return;
266	    }
267	
268	    // Check PIN against employee systemPins or master fallback PINs ('1234', '0000')
269	    const isValidPin = employees.some((emp: EmployeeRecord) => emp.systemPin && emp.systemPin.trim() === trimmedPin) ||
270	      trimmedPin === '1234' || trimmedPin === '0000';
271	
272	    if (!isValidPin) {
273	      setDeletePinError(isAr ? 'رمز PIN غير صحيح. يرجى التثبت من الرمز وتكرار المحاولة.' : 'Invalid PIN code. Access denied.');
274	      return;
275	    }
276	
277	    setDeleteLoading(true);
278	    try {
279	      const affectedAccountIds = new Set<string>();
280	      if (entryToDelete.debitAccountId) affectedAccountIds.add(entryToDelete.debitAccountId);
281	      if (entryToDelete.creditAccountId) affectedAccountIds.add(entryToDelete.creditAccountId);
282	
283	      const batch = writeBatch(db);
284	
285	      // Find all transaction legs related to this voucher
286	      if (entryToDelete.allLegs && entryToDelete.allLegs.length > 0) {
287	        entryToDelete.allLegs.forEach((leg: { id?: string; accountId?: string }) => {
288	          if (leg.id) {
289	            batch.delete(doc(db, 'account_trans', leg.id));
290	          }
291	          if (leg.accountId) affectedAccountIds.add(leg.accountId);
292	        });
293	      } else if (entryToDelete.id && !entryToDelete.id.startsWith('EXP-UNLINKED-')) {
294	        const refNum = entryToDelete.refNumber;
295	        const qTx = refNum
296	          ? query(collection(db, 'account_trans'), where('ref_number', '==', refNum))
297	          : query(collection(db, 'account_trans'), where('__name__', '==', entryToDelete.id));
298	        const snap = await getDocs(qTx);
299	        snap.docs.forEach((d: QueryDocumentLike) => {
300	          batch.delete(d.ref);
301	          const data = d.data();
302	          if (data.accountId) affectedAccountIds.add(data.accountId);
303	        });
304	      }
305	
306	      // Delete master entry document from main_entry if present
307	      if (entryToDelete.mainEntryId) {
308	        batch.delete(doc(db, 'main_entry', entryToDelete.mainEntryId));
309	      }
310	
311	      await batch.commit();
312	
313	      // Recalculate & sync balances for all affected accounts in background
314	      affectedAccountIds.forEach(accId => {
315	        if (accId) {
316	          financialAccountService.recalculateAndSyncBalance(accId).catch(console.error);
317	        }
318	      });
319	
320	      notificationService.notify({
321	        title: isAr ? 'تم الحذف' : 'Deleted',
322	        message: isAr ? 'تم حذف القيد المالي نهائياً وإلغاء كافة تأثيراته الحسابية.' : 'Financial entry permanently deleted and all ledger balances synced.',
323	        type: 'success'
324	      });
325	
326	      setIsDeletePinModalOpen(false);
327	      setEntryToDelete(null);
328	      setDeletePin('');
329	    } catch (err: unknown) {
330	      console.error("Error deleting entry:", err);
331	      setDeletePinError(errorMessage(err, 'Failed to delete entry'));
332	    } finally {
333	      setDeleteLoading(false);
334	    }
335	  };

337	// Handle addition of quick accounting adjustment voucher
338	  const handleAddAdjustment = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
339	    e.preventDefault();
340	    if (adjustLoading) return;
341	    if (!adjustData.amount || parseFloat(adjustData.amount) <= 0 || (!adjustData.title && !isSalaryPayment)) {
342	      notificationService.notify({
343	        title: isAr ? 'خطأ بالبيانات' : 'Invalid Entry',
344	        message: isAr ? 'يرجى ملء تفاصيل القيد والمبلغ المالي الصحيح.' : 'Provide precise title and positive currency amount.',
345	        type: 'error'
346	      });
347	      return;
348	    }
349	
350	    if (!sourceAccountId || !targetAccountId) {
351	      notificationService.notify({
352	        title: isAr ? 'الحسابات غير محددة' : 'Accounts Required',
353	        message: isAr ? 'يجب تحديد الحساب المصدر (الدائن) والحساب المستهدف (المدين) لإجراء القيد المزدوج.' : 'Please select both source and target accounts to complete the transaction.',
354	        type: 'error'
355	      });
356	      return;
357	    }
358	
359	    if (sourceAccountId === targetAccountId) {
360	      notificationService.notify({
361	        title: isAr ? 'تطابق الحسابات' : 'Identical Accounts',
362	        message: isAr ? 'لا يمكن أن يكون الحساب المصدر والحساب المستهدف متطابقين.' : 'Source and target accounts cannot be the same.',
363	        type: 'error'
364	      });
365	      return;
366	    }
367	
368	    setAdjustLoading(true);
369	    try {
370	      const amountVal = parseFloat(adjustData.amount);
371	      const convertedAmt = financialAccountService.convertToDefaultCurrency(
372	        amountVal,
373	        adjustData.currency,
374	        settings.currency || 'YER',
375	        dbRates
376	      );
377	
378	      const timestamp = Date.now();
379	      const randStr = Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000);
380	
381	      const srcAccount = postingFinancialAccounts.find((a: PostingAccount) => a.id === sourceAccountId || a.entityId === sourceAccountId);
382	      const trgAccount = postingFinancialAccounts.find((a: PostingAccount) => a.id === targetAccountId || a.entityId === targetAccountId);
383	
384	      if (!srcAccount || !trgAccount) {
385	        throw new Error(isAr ? 'أحد الحسابات المحددة غير موجود في الدفاتر.' : 'Selected accounts not found.');
386	      }
387	
388	      const voucherCode = `ADJ-${new Date().getFullYear().toString().slice(-2)}-${randStr}`;
389	
390	      // 1. If it is a Salary Payment, invoke the atomic recordSalaryPayment service
391	      if (isSalaryPayment && targetType === 'employee') {
392	        if (!adjustSalaryMonth) {
393	          notificationService.notify({
394	            title: isAr ? 'الشهر غير محدد' : 'Month Required',
395	            message: isAr ? 'يرجى تحديد شهر صرف الراتب.' : 'Please select the salary month.',
396	            type: 'error'
397	          });
398	          setAdjustLoading(false);
399	          return;
400	        }
401	
402	        await financialAccountService.recordSalaryPayment({
403	          employeeId: trgAccount.entityId || '',
404	          employeeName: trgAccount.entityName || '',
405	          accountId: targetAccountId,
406	          accountCode: trgAccount.accountCode || '',
407	          amount: convertedAmt,
408	          currency: adjustData.currency,
409	          salaryMonth: adjustSalaryMonth,
410	          notes: adjustData.notes || (isAr ? `صرف راتب شهر ${adjustSalaryMonth}` : `Salary payment for ${adjustSalaryMonth}`),
411	          createdByUid: currentUser?.id || 'system',
412	          createdByName: currentUser?.email?.split('@')[0] || 'Finance Auditor'
413	        });
414	      }
415	
416	      // 2. Perform double-entry transaction posting (Debit trgAccount, Credit srcAccount)
417	      await financialAccountService.recordDoubleEntryTransaction(
418	        targetAccountId,
419	        sourceAccountId,
420	        {
421	          accountId: targetAccountId,
422	          accountCode: trgAccount.accountCode || '',
423	          entityType: trgAccount.entityType || 'system',
424	          entityId: trgAccount.entityId || '',
425	          entityName: trgAccount.entityName || '',
426	          amount: convertedAmt,
427	          amountOriginal: amountVal,
428	          currencyOriginal: adjustData.currency,
429	          description: adjustData.title || (isAr ? `قيد تسوية مزدوج: ${voucherCode}` : `Double-entry adjustment: ${voucherCode}`),
430	          refNumber: voucherCode,
431	          module: 'adjustment',
432	          createdAt: timestamp,
433	          createdByUid: currentUser?.id || 'system',
434	          createdByName: currentUser?.email?.split('@')[0] || 'Finance Auditor'
435	        }
436	      );
437	
438	      notificationService.notify({
439	        title: isAr ? 'تم تقييد القيد بنجاح' : 'Adjustment Logged',
440	        message: isAr ? 'تم حفظ القيد المزدوج ترحيله إلى اليومية المساعدة بنجاح.' : 'Double-entry journal voucher registered successfully.',
441	        type: 'success'
442	      });
443	
444	      setIsAdjustmentModalOpen(false);
445	      setAdjustData({
446	        type: 'Debit',
447	        amount: '',
448	        currency: 'YER',
449	        title: '',
450	        recipientName: '',
451	        notes: ''
452	      });
453	      setTargetType('general');
454	      setSourceAccountId('');
455	      setTargetAccountId('');
456	      setIsSalaryPayment(false);
457	    } catch (err: unknown) {
458	      console.error(err);
459	      notificationService.notify({
460	        title: 'Error write-back',
461	        message: errorMessage(err, 'Failed to persist manual voucher entry.'),
462	        type: 'error'
463	      });
464	    } finally {

466	    }
467	  };

469	// FIFO Payment settlement for selected Customer outstanding debt
470	  const handleCustomerFIFOPayment = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
471	    e.preventDefault();
472	    if (payLoading) return;
473	    const amountVal = parseFloat(payAmount);
474	    if (!customerLedgerDetails || isNaN(amountVal) || amountVal <= 0) {
475	      notificationService.notify({
476	        title: isAr ? 'مبلغ غير صالح' : 'Invalid Balance',
477	        message: isAr ? 'الرجاء إدخال مبلغ دفع إيجابي لتسويته.' : 'Please type a valid currency number.',
478	        type: 'error'
479	      });
480	      return;
481	    }
482	
483	    setPayLoading(true);
484	    try {
485	      // Find customer orders with remaining debt
486	      const unpaidOrders = orders
487	        .filter((o: CustomerOrderRecord) => o.customerId === auditedCustomerId && parseFloat(String(o.amountRemaining || 0)) > 0)
488	        .sort((a: CustomerOrderRecord, b: CustomerOrderRecord) => {
489	          return getOrderTimestamp(a.createdAt) - getOrderTimestamp(b.createdAt);
490	        });
491	
492	      if (unpaidOrders.length === 0) {
493	        notificationService.notify({
494	          title: isAr ? 'الحساب خالص' : 'No Debts Outstanding',
495	          message: isAr ? 'لا توجد مديونيات معلقة مسجلة على هذا العميل.' : 'This customer already holds a 0 YER outstanding balance.',
496	          type: 'warning'
497	        });
498	        setIsPayModalOpen(false);
499	        return;
500	      }
501	
502	      let remainingPayment = amountVal;
503	      const batch = writeBatch(db);
504	
505	      // Settle unpaid chronological invoices using chronological FIFO queue
506	      for (const ord of unpaidOrders) {
507	        if (remainingPayment <= 0) break;
508	
509	        const ordRemaining = parseFloat(String(ord.amountRemaining || 0));
510	        const ordPaid = parseFloat(String(ord.amountPaid || 0));
511	        const ordRef = doc(db, 'orders', ord.id);
512	
513	        if (remainingPayment >= ordRemaining) {
514	          // Paying off this specific invoice fully
515	          batch.update(ordRef, {
516	            amountPaid: ordPaid + ordRemaining,
517	            amountRemaining: 0,
518	            paymentStatus: isAr ? 'خالص' : 'Fully Paid'
519	          });
520	          remainingPayment -= ordRemaining;
521	        } else {
522	          // Partial payment applied to this invoice
523	          batch.update(ordRef, {
524	            amountPaid: ordPaid + remainingPayment,
525	            amountRemaining: ordRemaining - remainingPayment,
526	            paymentStatus: isAr ? 'دفع جزئي' : 'Partially Paid'
527	          });
528	          remainingPayment = 0;
529	        }
530	      }
531	
532	      // --- Register Credit in Customer's Financial Account ---
533	      const customerRecord = customerLedgerDetails.customer;
534	      const linkedAccountId = customerRecord.accountId;
535	      const linkedAccountCode = customerRecord.accountCode;
536	
537	      // Record cash inflow directly as a new-model payment voucher.
538	      const randStr = Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000);
539	      const voucherNum = `RCV-${randStr}`;
540	
541	      if (linkedAccountId) {
542	        const convertedPaid = financialAccountService.convertToDefaultCurrency(
543	          amountVal,
544	          'YER',
545	          settings.currency || 'YER',
546	          dbRates
547	        );
548	
549	        const systemAccs = await financialAccountService.ensureSystemAccounts('YER');
550	
551	        await financialAccountService.recordTransaction({
552	          date: Date.now(),
553	          description: isAr
554	            ? `دفعة نقدية مستلمة على الحساب كشف حساب: ${payNotes || ''}`
555	            : `Cash payment received on account statement: ${payNotes || ''}`,
556	          module: 'payment',
557	          refNumber: voucherNum,
558	          amount: convertedPaid,
559	          currency: 'YER',
560	          debitAccount: { id: systemAccs['sys_cash_account'], code: '1111-0' },
561	          creditAccount: { id: linkedAccountId, code: linkedAccountCode || '1130' },
562	          createdByUid: currentUser?.id || 'system',
563	          createdByName: 'Finance Auditor'
564	        });
565	      }
566	
567	      await batch.commit();
568	
569	      notificationService.notify({
570	        title: isAr ? 'تم استلام وتوريد المبلغ' : 'Payment Deposited',
571	        message: isAr
572	          ? `تم استلام وتحصيل ${amountVal.toLocaleString()} YER وتطبيقها على أقدم الفواتير المستحقة.`
573	          : `FIFO accounting applied: Applied ${amountVal.toLocaleString()} YER to chronological outstanding invoices.`,

61	async function fetchRows<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
62	  collectionName: string
63	): Promise<T[]> {
64	  const path = apiCollectionPaths[collectionName];
65	  if (!path)

72	    ? response.data
73	    : (response.data.items ?? []);
74	  return normalizeRows(collectionName, rows) as T[];

61	const errorMessage = (error: unknown, fallback: string): string =>
62	  error instanceof Error && error.message ? error.message : fallback;
63	
64	export function createFinanceAccountingCourierActions(dependencies: ActionDependencies) {
65	  const { courierAuditSheet, currentUser, db, dbRates, doc, financialAccountService, isAr, notificationService, setBulkReconciliationLoading, setCargoRemitLoading, settings, updateDoc, writeBatch } = dependencies;
66	
67	// Full reconciliation and balance clearance for courier
68	  const handleFullCourierReconciliation = async () => {
69	    if (!courierAuditSheet) return;
70	    const cour = courierAuditSheet.courier;
71	    const currentBalance = cour.financialBalance || 0;
72	
73	    if (!window.confirm(isAr
74	      ? `تحذير: هل أنت متأكد من تصفية ذمة المندوب (${cour.fullName}) بالكامل؟
75	سيقوم هذا الإجراء بـ:
76	1. تصفير رصيد الحساب المالي الحالي (${currentBalance.toLocaleString()} YER) بقيد محاسبي تعويضي.
77	2. تصفية كافة العهد المالية المعلقة.
78	3. توريد وتصفير كافة تحصيلات الطرود النقدية المعلقة (${courierAuditSheet.totalUnremittedCashValue.toLocaleString()} YER).
79	هل تريد الاستمرار؟`
80	      : `Warning: Confirm full audit reconciliation for ${cour.fullName}?
81	This will:
82	1. Zero out the financial account balance (${currentBalance.toLocaleString()} YER) with an offsetting main entry.
83	2. Reconcile all outstanding open custodies.
84	3. Settle and remit all unremitted COD cargo collections (${courierAuditSheet.totalUnremittedCashValue.toLocaleString()} YER).
85	Continue?`
86	    )) return;
87	
88	    setBulkReconciliationLoading(true);
89	    try {
90	      const batch = writeBatch(db);
91	      const timestamp = Date.now();
92	      const randStr = Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000);
93	      const mainVoucherCode = `AUDIT-${randStr}`;
94	
95	      const systemAccs = await financialAccountService.ensureSystemAccounts('YER');
96	
97	      // 1. Reconcile current financial balance if not zero
98	      if (currentBalance !== 0) {
99	        const linkedAccountId = cour.accountId;
100	        const linkedAccountCode = cour.accountCode;
101	
102	        if (linkedAccountId) {
103	          const type = currentBalance > 0 ? 'Credit' : 'Debit'; // Credit to reduce balance, Debit to increase it
104	          const amount = Math.abs(currentBalance);
105	
106	          await financialAccountService.recordTransaction({
107	            date: timestamp,
108	            description: isAr
109	              ? `قيد تسوية لمطابقة وتصفير الحساب المالي للمندوب — قيد إقفال`
110	              : `Offsetting adjustment to zero out courier account balance`,
111	            module: 'adjustment',
112	            refNumber: mainVoucherCode,
113	            amount,
114	            currency: 'YER',
115	            debitAccount: type === 'Debit'
116	              ? { id: linkedAccountId, code: linkedAccountCode || '2120' }
117	              : { id: systemAccs['sys_cash_account'], code: '1111-0' },
118	            creditAccount: type === 'Credit'
119	              ? { id: linkedAccountId, code: linkedAccountCode || '2120' }
120	              : { id: systemAccs['sys_cash_account'], code: '1111-0' },
121	            createdByUid: currentUser?.id || 'system',
122	            createdByName: 'Finance Auditor'
123	          });
124	        }
125	      }
126	
127	      // 2. Settle all pending open custodies
128	      const pendingCustodies = courierAuditSheet.custodies.filter((c: CustodyRecord) => c.status === 'Pending');
129	      for (const exp of pendingCustodies) {
130	        const docRef = doc(db, 'custody_advances', exp.id);
131	        batch.update(docRef, {
132	          status: 'settled',
133	          settledAt: new Date(timestamp).toISOString(),
134	          settledByUid: currentUser?.id || 'system',
135	          amountSettled: exp.amountOriginal ?? exp.amount ?? 0,
136	          amountOutstanding: 0,
137	        });
138	
139	        if (exp.recipientAccountId) {
140	          const settledAmount = financialAccountService.convertToDefaultCurrency(
141	            parseFloat(String(exp.amount || 0)),
142	            exp.currency || 'YER',
143	            settings.currency || 'SAR',
144	            dbRates
145	          );
146	          await financialAccountService.recordTransaction({
147	            date: timestamp,
148	            description: isAr ? `تسوية عهدة تلقائية: ${exp.expenseNumber}` : `Auto custody settlement: ${exp.expenseNumber}`,
149	            module: 'custody',
150	            refNumber: `${String(exp.expenseNumber ?? exp.id ?? 'custody')}-SET`,
151	            amount: settledAmount,
152	            currency: 'YER',
153	            debitAccount: { id: String(exp.recipientAccountId), code: '2120' },
154	            creditAccount: { id: systemAccs['sys_cash_account'], code: '1111-0' },
155	            createdByUid: currentUser?.id || 'system',
156	            createdByName: 'Finance Auditor'
157	          });
158	        }
159	      }
160	
161	      // 3. Remit all unremitted COD cargo cash
162	      courierAuditSheet.currentUnremittedCargoCash.forEach((ord: CourierOrderRecord) => {
163	        const orderRef = doc(db, 'orders', ord.id);
164	        const prevPaid = parseFloat(String(ord.amountPaid || 0));
165	        const rem = parseFloat(String(ord.amountRemaining || 0));
166	
167	        batch.update(orderRef, {
168	          amountPaid: prevPaid + rem,
169	          amountRemaining: 0,
170	          paymentStatus: isAr ? 'خالص' : 'Fully Paid',
171	          courierRemittedAt: timestamp
172	        });
173	      });
174	
175	      await batch.commit();
176	
177	      notificationService.notify({
178	        title: isAr ? 'نجاح مطابقة الذمة بالكامل' : 'Full Audit Reconciled',
179	        message: isAr
180	          ? `تم تصفير رصيد المندوب وتصفية كافة العهد وتحصيلات الشحنات بنجاح!`
181	          : `Audit successful: All custodies, cargo collections, and balances resolved to 0 YER for ${cour.fullName}.`,
182	        type: 'success'
183	      });
184	    } catch (err: unknown) {
185	      console.error(err);
186	      notificationService.notify({
187	        title: 'Audit transaction failed',
188	        message: errorMessage(err, 'Error executing full courier reconciliation.'),
189	        type: 'error'
190	      });
191	    } finally {
192	      setBulkReconciliationLoading(false);
193	    }
194	  };
195	
196	  const handleBulkRemitCourierCash = async () => {
197	    if (!courierAuditSheet || courierAuditSheet.currentUnremittedCargoCash.length === 0) return;
198	
199	    const isSourcing = courierAuditSheet.courier.courierType === 'sourcing';
200	    const currency = isSourcing ? 'SAR' : 'YER';
201	    const amountLabel = isSourcing
202	      ? `${courierAuditSheet.totalUnremittedCashValue.toLocaleString()} SAR`
203	      : `${courierAuditSheet.totalUnremittedCashValue.toLocaleString()} YER`;
204	
205	    if (!window.confirm(isAr
206	      ? `هل تريد تصفية كافة مستحقات الشحن المحصلة بذمة المندوب (${amountLabel}) وتوريدها للخزينة؟`
207	      : `Confirm remittance of ${amountLabel} held by ${courierAuditSheet.courier.fullName}?`
208	    )) return;
209	
210	    setCargoRemitLoading(true);
211	    try {
212	      const batch = writeBatch(db);
213	
214	      // Update each unremitted cargo invoice
215	      courierAuditSheet.currentUnremittedCargoCash.forEach((ord: CourierOrderRecord) => {
216	        const orderRef = doc(db, 'orders', ord.id);
217	        const prevPaid = parseFloat(String(ord.amountPaid || 0));
218	        const rem = parseFloat(String(ord.amountRemaining || 0));
219	
220	        batch.update(orderRef, {
221	          amountPaid: prevPaid + rem,
222	          amountRemaining: 0,
223	          paymentStatus: isAr ? 'خ خالص' : 'Fully Paid',
224	          courierRemittedAt: Date.now()
225	        });
226	      });
227	
228	      // Register the remittance as a proper double-entry voucher.
229	      const randStr = Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000);
230	      const voucherCode = `REMIT-${randStr}`;
231	      const courierAccountId = courierAuditSheet.courier.accountId;
232	      if (courierAccountId) {
233	        const systemAccs = await financialAccountService.ensureSystemAccounts(currency);
234	        const amount = financialAccountService.convertToDefaultCurrency(
235	          courierAuditSheet.totalUnremittedCashValue,
236	          currency,
237	          settings.currency || 'YER',
238	          dbRates,
239	        );
240	        await financialAccountService.recordTransaction({
241	          date: Date.now(),
242	          description: isAr
243	            ? `توريد تحصيلات شحنات المندوب ${courierAuditSheet.courier.fullName}`
244	            : `Courier cargo remittance: ${courierAuditSheet.courier.fullName}`,
245	          module: 'payment',
246	          refNumber: voucherCode,
247	          amount,
248	          currency: settings.currency || 'YER',
249	          debitAccount: { id: systemAccs['sys_cash_account'], code: '1111-0' },
250	          creditAccount: { id: courierAccountId, code: '2120' },
251	          createdByUid: currentUser?.id || 'system',
252	          createdByName: 'Finance Auditor',
253	        });
254	      }
255	      await batch.commit();
256	
257	      notificationService.notify({
258	        title: isAr ? 'تم توريد التحصيلات وتصفير الذمة' : 'Cargo Cash Remitted',
259	        message: isAr
260	          ? `تم تصفير ذمة المندوب وتوريد مبلغ ${amountLabel} للخزينة بنجاح!`
261	          : `Remittance logged: safely deposited ${amountLabel} from Courier collections.`,
262	        type: 'success'
263	      });
264	    } catch (err: unknown) {
265	      console.error(err);
266	      notificationService.notify({
267	        title: 'Fm transaction error',
268	        message: errorMessage(err, 'Remittance transaction failed.'),
269	        type: 'error'
270	      });
271	    } finally {
272	      setCargoRemitLoading(false);
273	    }
274	  };
275	
276	// Live Settle specific Custody record from the interactive sheet
277	  const handleDirectSettleCustody = async (custodyDocId: string, recipientName: string) => {
278	    if (!window.confirm(isAr
279	      ? `هل أنت متأكد من مراجعة وتصفية هذا السند العهدة؟`
280	      : `Are you sure you want to discharge and settle this custody entry?`
281	    )) return;
282	
283	    try {
284	      const docRef = doc(db, 'custody_advances', custodyDocId);
285	      await updateDoc(docRef, {
286	        status: 'settled',
287	        settledAt: new Date().toISOString(),
288	        settledByUid: currentUser?.id || 'system',
289	        amountOutstanding: 0,
290	      });
291	
292	      notificationService.notify({
293	        title: isAr ? 'تم تسوية وتصفير العهدة' : 'Custody Discharged',
294	        message: isAr
295	          ? `تم إبراء المندوب ${recipientName} من العهدة وتسجيل الإرجاع.`
296	          : `Disgorged open trust for courier ${recipientName}. Safebox recalculated.`,
297	        type: 'success'
298	      });
299	    } catch (err: unknown) {
300	      console.error(err);
301	      notificationService.notify({
302	        title: 'Writeback fault',
303	        message: errorMessage(err, 'Could not discharge custody row in PostgreSQL.'),
304	        type: 'error'
305	      });
306	    }
307	  };
308	
309	  return { handleFullCourierReconciliation, handleBulkRemitCourierCash, handleDirectSettleCustody };
310	}

-- API access for existing shared system settings, currencies, rates, and user UI preferences.
-- This migration intentionally does NOT create or move any table.

REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.settings, public.currency, public.cur_price, public.user_settings
  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON TABLE public.settings, public.currency, public.cur_price, public.user_settings
  TO alx_api_runtime;

ALTER TABLE public.settings ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.currency ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.cur_price ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.user_settings ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.settings FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.currency FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.cur_price FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.user_settings FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS api_runtime_settings_all ON public.settings;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS api_runtime_currency_all ON public.currency;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS api_runtime_cur_price_all ON public.cur_price;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS api_runtime_user_settings_all ON public.user_settings;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow all" ON public.user_settings;

CREATE POLICY api_runtime_settings_all ON public.settings
  FOR ALL TO alx_api_runtime USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY api_runtime_currency_all ON public.currency
  FOR ALL TO alx_api_runtime USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY api_runtime_cur_price_all ON public.cur_price
  FOR ALL TO alx_api_runtime USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY api_runtime_user_settings_all ON public.user_settings
  FOR ALL TO alx_api_runtime USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

706	  // Debounce map: prevents cascade recalculations within 2 seconds for same account
707	  private _recalcDebounce: Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>> = new Map();
708	  async recalculateAndSyncBalance(accountId: string): Promise<number> {
709	    try {
710	      const accountDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, "accounts", accountId));
711	      if (!accountDoc.exists()) {
712	        console.warn(`[recalculateAndSyncBalance] Account ${accountId} not found.`);
713	        return 0;
714	      }
715	      const { error } = await (supabase as any).rpc('recalculate_accounting_hierarchy', {
716	        p_account_id: accountId,
717	      });
718	      if (error) {
719	        throw new Error(error.message || String(error));
720	      }
721	      const refreshedAccount = await this.getAccountById(accountId);
722	      return Number(refreshedAccount?.balance || 0);
723	    } catch (error) {
724	      console.error("[recalculateAndSyncBalance] Error:", error);
725	      return 0;
726	    }
727	  }
728	
729	  /**
730	   * Debounced recalculateAndSyncBalance — safe to call many times quickly.
731	   * Only executes once per accountId within a 2-second window.
732	   */
733	  recalculateAndSyncBalanceDebounced(accountId: string, delayMs = 2000): void {
734	    if (this._recalcDebounce.has(accountId)) {
735	      clearTimeout(this._recalcDebounce.get(accountId)!);
736	    }
737	    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
738	      this._recalcDebounce.delete(accountId);
739	      this.recalculateAndSyncBalance(accountId).catch(console.error);
740	    }, delayMs);
741	    this._recalcDebounce.set(accountId, timer);
742	  }
743	
744	  /**
745	   * Recalculate and sync ALL accounts in the system.
746	   * Returns a summary of accounts processed and any errors encountered.
747	   * Useful for migration / reconciliation runs.
748	   */
749	  async recalculateAllBalances(): Promise<{
750	    processed: number;
751	    errors: number;
752	    results: Array<{ accountId: string; accountCode: string; oldBalance: number; newBalance: number }>;
753	  }> {
754	    const results: Array<{ accountId: string; accountCode: string; oldBalance: number; newBalance: number }> = [];
755	    let errors = 0;
756	
757	    try {
758	      const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, "accounts"));
759	      const docs = snap.docs;
760	
761	      // Process in parallel batches of 5 to avoid overwhelming the DB while still being fast
762	      const BATCH_SIZE = 5;
763	      for (let i = 0; i < docs.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
764	        const batch = docs.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
765	        await Promise.all(batch.map(async (d) => {
766	          const data = d.data() as FinancialAccount;
767	          const oldBalance = data.balance || 0;
768	          try {
769	            const newBalance = await this.recalculateAndSyncBalance(d.id);
770	            results.push({
771	              accountId: d.id,
772	              accountCode: data.accountCode || d.id,
773	              oldBalance,
774	              newBalance,
775	            });
776	          } catch (err) {
777	            errors++;
778	            console.error(`[recalculateAllBalances] Error on account ${d.id}:`, err);
779	          }
780	        }));
781	      }
782	    } catch (err) {
783	      console.error("[recalculateAllBalances] Fatal error loading accounts:", err);
784	    }
785	
786	    return { processed: results.length, errors, results };
787	  }

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.settle_custody_advance(p_custody_id text, p_entry jsonb, p_settled_by_uid text DEFAULT NULL)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
  custody_record public.custody_advances%ROWTYPE;
  v_amount numeric;
  v_entry_result jsonb;
  v_new_settled numeric;
  v_new_outstanding numeric;
  v_new_status text;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO custody_record FROM public.custody_advances WHERE id = p_custody_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'العهدة غير موجودة.'; END IF;
  IF custody_record.status IN ('settled', 'cancelled') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن تسوية عهدة مغلقة.'; END IF;
  IF COALESCE(p_entry->>'amountOriginal', '') !~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' OR (p_entry->>'amountOriginal')::numeric <= 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مبلغ قيد التسوية يجب أن يكون موجبًا.';
  END IF;
  v_amount := (p_entry->>'amountOriginal')::numeric;
  IF v_amount > custody_record.amount_outstanding THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'مبلغ التسوية يتجاوز المتبقي من العهدة.'; END IF;
  IF COALESCE(p_entry->>'currencyOriginalNo', '')::integer <> custody_record.currency_original_no THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'عملة قيد التسوية يجب أن تطابق عملة العهدة.';
  END IF;
  IF p_settled_by_uid IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users WHERE id = p_settled_by_uid) THEN p_settled_by_uid := NULL; END IF;

  v_entry_result := public.create_financial_entry_v2(jsonb_set(p_entry, '{custodyId}', to_jsonb(p_custody_id), true));
  v_new_settled := custody_record.amount_settled + v_amount;
  v_new_outstanding := custody_record.amount_original - v_new_settled;
  v_new_status := CASE WHEN v_new_outstanding = 0 THEN 'settled' ELSE 'partial' END;
  UPDATE public.custody_advances
  SET amount_settled = v_new_settled, amount_outstanding = v_new_outstanding, status = v_new_status,
      settlement_entry_id = v_entry_result->>'id', settled_at = CASE WHEN v_new_status = 'settled' THEN now() ELSE NULL END,
      settled_by_uid = CASE WHEN v_new_status = 'settled' THEN p_settled_by_uid ELSE NULL END,
      updated_by_uid = p_settled_by_uid
  WHERE id = p_custody_id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('id', p_custody_id, 'settlementEntryId', v_entry_result->>'id', 'status', v_new_status, 'amountOutstanding', v_new_outstanding);
END;
$$;

auth.uid()::text
  );
BEGIN
  -- التحقق من وجود القيد — Verify entry exists
  SELECT * INTO v_entry FROM public.main_entry WHERE id = p_entry_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'القيد المحدد غير موجود.';
  END IF;

  -- التحقق من أن القيد مرحّل بالفعل — Verify entry is currently posted
  IF v_entry.posting_status <> 'posted' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يمكن فقط إلغاء ترحيل القيود والسندات المرحّلة.';
  END IF;

  -- تجميع الحسابات المتأثرة بالقيد قبل إلغاء الترحيل
  -- Collect affected account IDs before unposting
  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT account_id) INTO v_affected_accounts
  FROM public.account_trans
  WHERE entry_id = p_entry_id;

  -- ضبط المتغير الجلسي للسماح للتريجر بإجراء التحويل posted -> draft
  -- Set session variable so the trigger allows posted -> draft transition
  -- true = local to current transaction (auto-reset on transaction end)
  PERFORM set_config('swiftship.allow_unpost', 'true', true);

  -- التحديث: تحويل الحالة إلى مسودة وتصفير بيانات الترحيل
  -- Update: revert to draft and clear posting metadata
  UPDATE public.main_entry
  SET posting_status = 'draft',
      posted_at      = NULL,
      posted_by_uid  = NULL,
      updated_at     = now(),
      updated_by_uid = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(v_actor_id), ''), updated_by_uid)
  WHERE id = p_entry_id;

  -- إعادة تعيين المتغير الجلسي للأمان — Reset session variable for safety
  PERFORM set_config('swiftship.allow_unpost', 'false', true);

  -- إعادة احتساب أرصدة شجرة الحسابات المتأثرة تلقائياً
  -- Recalculate accounting hierarchy balances for affected accounts
  IF v_affected_accounts IS NOT NULL AND ARRAY_LENGTH(v_affected_accounts, 1) > 0 THEN
    PERFORM public.recalculate_accounting_hierarchy(v_affected_accounts);
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'id',           p_entry_id,
    'postingStatus','draft',
    'unposted',     true
  );
END;
$$;

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

export interface AutoVoucherRule {
  id: string;
  actionCode?: string;
  nameAr: string;
  nameEn: string;
  descriptionTempAr: string;
  descriptionTempEn: string;
  debitAccount: any;
  creditAccount: any;
  isActive: boolean;
  autoPost?: boolean;
  requiredEntities?: string[];
}

export function useAutoVoucherRules() {
  const [rules, setRules] = useState<AutoVoucherRule[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setRules([]);
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  return { rules, loading };
}

export type ApiCoverageStatus = 'available' | 'partial' | 'missing';
export type ApiOperation = 'read' | 'write' | 'realtime';

export interface ApiDomainContract {
  domain: string;
  status: ApiCoverageStatus;
  operations: readonly ApiOperation[];
  apiOwner: string;
  cutoverPhase: number;
  notes: string;
}

/**
 * Phase 0 baseline. This is intentionally declarative; it does not select a
 * data source or perform a fallback. Each domain must move to `available`
 * before API-only mode is enabled for that domain.
 */
export const API_CONTRACT_MATRIX: readonly ApiDomainContract[] = [
  { domain: 'auth', status: 'available', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/auth', cutoverPhase: 2, notes: 'Session and token contract exists.' },
  { domain: 'accounting', status: 'partial', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/finance', cutoverPhase: 5, notes: 'Accounting UI still contains direct legacy services.' },
  { domain: 'browser', status: 'missing', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/cross-cutting', cutoverPhase: 6, notes: 'Browser viewer data sources are still legacy-backed.' },
  { domain: 'financeEntries', status: 'partial', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/finance', cutoverPhase: 5, notes: 'Finance entry API exists; legacy services and fallback remain.' },
  { domain: 'orders', status: 'partial', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/operations', cutoverPhase: 4, notes: 'Core order routes exist; legacy consumers remain.' },
  { domain: 'shipments', status: 'partial', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/operations', cutoverPhase: 4, notes: 'Core shipment routes exist; UI still has legacy consumers.' },
  { domain: 'products', status: 'partial', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/operations', cutoverPhase: 4, notes: 'Core product routes exist; returns/categories are separate gaps.' },
  { domain: 'customers', status: 'partial', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/customers', cutoverPhase: 4, notes: 'HTTP gateway exists; legacy page paths remain.' },
  { domain: 'couriers', status: 'partial', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/operations/reporting', cutoverPhase: 4, notes: 'CRUD and reporting routes exist; legacy reads remain.' },
  { domain: 'employees', status: 'partial', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/operations/reporting', cutoverPhase: 4, notes: 'CRUD and reporting routes exist; legacy reads remain.' },
  { domain: 'users', status: 'partial', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/users', cutoverPhase: 6, notes: 'HTTP routes exist; session and page fallbacks remain.' },
  { domain: 'roles', status: 'partial', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/roles', cutoverPhase: 6, notes: 'HTTP routes exist; page fallback remains.' },
  { domain: 'finance', status: 'partial', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/finance', cutoverPhase: 5, notes: 'Gateway exists; finance fallback and services remain.' },
  { domain: 'reports', status: 'partial', operations: ['read'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/reporting', cutoverPhase: 5, notes: 'Reporting routes exist; dashboard/report legacy consumers remain.' },
  { domain: 'notifications', status: 'partial', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/notifications', cutoverPhase: 6, notes: 'Routes exist; notification page/service still uses legacy.' },
  { domain: 'settings', status: 'missing', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/settings', cutoverPhase: 1, notes: 'Required for system name, logo, general and logistics settings.' },
  { domain: 'currencies', status: 'missing', operations: ['read', 'write', 'realtime'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/currencies', cutoverPhase: 1, notes: 'Required for currency catalog, prices and exchange rates.' },
  { domain: 'siteManagement', status: 'partial', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/portal', cutoverPhase: 6, notes: 'Announcements and website settings are not fully covered.' },
  { domain: 'sources', status: 'partial', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/operations/reporting', cutoverPhase: 4, notes: 'Reporting exists; CRUD consumers remain.' },
  { domain: 'returns', status: 'missing', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/operations', cutoverPhase: 4, notes: 'Returned products still use legacy storage.' },
  { domain: 'statuses-options-categories', status: 'missing', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/modules/operations', cutoverPhase: 4, notes: 'Order statuses/options/item categories need explicit contracts.' },
  { domain: 'activity-sessions-search', status: 'missing', operations: ['read', 'write'], apiOwner: 'alx_api/cross-cutting', cutoverPhase: 6, notes: 'Cross-cutting APIs are required before deleting legacy listeners.' },
] as const;

export function getApiDomainContract(domain: string): ApiDomainContract | undefined {
  return API_CONTRACT_MATRIX.find((contract) => contract.domain === domain);
}

import type { OrderStatusItem } from '../hooks/useOrderStatuses';
import type { OrderHistoryEvent } from './orderHistoryService';

export type StatusTransitionPlan = {
  allowed: boolean;
  reason?: 'same_status' | 'backward_transition' | 'status_previously_processed' | 'unknown_status';
  stagesToProcess: OrderStatusItem[];
  skippedStages: OrderStatusItem[];
};

function statusIdFromEvent(event: OrderHistoryEvent): number | null {
  if (event.eventType !== 'order.status_changed' && event.eventType !== 'order.created') return null;
  const after = event.afterData ?? {};
  const raw = after.order_status_id ?? after.orderStatusId ?? after.orderStatus;
  const id = Number(raw);
  return Number.isInteger(id) && id > 0 ? id : null;
}

export function getProcessedStatusIds(events: OrderHistoryEvent[]): Set<number> {
  return new Set(events.map(statusIdFromEvent).filter((id): id is number => id !== null));
}

export function planOrderStatusTransition(
  statuses: OrderStatusItem[],
  currentStatusId: number,
  targetStatusId: number,
  processedStatusIds: Set<number>,
): StatusTransitionPlan {
  const ordered = [...statuses]
    .filter((status) => status.code !== 'cancelled')
    .sort((left, right) => (left.sortOrder ?? left.id) - (right.sortOrder ?? right.id));
  const target = statuses.find((status) => status.id === targetStatusId);
  const currentIndex = ordered.findIndex((status) => status.id === currentStatusId);
  const targetIndex = ordered.findIndex((status) => status.id === targetStatusId);

  if (!target || currentIndex < 0 || (target.code !== 'cancelled' && targetIndex < 0)) {
    return { allowed: false, reason: 'unknown_status', stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
  }

  if (target.code === 'cancelled') {
    return { allowed: true, stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
  }
  if (targetStatusId === currentStatusId) {
    return { allowed: false, reason: 'same_status', stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
  }
  if (targetIndex < currentIndex) {
    return { allowed: false, reason: 'backward_transition', stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
  }
  if (processedStatusIds.has(targetStatusId)) {
    return { allowed: false, reason: 'status_previously_processed', stagesToProcess: [], skippedStages: [] };
  }

  const stagesToProcess = ordered.slice(currentIndex + 1, targetIndex + 1);
  return {
    allowed: true,
    stagesToProcess,
    skippedStages: stagesToProcess.slice(0, -1),
  };
}

21	function makeApiCollection<T extends ApiRow>(config: ApiCollectionConfig): OrdersCollectionRepository<T> {
22	  const list = async (): Promise<readonly T[]> => {
23	    const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<T[] | { items?: T[] }>>(config.readPath, { limit: 100, offset: 0 });
24	    return extractRows(response.data).map((row) => normalize(row, config.idKey) as T);
25	  };

27	  return {
28	    subscribe(onData: (snapshot: { records: readonly T[] }) => void, onError?: (error: unknown) => void) {
29	      let disposed = false;
30	      const refresh = async () => {
31	        try { const records = await list(); if (!disposed) onData({ records }); }
32	        catch (error) { if (!disposed) onError?.(error); }
33	      };
34	      void refresh();
35	      const timer = setInterval(() => void refresh(), 30_000);
36	      return () => { disposed = true; clearInterval(timer); };
37	    },
38	    list,
39	    async get(id) {
40	      const response = await client.get<ApiEnvelope<T>>(`${config.readPath}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
41	      return normalize(response.data, config.idKey) as T;

43	    async create(id, payload) {
44	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`create:${config.readPath}`);
45	      const response = await client.post<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(config.writePath, { ...payload, [config.idKey]: id });
46	      return { id: String(response.data[config.idKey] ?? response.data.id ?? id) };
47	    },
48	    async set(id, payload) {
49	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`set:${config.readPath}`);
50	      await client.patch<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(pathFor(id), payload);
51	    },
52	    async update(id, payload) {
53	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`update:${config.readPath}`);
54	      await client.patch<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(pathFor(id), payload);
55	    },

57	      if (!config.writePath) return unsupported(`delete:${config.readPath}`);
58	      await client.delete<ApiEnvelope<ApiRow>>(pathFor(id));

  private readonly fetchImpl: typeof fetch;

  }

    const url = new URL(path, this.options.baseUrl);
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(query ?? {})) {

    }

        () => controller.abort(),
        this.options.timeoutMs ?? 10000
      );

            ...(accessToken ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` } : {}),

export enum OperationType {
  CREATE = 'create',
  UPDATE = 'update',
  DELETE = 'delete',
  LIST = 'list',
  GET = 'get',
  WRITE = 'write',
}

export function handleSupabaseError(error: unknown, operationType: OperationType, path: string | null) {
  console.error('[Supabase query/mutation error]:', error, operationType, path);

  const handleSearch = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const queryStr = trackingNumber.trim();
    if (!queryStr) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    setSuccessMsg('');
    setTrackingData(null);
    setResolvedSource(null);

    try {
      // 1. Ask backend API (which integrates third-party APIs + our local database)

      if (res.ok) {
        const contentType = res.headers.get("content-type");
        if (contentType && contentType.indexOf("application/json") !== -1) {
          const json = await res.json();
          if (json.success && json.tracking) {
            const t = json.tracking;
            let reconstructed: any = null;

            if (t.isLiveApi) {
              // Render live external API data
              reconstructed = {
                id: queryStr,
                trackingNumber: queryStr,
                orderNumber: 'N/A (External)',
                status: t.status || 'تم تسجيل الطلب',
                customerName: 'Verified Caller',
                customerPhone: '***',
                customerAddress: t.currentLocation || 'N/A',
                weight: 0,
                cbm: 0,
                shippingCompany: 'External Carrier',
                amountPaid: 0,
                amountRemaining: 0,
                totalCostYER: 0,
                currency: 'YER',
                products: [],
                history: t.history || [],
                currentCoordinates: t.currentCoordinates
              };
              setResolvedSource('public');
            } else {
              // Internal Order doc
              const docData = t.docData;
              reconstructed = {
                id: docData.id || queryStr,
                trackingNumber: docData.trackingNumber || docData.orderNumber,
                orderNumber: docData.orderNumber,
                status: t.status,
                customerName: docData.customerName,
                customerPhone: docData.customerPhone,
                customerAddress: docData.customerAddress || docData.destination || 'صنعاء، اليمن',
                weight: docData.totalWeight || 0,
                cbm: docData.totalCBM || 0,
                shippingCompany: docData.shippingCompany || '',
                amountPaid: docData.amountPaid || 0,
                amountRemaining: docData.amountRemaining || 0,
                totalCostYER: docData.totalCostYER || 0,
                currency: docData.currency || 'YER',
                products: docData.items || [],
                history: t.history || [],
                currentCoordinates: t.currentCoordinates
              };
              setResolvedSource('orders_db');
            }

            setTrackingData(reconstructed);
            setGpsLocation(t.currentLocation || 'مستودع الفرز والتبريد');
            setStatusSelector(t.status || 'تم تسجيل الطلب');
            return;

export function doc(...args: any[]) {
  // If first arg is a DocRef, return it
  if (args[0] instanceof DocRef) {
    return args[0];
  }
  // If first arg is a SupabaseQuery (CollectionRef), map it with its path and a secure auto-generated ID
  if (args[0] instanceof SupabaseQuery) {
    const id = args[1] || (Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11));
    return new DocRef(args[0].path, id);
  }
  // doc(db, 'id') or doc('table', 'id') or doc(db, 'table', 'id')
  if (args.length === 2 && typeof args[1] === 'string') {
    const parts = args[1].split('/');
    if (parts.length >= 2) {
      return new DocRef(parts[0], parts[1]);
    }
    return new DocRef(args[1], "");
  }
  if (args.length === 3 && typeof args[1] === 'string' && typeof args[2] === 'string') {
    return new DocRef(args[1], args[2]);
  }
  const mainPath = typeof args[1] === 'string' ? args[1] : (typeof args[0] === 'string' ? args[0] : 'unknown');
  const subId = typeof args[2] === 'string' ? args[2] : '';
  return new DocRef(mainPath, subId);
}

export function query(collectionRef: SupabaseQuery, ...constraints: any[]) {
  return new SupabaseQuery(collectionRef.path, [...collectionRef.constraints, ...constraints]);
}

export function where(field: string, op: string, value: any) {
  return { type: 'where', field, op, value };
}

export function orderBy(field: string, direction: 'asc' | 'desc' = 'asc') {
  return { type: 'orderBy', field, direction };
}

export function limit(value: number) {
  return { type: 'limit', value };
}

export function or(...conditions: any[]) {
  return { type: 'or', conditions };
}

export async function getDoc(docRef: DocRef) {
  const table = docRef.path;
  const id = docRef.id;
  const allItems = await ensureCache(table);
  const rawItem = allItems.find(i => i.id === id);
  const item = (table === 'orders' && rawItem) ? enrichOrderPayload(rawItem) : rawItem;

  return {
    id,
    exists: () => !!item,
    data: () => {
      if (!item) return undefined;
      const { id: _, ...rest } = item;
      return rest;
    }
  };
}

export async function setDoc(docRef: DocRef, rawData: any, options?: any) {
  const table = docRef.path;
  const pkCol = getTablePrimaryKey(table);
  const id = docRef.id;
  let rawClean = cleanData(rawData);

  if (options && options.merge) {
    const all = await ensureCache(table);
    const existing = all.find(item => item.id === id || item[pkCol] === id) || {};
    const { id: _, [pkCol]: __, ...existingData } = existing;
    rawClean = { ...existingData, ...rawClean };
  }
  const data = sanitizeDataPayload(table, rawClean);

  if (!isOfflineMode()) {
    const directCols = extractDirectColumns(table, rawClean);
    const writePayload = usesExplicitFinancialColumns(table) ? { [pkCol]: id, ...directCols } : { [pkCol]: id, ...directCols, data };
    const { error } = await supabase.from(table).upsert(writePayload);
    if (error) {
      const isRlsError = error?.code === '42501' || String(error?.message || '').toLowerCase().includes('row-level security');
      if (isRlsError) {
        console.warn(`[Supabase Adapter] RLS warning on ${table}: ${error?.message}. Local cache preserved.`);
      } else {
        throw createWriteError('upsert', table, error);
      }

import type { Express, NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import type { ApiEnvironment } from '../../config/env';
import { requirePermission } from '../../core/auth/require-permission';
import { sendFailure, sendSuccess } from '../../core/http/response';
import type { AuthUseCases } from '../auth/auth.contracts';
import { requireAuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.routes';
import type { OperationsRepository } from './operations.contracts';
import {
  createCourierSchema,
  createEmployeeSchema,
  createOrderInputSchema,
  deleteOrdersInputSchema,
  entityIdSchema,
  pageQuerySchema,
  productInputSchema,
  shipmentInputSchema,
  updateCourierSchema,
  updateEmployeeSchema,
  updateOrderStatusInputSchema,
  sourceInputSchema,
  shippingCompanyInputSchema,
} from './operations.schemas';

function requestId(response: Response): string {
  return String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');
}
function principalId(response: Response): string | undefined {
  return (response.locals.authPrincipal as { userId?: string } | undefined)?.userId;
}
function route(permission: string, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined) {
  return [requireAuthenticatedUser(auth), requirePermission(auth, permission)];
}
function handleWriteError(error: unknown, response: Response, next: NextFunction): void {
  if (error instanceof Error && error.message === 'ORDER_STATUS_REGRESSION') {
    sendFailure(response, 409, 'ORDER_STATUS_REGRESSION', 'لا يمكن إرجاع حالة الطلب إلى الخلف.', requestId(response));
    return;
  }
  next(error);
}

export function registerOperationsRoutes(
  app: Express,
  _environment: ApiEnvironment,
  auth: AuthUseCases | undefined,
  repository: OperationsRepository,
): void {
  const list =
    (
      load: (query: {
        limit: number;
        offset: number;
        search?: string | undefined;
        customerId?: string | undefined;
      }) => Promise<{ items: readonly Record<string, unknown>[]; total: number }>,
    ) =>
    async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
      const query = pageQuerySchema.safeParse(request.query);
      if (!query.success)
        return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_PAGE_QUERY', 'معاملات الصفحة غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
      try {
        const result = await load(query.data);
        return sendSuccess(response, result.items, requestId(response), { ...query.data, total: result.total });
      } catch (error) {
        return next(error);
      }
    };
  const single =
    (load: (key: string) => Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null>) =>
    async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
      const parsed = entityIdSchema.safeParse(request.params.id);
      if (!parsed.success)
        return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_ENTITY_ID', 'المعرف غير صالح.', requestId(response));
      try {
        const result = await load(parsed.data);
        return result
          ? sendSuccess(response, result, requestId(response))
          : sendFailure(response, 404, 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND', 'السجل غير موجود.', requestId(response));
      } catch (error) {
        return next(error);
      }
    };

app.post('/api/v1/orders', ...route('add_orders', auth), async (request, response, next) => {
    const parsed = createOrderInputSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
    const actorId = principalId(response);
    const key = request.get('Idempotency-Key')?.trim();
    if (!parsed.success || !actorId || !key || key.length > 200)
      return sendFailure(
        response,
        400,
        'INVALID_ORDER_INPUT',
        'بيانات الطلب أو مفتاح منع التكرار غير صالح.',
        requestId(response),
      );
    try {
      return sendSuccess(
        response,
        await repository.createOrder({ ...parsed.data, actorId, idempotencyKey: key }),
        requestId(response),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      return handleWriteError(error, response, next);
    }
  });
  app.patch('/api/v1/orders/:id/status', ...route('update_order_status', auth), async (request, response, next) => {
    const id = entityIdSchema.safeParse(request.params.id);
    const body = updateOrderStatusInputSchema.safeParse(request.body as unknown);
    const actorId = principalId(response);
    if (!id.success || !body.success || !actorId)
      return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_STATUS_INPUT', 'بيانات حالة الطلب غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
    try {
      const result = await repository.updateOrderStatus({ orderId: id.data, ...body.data, actorId });
      return 'notFound' in result
        ? sendFailure(response, 404, 'ENTITY_NOT_FOUND', 'الطلب غير موجود.', requestId(response))
        : sendSuccess(response, result, requestId(response));
    } catch (error) {
      return handleWriteError(error, response, next);
    }
  });

29	export function useOrderStatuses() {
30	  const [statuses, setStatuses] = useState<OrderStatusItem[]>(DEFAULT_ORDER_STATUSES);
31	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
32	
33	  useEffect(() => {
34	    // Order statuses are standard workflow stages provided by default.
35	    setStatuses(DEFAULT_ORDER_STATUSES);
36	    setLoading(false);
37	  }, []);
38	
39	  // Helper functions
40	  const getStatusById = (id: number | string | undefined | null): OrderStatusItem | undefined => {
41	    if (id === undefined || id === null || id === '') return undefined;
42	    const numId = typeof id === 'number' ? id : parseInt(String(id), 10);
43	    if (!isNaN(numId)) {
44	      const found = statuses.find(s => s.id === numId);
45	      if (found) return found;
46	    }
47	    return statuses.find(s => String(s.id) === String(id));
48	  };
49	
50	  const getStatusByName = (name: string): OrderStatusItem | undefined => {
51	    if (!name) return undefined;
52	    const clean = name.trim().toLowerCase();
53	    return statuses.find(s => s.nameAr.toLowerCase() === clean || s.nameEn.toLowerCase() === clean || s.code?.toLowerCase() === clean);
54	  };
55	
56	  const getStatusByAny = (val: number | string | undefined | null): OrderStatusItem | undefined => {
57	    if (val === undefined || val === null || val === '') return undefined;
58	    return getStatusById(val) || getStatusByName(String(val));
59	  };
60	
61	  const getFirstStatus = (): OrderStatusItem => {
62	    return statuses.find(s => s.isFirst) || statuses[0] || DEFAULT_ORDER_STATUSES[0];
63	  };
64	
65	  const getLastStatus = (): OrderStatusItem => {
66	    return statuses.find(s => s.isLast) || statuses[statuses.length - 1] || DEFAULT_ORDER_STATUSES[7];
67	  };
68	
69	  const getNextStatus = (currentStatusIdOrName: number | string): OrderStatusItem | undefined => {
70	    let currentItem: OrderStatusItem | undefined = getStatusByAny(currentStatusIdOrName);
71	    if (!currentItem) return undefined;
72	    const currentIndex = statuses.findIndex(s => s.id === currentItem!.id);
73	    if (currentIndex >= 0 && currentIndex < statuses.length - 1) {
74	      return statuses[currentIndex + 1];
75	    }
76	    return undefined;
77	  };
78	
79	  return {
80	    statuses,
81	    loading,
82	    getStatusById,
83	    getStatusByName,
84	    getStatusByAny,
85	    getFirstStatus,
86	    getLastStatus,
87	    getNextStatus
88	  };
89	}

Prior decision: "DEFAULT_ORDER_STATUSES is only a fallback for before-load / empty" — that's the plan. On error: keep statuses empty, or use defaults? The DB has 12 rows and they should display. If the API fails, we shouldn't crash every consumer. The plan from the summary: fetch, map, DEFAULT is only a fallback for before-load / empty, expose refresh. On error: fall back to defaults and expose the error, and have the component display a toast? Consumers: many components depend on statuses never being empty (dropdowns, etc.). Fallback to DEFAULT and surfacing the error is honest enough; the gap is visible via `error`.

```ts
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { ApiClient } from '../data/http/api-client';

export interface OrderStatusItem { ... unchanged }

export const DEFAULT_ORDER_STATUSES ... unchanged

const client = new ApiClient({...});

type StatusRow = Record<string, unknown>;

function toStatusItem(row: StatusRow): OrderStatusItem | null {
  const id = Number(row.statusId ?? row.orderStatusId ?? row.id);
  const nameAr = typeof row.nameAr === 'string' ? row.nameAr : '';
  if (!Number.isFinite(id) || !nameAr) return null;
  return {
    id,
    nameAr,
    nameEn: typeof row.nameEn === 'string' ? row.nameEn : nameAr,
    isFirst: Boolean(row.isFirst),
    isLast: Boolean(row.isLast),
    sortOrder: typeof row.sortOrder === 'number' ? row.sortOrder : undefined,
    color: ..., code: ..., description: ..., createdAt: ...
  };
}

export async function fetchOrderStatuses(): Promise<OrderStatusItem[]> {
  const response = await client.get<{ success: true; data: StatusRow[] }>('/api/v1/operations/order-statuses');
  return response.data.map(toStatusItem).filter((item): item is OrderStatusItem => item !== null);
}

export async function saveOrderStatus(input): Promise<void> — POST /api/v1/operations/order-statuses
export async function deleteOrderStatus(id: number): Promise<void> — DELETE .../{id}

export function useOrderStatuses() {
  const [statuses, setStatuses] = useState<OrderStatusItem[]>(DEFAULT_ORDER_STATUSES);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const rows = await fetchOrderStatuses();
      setStatuses(rows.length > 0 ? rows : DEFAULT_ORDER_STATUSES);
      setError(null);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'failed');
    } finally { setLoading(false); }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { void refresh(); }, [refresh]);
  ... helpers unchanged (regenerate with useCallback? plain functions are fine)
  return { statuses, loading, error, refresh, ...helpers };
}
```

300	class SupabaseQuery {
301	  path: string;
302	  constraints: any[] = [];
303	  constructor(path: string, constraints: any[] = []) {
304	    this.path = path;

309	class DocRef {
310	  type = 'doc';
311	  path: string;

318	
319	function applyQuery(items: any[], queryObj: SupabaseQuery): any[] {
320	  let filtered = [...items];
321	
322	  const evaluateCondition = (item: any, cond: any): boolean => {
323	    const val = item[cond.field];
324	    const compare = cond.value;
325	
326	    switch (cond.op) {
327	      case '==':
328	        return val === compare;
329	      case '!=':
330	        return val !== compare;
331	      case '>':
332	        return val > compare;
333	      case '>=':
334	        return val >= compare;
335	      case '<':
336	        return val < compare;
337	      case '<=':
338	        return val <= compare;
339	      case 'array-contains':
340	        return Array.isArray(val) && val.includes(compare);
341	      case 'in':
342	        return Array.isArray(compare) && compare.includes(val);
343	      default:
344	        return true;
345	    }
346	  };
347	
348	  for (const c of queryObj.constraints) {
349	    if (c.type === 'where') {
350	      filtered = filtered.filter(item => evaluateCondition(item, c));
351	    } else if (c.type === 'or') {
352	      filtered = filtered.filter(item => {
353	        return c.conditions.some((cond: any) => evaluateCondition(item, cond));
354	      });
355	    }
356	  }
357	
358	  // Handle orderBy
359	  const sortConstraints = queryObj.constraints.filter(c => c.type === 'orderBy');
360	  if (sortConstraints.length > 0) {
361	    filtered.sort((a, b) => {
362	      for (const s of sortConstraints) {
363	        const valA = a[s.field];
364	        const valB = b[s.field];
365	        if (valA !== valB) {
366	          const order = s.direction === 'desc' ? -1 : 1;
367	          if (valA === undefined || valA === null) return 1;
368	          if (valB === undefined || valB === null) return -1;
369	          return valA > valB ? order : -order;
370	        }
371	      }
372	      return 0;
373	    });
374	  }
375	
376	  // Handle limit
377	  const limitConstraint = queryObj.constraints.find(c => c.type === 'limit');
378	  if (limitConstraint) {
379	    filtered = filtered.slice(0, limitConstraint.value);
380	  }
381	
382	  return filtered;
383	}

511	export function doc(...args: any[]) {
512	  // If first arg is a DocRef, return it
513	  if (args[0] instanceof DocRef) {
514	    return args[0];
515	  }
516	  // If first arg is a SupabaseQuery (CollectionRef), map it with its path and a secure auto-generated ID
517	  if (args[0] instanceof SupabaseQuery) {
518	    const id = args[1] || (Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11));
519	    return new DocRef(args[0].path, id);
520	  }
521	  // doc(db, 'id') or doc('table', 'id') or doc(db, 'table', 'id')
522	  if (args.length === 2 && typeof args[1] === 'string') {
523	    const parts = args[1].split('/');
524	    if (parts.length >= 2) {
525	      return new DocRef(parts[0], parts[1]);
526	    }
527	    return new DocRef(args[1], "");
528	  }
529	  if (args.length === 3 && typeof args[1] === 'string' && typeof args[2] === 'string') {
530	    return new DocRef(args[1], args[2]);
531	  }
532	  const mainPath = typeof args[1] === 'string' ? args[1] : (typeof args[0] === 'string' ? args[0] : 'unknown');
533	  const subId = typeof args[2] === 'string' ? args[2] : '';
534	  return new DocRef(mainPath, subId);
535	}

557	export async function getDocs(queryObj: SupabaseQuery) {
558	  const table = queryObj.path;
559	  const allItems = await ensureCache(table);
560	  const filtered = applyQuery(allItems, queryObj);
561	
562	  const docs = filtered.map(rawItem => {
563	    const item = table === 'orders' ? enrichOrderPayload(rawItem) : rawItem;
564	    return {
565	      id: item.id,
566	      ref: new DocRef(table, item.id),
567	      exists: () => true,
568	      data: () => {
569	        const { id, ...rest } = item;
570	        return rest;
571	      }
572	    };
573	  });
574	
575	  return {
576	    docs,
577	    empty: docs.length === 0,
578	    size: docs.length,
579	    forEach: (cb: any) => docs.forEach(cb)
580	  };
581	}

583	export async function getDoc(docRef: DocRef) {
584	  const table = docRef.path;
585	  const id = docRef.id;
586	  const allItems = await ensureCache(table);
587	  const rawItem = allItems.find(i => i.id === id);
588	  const item = (table === 'orders' && rawItem) ? enrichOrderPayload(rawItem) : rawItem;
589	
590	  return {
591	    id,
592	    exists: () => !!item,
593	    data: () => {
594	      if (!item) return undefined;
595	      const { id: _, ...rest } = item;
596	      return rest;
597	    }
598	  };
599	}

605	export function createWriteError(operation: 'insert' | 'upsert' | 'update' | 'delete', table: string, error: any): Error {
606	  const writeError = new Error(`[Supabase Adapter] ${operation} failed on table ${table}: ${error?.message || 'Unknown database write error'}`);
607	  (writeError as any).code = error?.code;
608	  (writeError as any).cause = error;
609	  return writeError;
610	}

612	export async function addDoc(newID: any, collectionRef: SupabaseQuery, rawData: any) {
613	  const table = collectionRef.path;
614	  const pkCol = getTablePrimaryKey(table);
615	  let id = newID ? String(newID) : 'noId_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);
616	
617	  // Uniqueness check against cached items to prevent duplicate primary key violations
618	  const cache = collectionCaches[table] || [];
619	  if (cache.some((item: any) => String(item.id) === id || String(item[pkCol]) === id)) {
620	    id = `${id}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`;
621	  }
622	  const rawClean = cleanData(rawData);
623	  const data = sanitizeDataPayload(table, rawClean);
624	
625	  if (!isOfflineMode()) {
626	    const directCols = extractDirectColumns(table, rawClean);
627	    const writePayload = usesExplicitFinancialColumns(table) ? { [pkCol]: id, ...directCols } : { [pkCol]: id, ...directCols, data };
628	    const { error } = await supabase.from(table).insert(writePayload);
629	    if (error) {
630	      const isRlsError = error?.code === '42501' || String(error?.message || '').toLowerCase().includes('row-level security');
631	      if (isRlsError) {
632	        console.warn(`[Supabase Adapter] RLS warning on ${table}: ${error?.message}. Local cache preserved.`);
633	      } else {
634	        throw createWriteError('insert', table, error);
635	      }
636	    }
637	  } else {
638	    // Offline mode: buffering addDoc local write
639	  }
640	
641	  const newItem = extractRowPayload(table, { [pkCol]: id, id, ...extractDirectColumns(table, rawClean), data });
642	  if (!collectionCaches[table]) collectionCaches[table] = [];
643	  collectionCaches[table].push(newItem);
644	
645	  // إعلام استماع الطلبات عند إضافة منتج أو شحنة جديدة
646	  // Notify orders listeners when a product or shipment is added
647	  if ((table === 'products' || table === 'order_items' || table === 'shipments') && collectionListeners['orders']) {
648	    collectionListeners['orders'].forEach(cb => cb());
649	  }
650	
651	  // Safe write update in localStorage backup
652	  try {
653	    safeLocalStorage.setItem(`swiftship_table_backup_${table}`, JSON.stringify(collectionCaches[table]));
654	  } catch (_) { }
655	
656	  if (collectionListeners[table]) {
657	    collectionListeners[table].forEach(cb => cb());
658	  }
659	
660	  return { id };
661	}

700	export async function setDoc(docRef: DocRef, rawData: any, options?: any) {
701	  const table = docRef.path;
702	  const pkCol = getTablePrimaryKey(table);
703	  const id = docRef.id;
704	  let rawClean = cleanData(rawData);
705	
706	  if (options && options.merge) {
707	    const all = await ensureCache(table);
708	    const existing = all.find(item => item.id === id || item[pkCol] === id) || {};
709	    const { id: _, [pkCol]: __, ...existingData } = existing;
710	    rawClean = { ...existingData, ...rawClean };
711	  }
712	  const data = sanitizeDataPayload(table, rawClean);
713	
714	  if (!isOfflineMode()) {
715	    const directCols = extractDirectColumns(table, rawClean);
716	    const writePayload = usesExplicitFinancialColumns(table) ? { [pkCol]: id, ...directCols } : { [pkCol]: id, ...directCols, data };
717	    const { error } = await supabase.from(table).upsert(writePayload);
718	    if (error) {
719	      const isRlsError = error?.code === '42501' || String(error?.message || '').toLowerCase().includes('row-level security');
720	      if (isRlsError) {
721	        console.warn(`[Supabase Adapter] RLS warning on ${table}: ${error?.message}. Local cache preserved.`);
722	      } else {
723	        throw createWriteError('upsert', table, error);
724	      }
725	    }
726	  } else {
727	    // Offline mode: buffering setDoc local write
728	  }
729	
730	  const newItem = extractRowPayload(table, { [pkCol]: id, id, ...extractDirectColumns(table, rawClean), data });
731	  if (!collectionCaches[table]) collectionCaches[table] = [];
732	  const idx = collectionCaches[table].findIndex(item => item.id === id || item[pkCol] === id);
733	  if (idx >= 0) {
734	    collectionCaches[table][idx] = newItem;
735	  } else {
736	    collectionCaches[table].push(newItem);
737	  }
738	
739	  // إعلام استماع الطلبات عند تعديل منتج أو شحنة
740	  // Notify orders listeners when a product or shipment is updated
741	  if ((table === 'products' || table === 'order_items' || table === 'shipments') && collectionListeners['orders']) {
742	    collectionListeners['orders'].forEach(cb => cb());
743	  }
744	
745	  // Safe write update in localStorage backup
746	  try {
747	    safeLocalStorage.setItem(`swiftship_table_backup_${table}`, JSON.stringify(collectionCaches[table]));
748	  } catch (_) { }
749	
750	  if (collectionListeners[table]) {
751	    collectionListeners[table].forEach(cb => cb());
752	  }
753	}
