import type { Response } from 'express';

export interface ApiErrorDetails {
  code: string;
  message: string;
  details: ReadonlyArray<{ field?: string; message: string }>;
  requestId: string;
}

export interface ApiSuccess<T> {
  success: true;
  data: T;
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
  requestId: string;
}

export interface ApiFailure {
  success: false;
  error: ApiErrorDetails;
}

export function sendSuccess<T>(
  response: Response,
  data: T,
  requestId: string,
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>,
): Response<ApiSuccess<T>> {
  const body: ApiSuccess<T> = meta === undefined
    ? { success: true, data, requestId }
    : { success: true, data, meta, requestId };
  return response.json(body);
}

export function sendFailure(
  response: Response,
  status: number,
  code: string,
  message: string,
  requestId: string,
  details: ReadonlyArray<{ field?: string; message: string }> = [],
): Response<ApiFailure> {
  return response.status(status).json({
    success: false,
    error: { code, message, details, requestId },
  });
```json
}
```

# Legacy shim mechanics (context)

`src/data/legacy/legacy-compat.ts` = `export * from '../../lib/supabase-adapter'` (only line 6; file is a pure re-export).
`src/lib/supabase-adapter.ts`:
- `supabase` = `createSupabaseStub()` (L18–59): chainable **no-op Proxy** — every `.from(t).select/insert/update/delete` and `.rpc(fn, args)` resolves `{data:[], error:null, count:0}` (`single()` → `{data:null}`). All network reads return empty; all supabase writes silently "succeed" doing nothing.
- Firestore-style API (`collection/db/doc/query/where/orderBy/getDocs/getDoc/addDoc/setDoc/updateDoc/deleteDoc/writeBatch/onSnapshot`) operates on an **in-memory `collectionCaches`** seeded from localStorage `swiftship_table_backup_<table>`; writes mutate only cache+localStorage. `ensureCache` (L266–297) never fetches.
- **`addAssDoc`** (L663–698): like `addDoc` but takes `(newID, assetCode, collectionRef, rawData)` and injects `assetCode` into the insert payload/cache row. PKs from `getTablePrimaryKey` (`supabase-adapter-columns.ts`); `assets` PK = `asset_id`, `accounts` = `account_id`, `main_entry` = `main_entry_id`, `account_trans` = `account_trans_id`, `auto_entries` = `auto_entry_id`, `currency` = `cur_id`, `users` = `user_id`, `default_accounts` = `default_account_id`. `assets`, `accounts`, tree tables, `users`, entity tables are **explicit-column** tables (no `data` jsonb).
- `writeBatch(db)` = `MockWriteBatch` (L947–971): queued set/update/delete executed sequentially on `commit()`.

```ts
};
```

```ts
import { ApiClient } from '../../../../../data/http/api-client';
import {
  createReturnedProduct,
  deleteReturnedProduct,
  fetchReturnedProducts,
  updateReturnedProduct,
  type ReturnedProduct,
} from '../../../../../services/returnedProductService';
import { fetchOrderItems, updateOrderItem } from '../../../../../services/productService';

type OrderRow = { id: string } & Record<string, unknown>;
type OrderItemRow = { items_id: string } & Record<string, unknown>;

const client = new ApiClient({...});

type Setter<T> = (rows: T[]) => void;

function createPoller<T>(load: () => Promise<T[]>) {
  const listeners: { onData: Setter<T>; onError?: (e: unknown) => void }[] = [];
  const refresh = async () => {
    let rows: T[]; 
    try { rows = await load(); } catch (error) { listeners.slice().forEach(l => l.onError?.(error)); return; }
    listeners.slice().forEach(l => l.onData(rows));
  };
  return {
    subscribe(onData, onError?) {
      listeners.push({ onData, onError });
      if (listeners.length === 1) { void refresh(); }
      // hmm interval: keep one shared interval when there are subscribers
    }
  };
}
```

Simplification per collection; write straightforward functions:

```ts
function makeCollection<T>(load: () => Promise<T[]>) {
  const subs = new Set<{ onData: (rows: T[]) => void; onError?: (e: unknown) => void }>();
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  const refresh = async () => {
    try {
      const rows = await load();
      subs.forEach(s => s.onData(rows));
    } catch (error) {
      subs.forEach(s => s.onError?.(error));
    }
  };
  const start = () => { if (!timer) { void refresh(); timer = setInterval(() => void refresh(), 30_000); } };
  const stopIfIdle = () => { if (subs.size === 0 && timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; } };
  return {
    subscribe(onData: (rows: T[]) => void, onError?: (error: unknown) => void) {
      subs.add({ onData, onError });
      start();
      let disposed = false;
      return () => { if (disposed) return; disposed = true; subs.delete({ onData, onError } as any) — problem: need identity. Hold onto the sub object:
    },
    notify: refresh,
  };
}
```

```ts
const returnsCollection = makeCollection<ReturnedProduct>(() => fetchReturnedProducts());
const orderItemsCollection = makeCollection<OrderItemRow>(async () => (await fetchOrderItems()) as unknown as OrderItemRow[]);
const ordersCollection = makeCollection<OrderRow>(async () => {
  const res = await client.get<{ success: boolean; data: ApiRow[] | { items?: ApiRow[] } }>('/api/v1/orders', { limit: '500', offset: '0' });
  return extractRows(res.data).map(row => ({ ...row, id: String(row.orderId ?? row.id ?? ''), customerName: row.customerName ?? row.customerId }));
});

export const returnedProductsGateway = {
  subscribeOrders: (onData, onError?) => ordersCollection.subscribe(onData, onError),
  subscribeOrderItems: ...
  subscribeReturns: (onData, onError) => returnsCollection.subscribe(onData, onError ? (e)=>onError(e): undefined) — the legacy signature is (onData, onError required).
  async updateReturn(returnId, payload) { await updateReturnedProduct(returnId, payload as any); void returnsCollection.notify(); },
  async createReturn(returnId, payload) { await createReturnedProduct({ ...(payload as any), return_id: returnId }); void returnsCollection.notify(); },
  async updateOrderItem(orderItemId, payload) { await updateOrderItem(orderItemId, payload as any); void orderItemsCollection.notify(); },
  async deleteReturn(returnId) { await deleteReturnedProduct(returnId); void returnsCollection.notify(); },
};
```

59	const money = (value: unknown) => Math.round((Number(value) || 0) * 100) / 100;
60	
61	export function calculateShipmentCategoryFees(category: Partial<ItemCategory> | undefined, cartonCount: unknown): ShipmentCategoryFees {
62	  const cartons = Math.max(0, money(cartonCount));
63	  const customsFee = money(cartons * money(category?.customsPerCarton));
64	  const taxFee = money(cartons * money(category?.taxPerCarton));
65	  const otherCategoryFee = money(cartons * money(category?.otherFeesPerCarton));
66	  return {
67	    cartonCount: cartons,
68	    customsFee,
69	    taxFee,
70	    otherCategoryFee,
71	    total: money(customsFee + taxFee + otherCategoryFee),
72	    currency: category?.feeCurrency || 'SAR',
73	  };
74	}

19	function requestId(response: Response): string {
20	  return String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');
21	}
22	function principalId(response: Response): string | undefined {
23	  return (response.locals.authPrincipal as { userId?: string } | undefined)?.userId;
24	}
25	function route(permission: string, auth: AuthUseCases | undefined) {
26	  return [requireAuthenticatedUser(auth), requirePermission(auth, permission)];
27	}
28	function pageHandler(
29	  load: (query: {
30	    limit: number;
31	    offset: number;
32	    search?: string | undefined;
33	  }) => Promise<{ items: readonly Record<string, unknown>[]; total: number }>,
34	) {
35	  return async (request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
36	    const query = pageQuerySchema.safeParse(request.query);
37	    if (!query.success)
38	      return sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_PAGE_QUERY', 'معاملات الصفحة غير صالحة.', requestId(response));
39	    try {
40	      const result = await load(query.data);
41	      return sendSuccess(response, result.items, requestId(response), { ...query.data, total: result.total });
42	    } catch (error) {
43	      return next(error);
44	    }
45	  };
46	}
47	function idParam(request: Request, response: Response): string | undefined {
48	  const parsed = entityIdSchema.safeParse(request.params.id);
49	  if (!parsed.success) {
50	    sendFailure(response, 400, 'INVALID_ENTITY_ID', 'المعرف غير صالح.', requestId(response));
51	    return undefined;
52	  }
53	  return parsed.data;
54	}
55	function writeError(error: unknown, response: Response, next: NextFunction): void {
56	  if (error instanceof Error && /غير متوازن|balance|balanced/i.test(error.message)) {
57	    sendFailure(response, 422, 'FINANCIAL_ENTRY_NOT_BALANCED', 'لا يمكن إنشاء قيد غير متوازن.', requestId(response));
58	    return;
59	  }
60	  next(error);
61	}

63	// مطابقة منطق الصلاحيات الدقيقة للإجراءين secure_replace/secure_delete في قاعدة البيانات
64	// Mirrors the granular permission mapping of the legacy secure_replace/secure_delete RPC wrappers.
65	const RECEIPT_TYPE_CODES = ['RECEIPT_VOUCHER', 'ORDER_PAYMENT'];
66	const PAYMENT_TYPE_CODES = ['PAYMENT_VOUCHER', 'OPERATING_EXPENSE', 'SALARY_PAYMENT'];
67	
68	function entryPermissionFor(typeCode: string | null, category: string, action: 'edit' | 'delete'): string {
69	  if (RECEIPT_TYPE_CODES.includes(typeCode ?? '')) return action === 'edit' ? 'edit_receipt_vouchers' : 'delete_receipt_vouchers';
70	  if (PAYMENT_TYPE_CODES.includes(typeCode ?? '')) return action === 'edit' ? 'edit_payment_vouchers' : 'delete_payment_vouchers';
71	  if (category === 'Compound') return action === 'edit' ? 'edit_compound_entries' : 'delete_compound_entries';
72	  if (category === 'Temp') return action === 'edit' ? 'edit_temporary_entries' : 'delete_temporary_entries';
73	  return action === 'edit' ? 'edit_general_entries' : 'delete_general_entries';
74	}
75	
76	async function hasPermission(auth: AuthUseCases | undefined, userId: string, code: string): Promise<boolean> {
77	  if (!auth) return false;
78	  const permissions = await auth.listPermissions({ userId });
79	  return permissions.includes(code);
80	}

#### Thinking

The alx_api finance module covers: accounts (read-only: list/get/movements), journal entries, advances, order payments, auto-entry rules, and custody advances. The following are not included: account CRUD (add/edit/delete accounts), chart of accounts, accounting hierarchy, expense categories, assets, job applications, entry module/type writes (read-only), finance report data.

Frontend finance surface to migrate (#7):
1. AssetsPortfolio.tsx — assets table (addAssDoc, collection, onSnapshot, CRUD)
2. ChartOfAccounts.tsx — chart of accounts collection, onSnapshot etc.
3. AccountingHierarchyManagement.tsx — hierarchy collection
4. accountingHierarchyService.ts — getDoc/getDocs
5. ExpenseCategoriesManager.tsx — expense categories collection
6. AutoVoucherRulesManager.tsx — orphaned; useAutoVoucherRules is stubbed out
7. financialAccountAccounts.ts — accounts collection read/write (add/edit/delete accounts)
8. financialAccountAutomation.ts — supabase rpc, settings documents
9. financialAccountPurge.ts — writeBatch
10. financialAccountService.ts — getAccountById, supabase rpc balance, salary_history, auto voucher rules
11. financialEntrySettingsService.ts — supabase
12. autoEntryService.ts — used in orders handler (production engine) + settings read
13. FinanceAccounting.tsx — writeBatch for COD remittance to orders
14. FinanceReports.tsx — collection read via onSnapshot
15. AccountingPage.tsx — collection read via onSnapshot
16. GlobalEntityLedgerModal.tsx — ledger read via onSnapshot
17. defaultAccountsVoucherWiring test failure

This is a very large phase. We need DB schema knowledge: what tables exist in the live DB (assets, chart_of_accounts/Accounts, hierarchy, expense categories, EntryModules/EntryTypes, etc.). Supabase MCP is broken (-32603). Try mcp__supabase__list_tables once more? Worth a try — the error was occurring on list_projects; list_tables requires a project reference. There might be a project ID in .env. Legacy supabase client URL in env: VITE_SUPABASE_URL. MCP might be able to use that reference.

Also, I need to read each frontend file to check which collections it's accessing. That's a lot to read. Plan: delegate the mapping work to the Explore agent, and have it produce: per-file legacy collection/RPC usage. Then design the API routes for alx_api, and implement them incrementally.

First, quickly check the live DB tables with supabase MCP, and in parallel delegate the inventory of legacy usage to the Explore agent.

The alx_api finance module handles accounts, entries, and custody flows, but lacks write operations for accounts, chart of accounts, hierarchy, expense categories, assets, and reports. I'm inventorying all legacy usages across the codebase to identify what needs to be built.

# Legacy shim mechanics (context)

`src/data/legacy/legacy-compat.ts` = `export * from '../../lib/supabase-adapter'` (only line 6; file is a pure re-export).
`src/lib/supabase-adapter.ts`:
- `supabase` = `createSupabaseStub()` (L18–59): chainable **no-op Proxy** — every `.from(t).select/insert/update/delete` and `.rpc(fn, args)` resolves `{data:[], error:null, count:0}` (`single()` → `{data:null}`). All network reads return empty; all supabase writes silently "succeed" doing nothing.
- Firestore-style API (`collection/db/doc/query/where/orderBy/getDocs/getDoc/addDoc/setDoc/updateDoc/deleteDoc/writeBatch/onSnapshot`) operates on an **in-memory `collectionCaches`** seeded from localStorage `swiftship_table_backup_<table>`; writes mutate only cache+localStorage. `ensureCache` (L266–297) never fetches.
- **`addAssDoc`** (L663–698): like `addDoc` but takes `(newID, assetCode, collectionRef, rawData)` and injects `assetCode` into the insert payload/cache row. PKs from `getTablePrimaryKey` (`supabase-adapter-columns.ts`); `assets` PK = `asset_id`, `accounts` = `account_id`, `main_entry` = `main_entry_id`, `account_trans` = `account_trans_id`, `auto_entries` = `auto_entry_id`, `currency` = `cur_id`, `users` = `user_id`, `default_accounts` = `default_account_id`. `assets`, `accounts`, tree tables, `users`, entity tables are **explicit-column** tables (no `data` jsonb).
- `writeBatch(db)` = `MockWriteBatch` (L947–971): queued set/update/delete executed sequentially on `commit()`.

301	  path: string;

309	class DocRef {
310	  type = 'doc';
311	  path: string;
312	  id: string;
313	  constructor(path: string, id: string) {
314	    this.path = path;
315	    this.id = id;
316	  }

318	
319	function applyQuery(items: any[], queryObj: SupabaseQuery): any[] {
320	  let filtered = [...items];
321	
322	  const evaluateCondition = (item: any, cond: any): boolean => {
323	    const val = item[cond.field];
324	    const compare = cond.value;
325	
326	    switch (cond.op) {
327	      case '==':
328	        return val === compare;
329	      case '!=':
330	        return val !== compare;
331	      case '>':
332	        return val > compare;
333	      case '>=':
334	        return val >= compare;
335	      case '<':
336	        return val < compare;
337	      case '<=':
338	        return val <= compare;
339	      case 'array-contains':
340	        return Array.isArray(val) && val.includes(compare);
341	      case 'in':
342	        return Array.isArray(compare) && compare.includes(val);
343	      default:
344	        return true;
345	    }
346	  };
347	
348	  for (const c of queryObj.constraints) {
349	    if (c.type === 'where') {
350	      filtered = filtered.filter(item => evaluateCondition(item, c));
351	    } else if (c.type === 'or') {
352	      filtered = filtered.filter(item => {
353	        return c.conditions.some((cond: any) => evaluateCondition(item, cond));
354	      });
355	    }
356	  }
357	
358	  // Handle orderBy
359	  const sortConstraints = queryObj.constraints.filter(c => c.type === 'orderBy');
360	  if (sortConstraints.length > 0) {
361	    filtered.sort((a, b) => {
362	      for (const s of sortConstraints) {
363	        const valA = a[s.field];
364	        const valB = b[s.field];
365	        if (valA !== valB) {
366	          const order = s.direction === 'desc' ? -1 : 1;
367	          if (valA === undefined || valA === null) return 1;
368	          if (valB === undefined || valB === null) return -1;
369	          return valA > valB ? order : -order;
370	        }
371	      }
372	      return 0;
373	    });
374	  }
375	
376	  // Handle limit
377	  const limitConstraint = queryObj.constraints.find(c => c.type === 'limit');
378	  if (limitConstraint) {
379	    filtered = filtered.slice(0, limitConstraint.value);
380	  }
381	
382	  return filtered;
383	}

511	export function doc(...args: any[]) {
512	  // If first arg is a DocRef, return it
513	  if (args[0] instanceof DocRef) {
514	    return args[0];
515	  }
516	  // If first arg is a SupabaseQuery (CollectionRef), map it with its path and a secure auto-generated ID
517	  if (args[0] instanceof SupabaseQuery) {
518	    const id = args[1] || (Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11));
519	    return new DocRef(args[0].path, id);
520	  }
521	  // doc(db, 'id') or doc('table', 'id') or doc(db, 'table', 'id')
522	  if (args.length === 2 && typeof args[1] === 'string') {
523	    const parts = args[1].split('/');
524	    if (parts.length >= 2) {
525	      return new DocRef(parts[0], parts[1]);
526	    }
527	    return new DocRef(args[1], "");
528	  }
529	  if (args.length === 3 && typeof args[1] === 'string' && typeof args[2] === 'string') {
530	    return new DocRef(args[1], args[2]);
531	  }
532	  const mainPath = typeof args[1] === 'string' ? args[1] : (typeof args[0] === 'string' ? args[0] : 'unknown');
533	  const subId = typeof args[2] === 'string' ? args[2] : '';
534	  return new DocRef(mainPath, subId);
535	}

557	export async function getDocs(queryObj: SupabaseQuery) {
558	  const table = queryObj.path;
559	  const allItems = await ensureCache(table);
560	  const filtered = applyQuery(allItems, queryObj);
561	
562	  const docs = filtered.map(rawItem => {
563	    const item = table === 'orders' ? enrichOrderPayload(rawItem) : rawItem;
564	    return {
565	      id: item.id,
566	      ref: new DocRef(table, item.id),
567	      exists: () => true,
568	      data: () => {
569	        const { id, ...rest } = item;
570	        return rest;
571	      }
572	    };
573	  });
574	
575	  return {
576	    docs,
577	    empty: docs.length === 0,
578	    size: docs.length,
579	    forEach: (cb: any) => docs.forEach(cb)
580	  };
581	}

583	export async function getDoc(docRef: DocRef) {
584	  const table = docRef.path;
585	  const id = docRef.id;
586	  const allItems = await ensureCache(table);
587	  const rawItem = allItems.find(i => i.id === id);
588	  const item = (table === 'orders' && rawItem) ? enrichOrderPayload(rawItem) : rawItem;
589	
590	  return {
591	    id,
592	    exists: () => !!item,
593	    data: () => {
594	      if (!item) return undefined;
595	      const { id: _, ...rest } = item;
596	      return rest;
597	    }
598	  };
599	}

605	export function createWriteError(operation: 'insert' | 'upsert' | 'update' | 'delete', table: string, error: any): Error {
606	  const writeError = new Error(`[Supabase Adapter] ${operation} failed on table ${table}: ${error?.message || 'Unknown database write error'}`);
607	  (writeError as any).code = error?.code;
608	  (writeError as any).cause = error;
609	  return writeError;
610	}

612	export async function addDoc(newID: any, collectionRef: SupabaseQuery, rawData: any) {
613	  const table = collectionRef.path;
614	  const pkCol = getTablePrimaryKey(table);
615	  let id = newID ? String(newID) : 'noId_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);
616	
617	  // Uniqueness check against cached items to prevent duplicate primary key violations
618	  const cache = collectionCaches[table] || [];
619	  if (cache.some((item: any) => String(item.id) === id || String(item[pkCol]) === id)) {
620	    id = `${id}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`;
621	  }
622	  const rawClean = cleanData(rawData);
623	  const data = sanitizeDataPayload(table, rawClean);
624	
625	  if (!isOfflineMode()) {
626	    const directCols = extractDirectColumns(table, rawClean);
627	    const writePayload = usesExplicitFinancialColumns(table) ? { [pkCol]: id, ...directCols } : { [pkCol]: id, ...directCols, data };
628	    const { error } = await supabase.from(table).insert(writePayload);
629	    if (error) {
630	      const isRlsError = error?.code === '42501' || String(error?.message || '').toLowerCase().includes('row-level security');
631	      if (isRlsError) {
632	        console.warn(`[Supabase Adapter] RLS warning on ${table}: ${error?.message}. Local cache preserved.`);
633	      } else {
634	        throw createWriteError('insert', table, error);
635	      }
636	    }
637	  } else {
638	    // Offline mode: buffering addDoc local write
639	  }
640	
641	  const newItem = extractRowPayload(table, { [pkCol]: id, id, ...extractDirectColumns(table, rawClean), data });
642	  if (!collectionCaches[table]) collectionCaches[table] = [];
643	  collectionCaches[table].push(newItem);
644	
645	  // إعلام استماع الطلبات عند إضافة منتج أو شحنة جديدة
646	  // Notify orders listeners when a product or shipment is added
647	  if ((table === 'products' || table === 'order_items' || table === 'shipments') && collectionListeners['orders']) {
648	    collectionListeners['orders'].forEach(cb => cb());
649	  }
650	
651	  // Safe write update in localStorage backup
652	  try {
653	    safeLocalStorage.setItem(`swiftship_table_backup_${table}`, JSON.stringify(collectionCaches[table]));
654	  } catch (_) { }
655	
656	  if (collectionListeners[table]) {
657	    collectionListeners[table].forEach(cb => cb());
658	  }
659	
660	  return { id };
661	}

708	    const existing = all.find(item => item.id === id || item[pkCol] === id) || {};
709	    const { id: _, [pkCol]: __, ...existingData } = existing;
710	    rawClean = { ...existingData, ...rawClean };
711	  }
712	  const data = sanitizeDataPayload(table, rawClean);
713	
714	  if (!isOfflineMode()) {
715	    const directCols = extractDirectColumns(table, rawClean);
716	    const writePayload = usesExplicitFinancialColumns(table) ? { [pkCol]: id, ...directCols } : { [pkCol]: id, ...directCols, data };
717	    const { error } = await supabase.from(table).upsert(writePayload);
718	    if (error) {

722	      } else {

727	    // Offline mode: buffering setDoc local write

731	  if (!collectionCaches[table]) collectionCaches[table] = [];
732	  const idx = collectionCaches[table].findIndex(item => item.id === id || item[pkCol] === id);

778	export async function updateDoc(docRef: DocRef, rawData: any) {
779	  const table = docRef.path;

785	  const { id: _, [pkCol]: __, ...existingData } = existing;
786	
787	  const resolvedPayload: any = {};
788	  for (const k of Object.keys(rawData)) {
789	    const val = rawData[k];
790	    if (val instanceof IncrementValue) {
791	      const currentVal = parseFloat(existingData[k]) || 0;
792	      resolvedPayload[k] = currentVal + val.amount;
793	    } else if (val instanceof ArrayUnionValue) {
794	      const currentArr = Array.isArray(existingData[k]) ? existingData[k] : [];
795	      resolvedPayload[k] = [...currentArr, ...val.elements.filter((e: any) => !currentArr.includes(e))];
796	    } else {
797	      resolvedPayload[k] = cleanData(val);
798	    }
799	  }

1108	export function safeToDate(timestamp: any): Date | null {
1109	  if (!timestamp) return null;
1110	  if (timestamp instanceof Date) return timestamp;
1111	  if (timestamp && typeof timestamp.toDate === 'function') return timestamp.toDate();
1112	  if (typeof timestamp === 'number') return new Date(timestamp);
1113	  if (typeof timestamp === 'string') {
1114	    const d = new Date(timestamp);
1115	    return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
1116	  }
1117	  return null;
1118	}

1175	export function encryptDataLocal(text: string, key: string): string {
1176	  let result = '';
1177	  const cleanKey = key || 'swiftship_emergency_core_system_salt';
1178	  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
1179	    const charCode = text.charCodeAt(i);
1180	    const keyChar = cleanKey.charCodeAt(i % cleanKey.length);
1181	    result += String.fromCharCode(charCode ^ keyChar);
1182	  }
1183	  return btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(result)));
1184	}
1185	
1186	export function decryptDataLocal(cipherText: string, key: string): string {
1187	  try {
1188	    const cleanKey = key || 'swiftship_emergency_core_system_salt';
1189	    const text = decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(cipherText)));
1190	    let result = '';
1191	    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
1192	      const charCode = text.charCodeAt(i);
1193	      const keyChar = cleanKey.charCodeAt(i % cleanKey.length);
1194	      result += String.fromCharCode(charCode ^ keyChar);
1195	    }
1196	    return result;
1197	  } catch (e) {
1198	    return '';
1199	  }
1200	}

1202	export function simpleHashPassword(message: string): string {
1203	  let hash = 0;
1204	  const input = message || '';
1205	  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
1206	    const char = input.charCodeAt(i);
1207	    hash = (hash << 5) - hash + char;
1208	    hash = hash & hash;
1209	  }
1210	  return 'emergency_hash_v1_' + Math.abs(hash).toString(16) + '_' + input.length;
1211	}

Now I understand the adapter. Key points: addAssDoc(newID, arg1(assetCode), collectionRef, rawData) inserts into collectionCaches + localStorage only (supabase.from is a stub, and insert resolves with {data:[], error:null}? Actually, supabase.from(table).insert(...) returns a Proxy stub that's thenable and has defaultResult {data: [], error: null, count: 0}, so error is null and no exception is thrown, but nothing is persisted to the network. Reads go to the in-memory collectionCaches seeded from localStorage's `swiftship_table_backup_${table}`. So writes are persisted only to localStorage.

51	    while (used.has(String(next))) next += 1;
52	    if (next > 9) throw new Error('لا يمكن إنشاء حساب رئيسي جديد: نطاق أكواد الجذر المكوّن من رقم واحد ممتلئ.');
53	    return String(next);
54	  },
55	
56	  nextChildCode(parentCode: string, records: any[]): string {
57	    const normalizedParent = onlyDigits(parentCode);
58	    if (!normalizedParent || normalizedParent.length >= 4) {
59	      throw new Error('رمز الأب غير صالح لإنشاء عقدة فرعية.');
60	    }
61	    const childNumbers = (records || [])
62	      .map(readCode)
63	      .filter((code) => code.startsWith(normalizedParent) && /^\d+$/.test(code))
64	      .map((code) => code.slice(normalizedParent.length))
65	      .filter((suffix) => /^\d$/.test(suffix))
66	      .map(Number);
67	    const next = Math.max(0, ...childNumbers) + 1;
68	    if (next > 9) throw new Error(`لا يمكن إنشاء عقدة أخرى تحت ${normalizedParent}: نطاق التسلسل ممتلئ.`);
69	    return `${normalizedParent}${next}`;
70	  },
71	
72	  postingPrefix(accSubCode: string, groupCode?: string): string {
73	    const selected = onlyDigits(groupCode || accSubCode);
74	    if (!selected || selected.length > 4) {
75	      throw new Error('يجب اختيار حساب جزئي صالح، ومجموعة اختيارية ذات كود صالح، قبل إنشاء حساب مالي.');
76	    }
77	    return selected.padEnd(4, '0');
78	  },
79	
80	  nextPostingSequence(prefix: string, records: any[]): number {
81	    const normalizedPrefix = onlyDigits(prefix);
82	    if (normalizedPrefix.length !== 4) throw new Error('بادئة الحساب المالي يجب أن تتكون من أربعة أرقام.');
83	    return (records || []).reduce((maximum, record) => {
84	      const explicitSequence = Number(readValue(record, 'accountSeq', 'account_seq') || 0);
85	      const codeMatch = readCode(record).match(new RegExp(`^${normalizedPrefix}-(\\d{1,4})$`));
86	      const codeSequence = codeMatch ? Number(codeMatch[1]) : 0;
87	      return Math.max(maximum, Number.isInteger(explicitSequence) ? explicitSequence : 0, codeSequence);
88	    }, 0) + 1;
89	  },
90	
91	  formatPostingCode(prefix: string, sequence: number): string {
92	    const normalizedPrefix = onlyDigits(prefix);
93	    const normalizedSequence = Number(sequence);
94	    if (normalizedPrefix.length !== 4 || !Number.isInteger(normalizedSequence) || normalizedSequence < 1 || normalizedSequence > 9999) {
95	      throw new Error('كود الحساب المالي أو تسلسله غير صالح.');
96	    }
97	    return `${normalizedPrefix}-${String(normalizedSequence).padStart(4, '0')}`;
98	  },
99	
100	  validateCode(kind: HierarchyCodeKind, code: string, parents: { accountCode?: string; mainCode?: string; subCode?: string; groupCode?: string }): string | null {
101	    const normalized = String(code || '').trim();
102	    if (kind === 'account') return /^\d$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود الحساب الرئيسي يجب أن يكون رقمًا واحدًا.';
103	    if (kind === 'main') return normalized === `${onlyDigits(parents.accountCode || '')}${normalized.slice(-1)}` && /^\d{2}$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود الحساب الفرعي يجب أن يتبع كود الحساب الرئيسي مباشرة.';
104	    if (kind === 'sub') return normalized === `${onlyDigits(parents.mainCode || '')}${normalized.slice(-1)}` && /^\d{3}$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود الحساب الجزئي يجب أن يتبع كود الحساب الفرعي مباشرة.';
105	    if (kind === 'group') return normalized === `${onlyDigits(parents.subCode || '')}${normalized.slice(-1)}` && /^\d{4}$/.test(normalized) ? null : 'كود المجموعة يجب أن يتبع كود الحساب الجزئي مباشرة.';
106	
107	    const prefix = this.postingPrefix(parents.subCode || '', parents.groupCode);
108	    return new RegExp(`^${prefix}-\\d{4}$`).test(normalized)
109	      ? null
110	      : `كود الحساب المالي يجب أن يطابق ${prefix}-0001.`;
111	  },
112	};

114	class AccountingHierarchyService {
115	  /** يبقى الحساب القديم قابلاً للقيد فقط إلى أن تصنّف الحسابات في الترحيل التالي. */
116	  isPostingAccount(account: any): boolean {
117	    return Boolean(account?.id)
118	      && account?.isActive !== false
119	      && account?.is_active !== false
120	      && account?.isHierarchyNode !== true;
121	  }
122	
123	  filterPostingAccounts(accounts: any[], requireClassified = false): any[] {
124	    return (accounts || []).filter((account) => {
125	      if (!this.isPostingAccount(account)) return false;
126	      return !requireClassified || Boolean(readValue(account, 'accSubId', 'acc_sub_id'));
127	    });
128	  }
129	
130	  async hasHierarchyStructure(): Promise<boolean> {
131	    const [rootSnapshot, subSnapshot] = await Promise.all([
132	      getDocs(collection(db, 'account')),
133	      getDocs(collection(db, 'acc_sub')),
134	    ]);
135	    return !rootSnapshot.empty && !subSnapshot.empty;
136	  }
137	
138	  async getDefaultCurrencyId(): Promise<number | undefined> {
139	    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'currency'));

141	      .map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() }))
142	      .find((entry: any) => entry.isDefault === true || entry.is_default === true);
143	    return currency?.cur_id === undefined ? undefined : Number(currency.cur_id);
144	  }
145	
146	  async getCurrencyIdByCode(currencyCode?: string): Promise<number | undefined> {
147	    const normalizedCode = String(currencyCode || '').trim().toUpperCase();
148	    if (!normalizedCode) return this.getDefaultCurrencyId();
149	    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'currency'));

152	      .find((entry: any) => String(entry.code || '').toUpperCase() === normalizedCode);
153	    return currency?.cur_id === undefined ? undefined : Number(currency.cur_id);
154	  }
155	
156	  async getEntityPostingLocation(entityType: LedgerEntityType): Promise<AccountGroupLocation | null> {
157	    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'acc_sub_group'));
158	    const group = snap.docs
159	      .map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() }))
160	      .find((entry: any) => readValue(entry, 'entityType', 'entity_type') === entityType
161	        && entry.isActive !== false
162	        && entry.is_active !== false
163	        && readValue(entry, 'allowsDirectAccounts', 'allows_direct_accounts') !== false);
164	    if (!group) return null;
165	
166	    const accountCode = readCode(group);
167	    const accSubId = String(readValue(group, 'accSubId', 'acc_sub_id') || '').trim();
168	    if (!accountCode || !accSubId) return null;
169	    const curNo = readValue(group, 'curNo', 'cur_no');
170	    return { accSubId, groupId: group.id, accountCode, currencyId: curNo == null ? undefined : Number(curNo) };
171	  }
172	
173	  async getNextAccountSequence(location: AccountGroupLocation): Promise<number> {
174	    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'accounts'));
175	    const siblings = snap.docs
176	      .map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() }))
177	      .filter((account: any) => {
178	        const sameGroup = location.groupId && readValue(account, 'groupId', 'group_id') === location.groupId;
179	        const sameSub = !location.groupId && readValue(account, 'accSubId', 'acc_sub_id') === location.accSubId;
180	        return Boolean(sameGroup || sameSub);
181	      });
182	    return hierarchyCodeRules.nextPostingSequence(location.accountCode, siblings);
183	  }
184	
185	  async getDefaultAccount(defaultKey: string): Promise<DefaultAccountBinding | null> {
186	    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'default_accounts'));
187	    const binding = snap.docs
188	      .map((entry) => ({ id: entry.id, ...entry.data() }))
189	      .find((entry: any) => String(readValue(entry, 'defaultKey', 'default_key') || '') === defaultKey);
190	    if (!binding || binding.isActive === false || binding.is_active === false) return null;
191	    const accountId = String(readValue(binding, 'accountId', 'account_id') || '').trim();
192	    if (!accountId) return null;
193	    return {
194	      id: String(binding.id),
195	      defaultKey,
196	      accountId,
197	      accNameAr: String(readValue(binding, 'accNameAr', 'acc_name_ar') || binding.nameAr || ''),
198	      accNameEn: String(readValue(binding, 'accNameEn', 'acc_name_en') || binding.nameEn || ''),
199	      curNo: readValue(binding, 'curNo', 'cur_no') == null ? undefined : Number(readValue(binding, 'curNo', 'cur_no')),
200	      isActive: true,
201	    };
202	  }
203	
204	  async resolveDefaultPostingAccount(defaultKey: string): Promise<any | null> {
205	    const binding = await this.getDefaultAccount(defaultKey);
206	    if (!binding) return null;
207	    const account = await getDoc(doc(db, 'accounts', binding.accountId));
208	    if (!account.exists()) return null;
209	    const resolved = { id: account.id, ...account.data() };
210	    return this.isPostingAccount(resolved) ? resolved : null;
211	  }
212	
213	  validateNaturalBalanceLimit(account: any, delta: number): void {
214	    const limit = Number(readValue(account, 'limitedBalance', 'limited_balance') || 0);
215	    if (!Number.isFinite(limit) || limit <= 0) return;
216	    const current = Number(readValue(account, 'balance', 'balance') || 0);
217	    const next = current + Number(delta || 0);
218	    if (next > limit) {
219	      throw new Error(`Account ${readCode(account)} exceeds its configured natural balance limit.`);
220	    }
221	  }
222	}

30	    }
31	
32	    const existingIds = new Set<string>();
33	    const existingCodes = new Set<string>();
34	    const existingNumbersForPrefix = new Set<string>();
35	
36	    let maxSeq = 0;
37	
38	    for (const acc of allAccounts) {
39	      if (acc.id) existingIds.add(String(acc.id));
40	
41	      const accCode = String(acc.accountCode || acc.code || '').trim();
42	      if (accCode) existingCodes.add(accCode);
43	
44	      const rawCode = String(acc.code || '').trim();
45	      if (rawCode) existingCodes.add(rawCode);
46	
47	      const accNum = String(acc.accountNumber || '').trim();
48	      const accPrefix = String(acc.accountPrefix || acc.parentCode || '').trim();
49	
50	      if (accPrefix === prefix || accCode.startsWith(`${prefix}-`)) {
51	        if (accNum) existingNumbersForPrefix.add(accNum);
52	
53	        const parts = accCode.split("-");
54	        if (parts.length >= 2) {
55	          const num = parseInt(parts[parts.length - 1], 10);
56	          if (!isNaN(num) && num > maxSeq) {
57	            maxSeq = num;
58	          }
59	        }
60	        if (accNum) {
61	          const num = parseInt(accNum, 10);
62	          if (!isNaN(num) && num > maxSeq) {
63	            maxSeq = num;
64	          }
65	        }
66	      }
67	    }
68	
69	    for (const ent of entityDocs) {
70	      if (ent.id) existingIds.add(String(ent.id));
71	    }
72	
73	    let candidateSeq = hierarchyLocation
74	      ? await accountingHierarchyService.getNextAccountSequence({ ...hierarchyLocation, accountCode: prefix })
75	      : Math.max(maxSeq + 1, allAccounts.length + 1, 1);
76	
77	    while (true) {
78	      const seqStr = String(candidateSeq).padStart(4, "0");
79	      const candidateCode = hierarchyCodeRules.formatPostingCode(prefix, candidateSeq);
80	      // الحساب المالي الورقي يُعرّف بالكود المحاسبي نفسه؛ لا تستخدم بادئة acc_.
81	      const candidateId = candidateCode;
82	      const candidateCustId = `cust_${candidateCode}`;
83	      const candidateEmpId = `emp_${candidateCode}`;
84	      const candidateCourId = `cour_${candidateCode}`;
85	
86	      const isCodeTaken = existingCodes.has(candidateCode);
87	      const isIdTaken = existingIds.has(candidateId) || existingIds.has(candidateCustId) || existingIds.has(candidateEmpId) || existingIds.has(candidateCourId);
88	      const isNumTaken = existingNumbersForPrefix.has(seqStr);
89	
90	      if (!isCodeTaken && !isIdTaken && !isNumTaken) {
91	        return {
92	          prefix,
93	          accountNumber: seqStr,
94	          accountCode: candidateCode,
95	          code: candidateCode,
96	          accountId: candidateId,
97	        };
98	      }
99	      candidateSeq++;
100	    }
101	  }
102	
103	export async function createFinancialEntityAccount(service: any, entityType: AccountEntityType, entityId: string, entityName: string, currency: string, monthlySalary?: number, options?: {
104	      accountPrefix?: string;
105	      accountType?: FinancialAccount["type"];
106	      parentCode?: string;
107	      notes?: string;
108	      updateEntity?: boolean;
109	    }): Promise<FinancialAccount> {
110	    try {
111	      // 1. Prevent duplicate account creation for the same entityId
112	      const existing = await service.getAccountByEntityId(entityId, entityType);
113	      if (existing && existing.id) {
114	        const now = Date.now();
115	        const existingUpdate = {
116	          entityName,
117	          currency: currency || existing.currency,
118	          type: options?.accountType || existing.type,
119	          updatedAt: now,
120	        };
121	        await updateDoc(doc(db, "accounts", existing.id), existingUpdate);
122	        if (entityType !== "system" && options?.updateEntity !== false) {
123	          await updateDoc(doc(db, service.getEntityCollection(entityType), entityId), {
124	            accountId: existing.id,
125	            updatedAt: now,
126	          });
127	        }
128	        return { ...existing, ...existingUpdate };
129	      }
130	
131	      // 2. Generate guaranteed unique account identifiers
132	      const hierarchyLocation = await accountingHierarchyService.getEntityPostingLocation(entityType);
133	      if (!hierarchyLocation && await accountingHierarchyService.hasHierarchyStructure()) {
134	        throw new Error(`لا يمكن إنشاء حساب «${entityName}»: لا توجد مجموعة نشطة لنوع الكيان «${entityType}» في شجرة الحسابات.`);
135	      }
136	      const hierarchyPrefix = hierarchyLocation?.accountCode;
137	      const { prefix, accountNumber, accountCode, code, accountId } =
138	        await service.getNextAccountIdentifiers(entityType, options?.accountPrefix || hierarchyPrefix);
139	      let currencyId: number | undefined;
140	      try {
141	        currencyId = await accountingHierarchyService.getCurrencyIdByCode(currency);
142	      } catch (currencyError) {
143	        console.warn('[FinancialAccountService] Currency reference lookup deferred:', currencyError);
144	      }
145	      // تستخدم عملة عقدة الشجرة فقط عندما لا يحدد الحساب المالي عملة صريحة.
146	      currencyId ??= hierarchyLocation?.currencyId;
147	
148	      const now = Date.now();
149	      const accountData: FinancialAccount = {
150	        id: accountId,
151	        accountCode,
152	        code,
153	        accountPrefix: prefix,
154	        accountNumber,
155	        entityType,
156	        entityId,
157	        entityName,
158	        currency,
159	        balance: 0,
160	        isActive: true,
161	        createdAt: now,
162	        updatedAt: now,
163	        notes: options?.notes || "",
164	        type:
165	          options?.accountType ||
166	          (([
167	            "courier",
168	            "employee",
169	            "source",
170	            "shipping_company",
171	          ] as AccountEntityType[]).includes(entityType)
172	            ? "Liability"
173	            : "Asset"),
174	        accSubId: hierarchyLocation?.accSubId,
175	        groupId: hierarchyLocation?.groupId,
176	        accountSeq: Number(accountNumber),
177	        accNameAr: entityName,
178	        accNameEn: entityName,
179	        limitedBalance: 0,
180	        lastRecalculatedAt: new Date(now).toISOString(),
181	        curNo: currencyId,
182	      } as any;
183	
184	      // Save document with explicit unique ID
185	      await setDoc(doc(db, "accounts", accountId), accountData);
186	
187	      // Update the entity's document with the account code reference
188	      if (entityType !== "system" && options?.updateEntity !== false) {
189	        try {
190	          const entityCollection = service.getEntityCollection(entityType);
191	          const entityUpdateData: any = {
192	            accountId: accountId,
193	            updatedAt: now,
194	          };
195	          if (monthlySalary !== undefined) {
196	            entityUpdateData.monthlySalary = monthlySalary;
197	          }
198	          await updateDoc(
199	            doc(db, entityCollection, entityId),
200	            entityUpdateData,
201	          );
202	        } catch (e) {
203	          console.warn("Could not update entity doc with account_id", e);
204	        }
205	      }
206	
207	      activityLogService.log("create_financial_account" as any, entityName, {
208	        accountCode,
209	        entityType,
210	        entityId,
211	      });
212	
213	      return { id: accountId, ...accountData };
214	    } catch (error) {
215	      console.error("[FinancialAccountService] Error creating account:", error);
216	      throw error;
217	    }
218	  }

3	export async function purgeEntityAndFinancialFootprint(service: any, entityType: 'customer' | 'courier' | 'user' | 'employee', entityId: string): Promise<void> {
4	    try {
5	      // Step 0: Check if entity is linked to any orders in 'orders' collection
6	      const ordersSnap = await getDocs(collection(db, "orders"));
7	      const isLinkedToOrders = ordersSnap.docs.some(doc => {
8	        const o = doc.data();
9	        if (entityType === 'customer') {
10	          return o.customerId === entityId || o.customer?.id === entityId;
11	        } else if (entityType === 'courier') {
12	          return (
13	            o.courierId === entityId ||
14	            o.driverId === entityId ||
15	            o.courier?.id === entityId ||
16	            o.deliveryCourierId === entityId ||
17	            o.delivery_courier_id === entityId ||
18	            o.shippingCourierId === entityId ||
19	            o.shipping_courier_id === entityId
20	          );
21	        } else if (entityType === 'employee') {
22	          return o.employeeId === entityId;
23	        }
24	        return false;
25	      });
26	
27	      if (isLinkedToOrders) {
28	        const label = entityType === 'customer' ? 'العميل' : (entityType === 'courier' ? 'المندوب' : entityType === 'user' ? 'المستخدم' : 'الموظف');
29	        throw new Error(`تعذر الحذف: هذا الـ (${label}) مرتبط بطلبات مسجلة في جدول الطلبات. يرجى فك ارتباط الطلبات أو حذفها أولاً والمحاولة مرة أخرى.`);
30	      }
31	
32	      const batch = writeBatch(db);
33	      const affectedAccountIds = new Set<string>();
34	
35	      // 1. Find the associated financial account
36	      const accountQuery = query(
37	        collection(db, "accounts"),
38	        where("entityId", "==", entityId)
39	      );
40	      const accountSnap = await getDocs(accountQuery);
41	      let accountId = "";
42	
43	      if (!accountSnap.empty) {
44	        const accountDoc = accountSnap.docs[0];
45	        accountId = accountDoc.id;
46	
47	        // 2. Find all account_trans legs linked to this account
48	        // استعلام أسطر الحسابات من جدول account_trans الجديد
49	        const txQuery = query(
50	          collection(db, "account_trans"),
51	          where("accountId", "==", accountId)
52	        );
53	        const txSnap = await getDocs(txQuery);
54	
55	        const refNumbers = new Set<string>();
56	        const mainEntryIds = new Set<string>();
57	
58	        txSnap.docs.forEach((d) => {
59	          const tx = d.data();
60	          const entryId = tx.entryId || tx.mainEntryId;
61	          if (entryId) {
62	            mainEntryIds.add(entryId);
63	          }
64	          if (tx.refNumber) {
65	            refNumbers.add(tx.refNumber);
66	          }
67	        });
68	
69	
70	        // 3. Fetch and delete all related transaction double-entry legs
71	        const allTxDocsToDelete = new Map<string, any>(); // docId -> docRef
72	
73	        if (mainEntryIds.size > 0) {
74	          const jvIdsArray = Array.from(mainEntryIds);
75	          for (const jvId of jvIdsArray) {
76	            const q = query(collection(db, "account_trans"), where("entryId", "==", jvId));
77	            const snap = await getDocs(q);
78	            snap.docs.forEach(docItem => {
79	              allTxDocsToDelete.set(docItem.id, docItem.ref);
80	              const txData = docItem.data();
81	              if (txData.accountId && txData.accountId !== accountId) {
82	                affectedAccountIds.add(txData.accountId);
83	              }
84	            });
85	            // حذف رأس القيد من main_entry
86	            batch.delete(doc(db, "main_entry", jvId));
87	          }
88	        }
89	
90	        if (refNumbers.size > 0) {
91	          const refsArray = Array.from(refNumbers);
92	          for (const refNo of refsArray) {
93	            const q = query(collection(db, "account_trans"), where("refNumber", "==", refNo));
94	            const snap = await getDocs(q);
95	            snap.docs.forEach(docItem => {
96	              allTxDocsToDelete.set(docItem.id, docItem.ref);
97	              const txData = docItem.data();
98	              if (txData.accountId && txData.accountId !== accountId) {
99	                affectedAccountIds.add(txData.accountId);
100	              }
101	            });
102	
103	          }
104	        }
105	
106	        // Add direct legs linked to this account
107	        txSnap.docs.forEach(d => {
108	          allTxDocsToDelete.set(d.id, d.ref);
109	        });
110	
111	        // Delete all collected transaction leg documents using direct refs
112	        allTxDocsToDelete.forEach(ref => {
113	          batch.delete(ref);
114	        });
115	
116	
117	        // Delete the main accounts document
118	        batch.delete(accountDoc.ref);
119	      }
120	
121	      // 4. Delete the core entity document
122	      const collectionName = entityType === 'user' ? 'users' : (entityType === 'employee' ? 'employees' : (entityType === 'courier' ? 'couriers' : 'customers'));
123	      batch.delete(doc(db, collectionName, entityId));
124	
125	      // 5. Commit all deletions
126	      await batch.commit();
127	
128	      // 6. Recalculate & sync all financial balances system-wide
129	      await service.recalculateAllBalances();
130	    } catch (err) {
131	      console.error(`[purgeEntityAndFinancialFootprint] Purge failed:`, err);
132	      throw err;
133	    }
134	  }

5	/**
6	 * Compatibility report surface for callers outside the unified FinanceEntries page.
7	 * The report source is the normalized ledger only: posted main_entry headers and
8	 * their account_trans lines. No legacy expenditure collection is queried.

18	      (error) => console.warn('FinanceReports: main_entry subscription error:', error),
19	    );
20	    const unsubLines = onSnapshot(
21	      query(collection(db, 'account_trans'), orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')),
22	      (snap) => setLines(snap.docs.map((doc: any) => ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() }))),
23	      (error) => console.warn('FinanceReports: account_trans subscription error:', error),
24	    );
25	    return () => {

27	      unsubLines();
28	    };
29	  }, []);
30

32	  const postedLines = lines.filter((tx) => {
33	    const entry = entryById.get(tx.entryId || tx.main_entry_id);
34	    return tx.entry?.postingStatus === 'posted' || (entry && entry.postingStatus === 'posted');

36

39	      <h2 className="text-sm font-black text-white">Financial Reports</h2>

41	        {postedLines.length.toLocaleString()} posted ledger lines from {entries.length.toLocaleString()} entry headers.
42	      </p>
43	    </section>
44	  );

707	  private _recalcDebounce: Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>> = new Map();
708	  async recalculateAndSyncBalance(accountId: string): Promise<number> {

717	      });
718	      if (error) {

729	  /**
730	   * Debounced recalculateAndSyncBalance — safe to call many times quickly.
731	   * Only executes once per accountId within a 2-second window.
732	   */
733	  recalculateAndSyncBalanceDebounced(accountId: string, delayMs = 2000): void {
734	    if (this._recalcDebounce.has(accountId)) {
735	      clearTimeout(this._recalcDebounce.get(accountId)!);
736	    }
737	    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
738	      this._recalcDebounce.delete(accountId);
739	      this.recalculateAndSyncBalance(accountId).catch(console.error);
740	    }, delayMs);
741	    this._recalcDebounce.set(accountId, timer);
742	  }

744	  /**
745	   * Recalculate and sync ALL accounts in the system.
746	   * Returns a summary of accounts processed and any errors encountered.
747	   * Useful for migration / reconciliation runs.
748	   */
749	  async recalculateAllBalances(): Promise<{
750	    processed: number;
751	    errors: number;
752	    results: Array<{ accountId: string; accountCode: string; oldBalance: number; newBalance: number }>;
753	  }> {
754	    const results: Array<{ accountId: string; accountCode: string; oldBalance: number; newBalance: number }> = [];
755	    let errors = 0;
756	
757	    try {
758	      const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, "accounts"));
759	      const docs = snap.docs;
760	
761	      // Process in parallel batches of 5 to avoid overwhelming the DB while still being fast
762	      const BATCH_SIZE = 5;
763	      for (let i = 0; i < docs.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
764	        const batch = docs.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
765	        await Promise.all(batch.map(async (d) => {
766	          const data = d.data() as FinancialAccount;
767	          const oldBalance = data.balance || 0;
768	          try {
769	            const newBalance = await this.recalculateAndSyncBalance(d.id);
770	            results.push({
771	              accountId: d.id,
772	              accountCode: data.accountCode || d.id,
773	              oldBalance,
774	              newBalance,
775	            });
776	          } catch (err) {
777	            errors++;
778	            console.error(`[recalculateAllBalances] Error on account ${d.id}:`, err);
779	          }
780	        }));
781	      }
782	    } catch (err) {
783	      console.error("[recalculateAllBalances] Fatal error loading accounts:", err);
784	    }
785	
786	    return { processed: results.length, errors, results };
787	  }

96	  async getAccountByEntityId(
97	    entityId: string,
98	    entityType?: AccountEntityType,
99	  ): Promise<FinancialAccount | null> {
100	    try {
101	      const constraints = [where("entityId", "==", entityId)];
102	      if (entityType) constraints.push(where("entityType", "==", entityType));
103	      const q = query(collection(db, "accounts"), ...constraints);
104	      const snap = await getDocs(q);
105	      if (snap.empty) return null;
106	      const docData = snap.docs[0];
107	      return { id: docData.id, ...docData.data() } as FinancialAccount;
108	    } catch (error) {
109	      console.error("[FinancialAccountService] Error fetching account:", error);
110	      return null;
111	    }
112	  }
113	
114	  /**
115	   * Get account by account ID directly
116	   */
117	  async getAccountById(accountId: string): Promise<FinancialAccount | null> {
118	    try {
119	      const docRef = await getDoc(doc(db, "accounts", accountId));
120	      if (docRef.exists()) {
121	        return { id: docRef.id, ...docRef.data() } as FinancialAccount;
122	      }
123	      // جسر قراءة مؤقت للمراجع التاريخية فقط إلى حين ترحيل المعرفات النهائي.
124	      const legacyCode = String(accountId || '').replace(/^acc_/, '').replace(/_/g, '-');
125	      if (legacyCode && legacyCode !== accountId) {
126	        const byCode = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "accounts"), where("accountCode", "==", legacyCode)));
127	        if (!byCode.empty) {
128	          const matched = byCode.docs[0];
129	          return { id: matched.id, ...matched.data() } as FinancialAccount;
130	        }
131	      }
132	      const mappedLegacyId = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "account_id_migration_map"), where("oldAccountId", "==", accountId)));
133	      if (!mappedLegacyId.empty) {
134	        const mapping = mappedLegacyId.docs[0].data();
135	        const mappedAccountId = String(mapping.newAccountId || mapping.new_account_id || '').trim();
136	        if (mappedAccountId) {
137	          const mappedAccount = await getDoc(doc(db, "accounts", mappedAccountId));
138	          if (mappedAccount.exists()) return { id: mappedAccount.id, ...mappedAccount.data() } as FinancialAccount;
139	        }
140	      }
141	      // Fallback: search by entityId if not found by primary doc ID
142	      return this.getAccountByEntityId(accountId);
143	    } catch (error) {
144	      console.error(
145	        "[FinancialAccountService] Error fetching account by ID:",
146	        error,
147	      );
148	      return null;
149	    }
150	  }

152	  private getAccountTypeByCode(code: string): string {
153	    const cleanCode = code.trim().toUpperCase();
154	    if (cleanCode.startsWith("REV")) return "Revenue";
155	    if (cleanCode.startsWith("EXP")) return "Expense";
156	    if (cleanCode.startsWith("AST") || cleanCode.startsWith("ASS"))
157	      return "Asset";
158	    if (cleanCode.startsWith("LIAB")) return "Liability";
159	    if (cleanCode.startsWith("EQU")) return "Equity";
160	
161	    const firstChar = cleanCode.charAt(0);
162	    switch (firstChar) {
163	      case "1":
164	        return "Asset";
165	      case "2":
166	        return "Liability";
167	      case "3":
168	        return "Equity";
169	      case "4":
170	        return "Revenue";
171	      case "5":
172	        return "Expense";
173	      default:
174	        return "Asset";
175	    }
176	  }

-- SwiftShip accounting hierarchy — default account bindings
-- Binds existing active system posting accounts by their stable entity_id values.
-- Does not create financial accounts, balances, rates, or transactions.

INSERT INTO public.default_accounts (id, default_key, account_id, acc_name_ar, acc_name_en, cur_no, is_active)
SELECT
  defaults.default_key,
  defaults.default_key,
  accounts.id,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(accounts.acc_name_ar, ''), NULLIF(accounts.data->>'entityName', ''), defaults.acc_name_ar),
  COALESCE(NULLIF(accounts.acc_name_en, ''), NULLIF(accounts.data->>'nameEn', ''), defaults.acc_name_en),
  accounts.cur_no,
  accounts.is_active
FROM (VALUES
  ('sys_cash_account', 'حساب الصندوق الرئيسي', 'Main cash account'),
  ('sys_orders_cost', 'حساب تكاليف الطلبات والشحن', 'Order and shipment cost account'),
  ('sys_profit_account', 'حساب أرباح الشركة', 'Company profit account'),
  ('sys_delivery_cost', 'حساب مصروفات التوصيل', 'Delivery expense account'),
  ('sys_sourcing_cost', 'حساب تكاليف التوريد والاستيراد', 'Sourcing and import cost account'),
  ('sys_packaging_fees', 'حساب رسوم التغليف والتعبئة', 'Packaging fees account'),
  ('sys_shipping_costs', 'حساب تكاليف الشحن الدولي', 'International shipping cost account'),
  ('sys_local_shipping', 'حساب تكاليف الشحن المحلي', 'Local shipping cost account')
) AS defaults(default_key, acc_name_ar, acc_name_en)
INNER JOIN public.accounts ON accounts.entity_id = defaults.default_key
  AND accounts.entity_type = 'system'
  AND accounts.is_active = true
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

COMMENT ON TABLE public.default_accounts IS 'ربط حسابات النظام الورقية بمفاتيح قابلة للإدارة. لا تعتمد خدمات القيود على كود ثابت بعد إكمال الترحيل.';

Summary of key items per file:

**Legacy shim (context)**: src/data/legacy/legacy-compat.ts = `export * from '../../lib/supabase-adapter'`. supabase-adapter.ts:
- `supabase` = createSupabaseStub() → chainable Proxy; every `.from(t).select/insert/update/delete/upsert` and `.rpc(fn,args)` resolves to `{data:[], error:null, count:0}` (for single → `{data:null,error:null}`). So reads are always empty, writes never reach the network.
- Firestore-style API: collection/db/doc/query/where/orderBy/limit/or/getDocs/getDoc/addDoc/addAssDoc/setDoc/updateDoc/deleteDoc/writeBatch/onSnapshot operate against an in-memory `collectionCaches` table seeded from localStorage key `swiftship_table_backup_<table>`; writes only mutate the cache+localStorage. Network fetch is disabled (ensureCache never goes to the network).
- addAssDoc(newID, assetCode, collectionRef, rawData) (adapter lines 663-698): like addDoc but injects `assetCode` into the writePayload/newItem; inserts into cache via `supabase.from(table).insert` (noop) and pushes item `{[pkCol]:id, id, assetCode, ...directCols, data}` into collectionCaches[table] + localStorage. PK of assets = asset_id.
- MockWriteBatch queues set/update/delete then runs them sequentially on commit.
- onSnapshot reads from cache only, notifies listeners registered per table.

# Legacy shim mechanics (context)

`src/data/legacy/legacy-compat.ts` = `export * from '../../lib/supabase-adapter'` (only line 6; file is a pure re-export).
`src/lib/supabase-adapter.ts`:
- `supabase` = `createSupabaseStub()` (L18–59): chainable **no-op Proxy** — every `.from(t).select/insert/update/delete` and `.rpc(fn, args)` resolves `{data:[], error:null, count:0}` (`single()` → `{data:null}`). All network reads return empty; all supabase writes silently "succeed" doing nothing.
- Firestore-style API (`collection/db/doc/query/where/orderBy/getDocs/getDoc/addDoc/setDoc/updateDoc/deleteDoc/writeBatch/onSnapshot`) operates on an **in-memory `collectionCaches`** seeded from localStorage `swiftship_table_backup_<table>`; writes mutate only cache+localStorage. `ensureCache` (L266–297) never fetches.
- **`addAssDoc`** (L663–698): like `addDoc` but takes `(newID, assetCode, collectionRef, rawData)` and injects `assetCode` into the insert payload/cache row. PKs from `getTablePrimaryKey` (`supabase-adapter-columns.ts`); `assets` PK = `asset_id`, `accounts` = `account_id`, `main_entry` = `main_entry_id`, `account_trans` = `account_trans_id`, `auto_entries` = `auto_entry_id`, `currency` = `cur_id`, `users` = `user_id`, `default_accounts` = `default_account_id`. `assets`, `accounts`, tree tables, `users`, entity tables are **explicit-column** tables (no `data` jsonb).
- `writeBatch(db)` = `MockWriteBatch` (L947–971): queued set/update/delete executed sequentially on `commit()`.

#### Thinking

Bug: the array has 18 items, but the query says $1 text[] — I ended up passing 18 tables including 'orders'... count: assets, account, acc_main, acc_sub, acc_sub_group, accounts, default_accounts, salary_history, account_id_migration_map, entry_module, entry_type, settings, auto_entries, users, main_entry, account_trans, employees, orders = 18. The query is role_table_grants with table_name = any($1::text[]) — 1 parameter. But the error says it was given 18 parameters and 1 is required — did pg expand the array? No, when you pass a JS array to pg for `= any($1::text[])` it gets erroneously serialized (pg converts arrays into multiple parameters ($1,$2...) with implicit expansion) — yeah, node-pg automatically converts arrays into a list of parameters. Fix: use the string literal form `= any($1::text[])` and pass it in the `{ name, type }` format, or simply embed a text array literal: passing JSON.stringify and then `::text[]`? The easiest way: build an IN list with unnest(string_to_array). Change to `= any(string_to_array($1, ','))`.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.manage_financial_entry_setting(p_kind text, p_action text, p_id text, p_payload jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_permission text;
  v_actor_id text;
  v_code text := upper(btrim(COALESCE(p_payload->>'code', '')));
  v_name_ar text := btrim(COALESCE(p_payload->>'nameAr', ''));
  v_name_en text := btrim(COALESCE(p_payload->>'nameEn', ''));
  v_note text := COALESCE(p_payload->>'note', '');
  v_module_id text := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_payload->>'moduleId', '')), '');
  v_is_active boolean := COALESCE((p_payload->>'isActive')::boolean, true);
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF p_action NOT IN ('create', 'update', 'delete') OR p_kind NOT IN ('module', 'type') OR p_id IS NULL OR btrim(p_id) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'طلب إدارة إعدادات القيود غير صالح.';
  END IF;

  v_permission := CASE p_action WHEN 'create' THEN 'create_entry_settings' WHEN 'update' THEN 'edit_entry_settings' ELSE 'delete_entry_settings' END;
  v_actor_id := public.require_financial_entry_settings_permission(v_permission);

  IF p_action <> 'delete' THEN
    IF v_code !~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{1,63}$' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'رمز الفئة أو النوع يجب أن يبدأ بحرف إنجليزي ويحتوي أحرفًا كبيرة أو أرقامًا أو شرطات سفلية فقط.';
    END IF;
    IF v_name_ar = '' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'الاسم العربي مطلوب.';
    END IF;
    IF v_name_en = '' THEN
      v_name_en := v_name_ar;
    END IF;
    IF p_kind = 'type' AND (v_module_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.entry_module WHERE entry_module_id = v_module_id)) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'فئة القيد المرتبطة بالنوع غير موجودة.';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF p_kind = 'module' AND p_action = 'create' THEN
    INSERT INTO public.entry_module (entry_module_id, code, name_ar, name_en, note, is_active, created_by_uid, updated_by_uid)
    VALUES (p_id, v_code, v_name_ar, v_name_en, v_note, v_is_active, v_actor_id, v_actor_id)
    RETURNING jsonb_build_object('id', entry_module_id, 'code', code, 'nameAr', name_ar, 'nameEn', name_en, 'isActive', is_active) INTO v_result;
  ELSIF p_kind = 'module' AND p_action = 'update' THEN
    UPDATE public.entry_module SET code = v_code, name_ar = v_name_ar, name_en = v_name_en, note = v_note, is_active = v_is_active, updated_at = now(), updated_by_uid = v_actor_id
    WHERE entry_module_id = p_id
    RETURNING jsonb_build_object('id', entry_module_id, 'code', code, 'nameAr', name_ar, 'nameEn', name_en, 'isActive', is_active) INTO v_result;
  ELSIF p_kind = 'module' AND p_action = 'delete' THEN
    DELETE FROM public.entry_module WHERE entry_module_id = p_id
    RETURNING jsonb_build_object('id', entry_module_id, 'deleted', true) INTO v_result;
  ELSIF p_kind = 'type' AND p_action = 'create' THEN
    INSERT INTO public.entry_type (entry_type_id, code, module_id, name_ar, name_en, note, is_active, created_by_uid, updated_by_uid)
    VALUES (p_id, v_code, v_module_id, v_name_ar, v_name_en, v_note, v_is_active, v_actor_id, v_actor_id)
    RETURNING jsonb_build_object('id', entry_type_id, 'code', code, 'moduleId', module_id, 'nameAr', name_ar, 'nameEn', name_en, 'isActive', is_active) INTO v_result;
  ELSIF p_kind = 'type' AND p_action = 'update' THEN
    UPDATE public.entry_type SET code = v_code, module_id = v_module_id, name_ar = v_name_ar, name_en = v_name_en, note = v_note, is_active = v_is_active, updated_at = now(), updated_by_uid = v_actor_id
    WHERE entry_type_id = p_id
    RETURNING jsonb_build_object('id', entry_type_id, 'code', code, 'moduleId', module_id, 'nameAr', name_ar, 'nameEn', name_en, 'isActive', is_active) INTO v_result;
  ELSE
    DELETE FROM public.entry_type WHERE entry_type_id = p_id
    RETURNING jsonb_build_object('id', entry_type_id, 'deleted', true) INTO v_result;
  END IF;

  IF v_result IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سجل إعداد القيد غير موجود أو تعذر تنفيذ العملية.';
  END IF;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.require_financial_entry_settings_permission(p_permission text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor_id text := auth.uid()::text;
  v_role text;
  v_disabled boolean;
  v_permissions jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF v_actor_id IS NULL OR btrim(v_actor_id) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تتطلب عملية إعدادات القيود جلسة مستخدم موثقة.';
  END IF;
  SELECT u.role, COALESCE(u.disabled, false) INTO v_role, v_disabled FROM public.users u WHERE u.user_id = v_actor_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_disabled THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'حساب المستخدم غير صالح أو معطل.';
  END IF;
  IF v_role = 'Admin' THEN
    RETURN v_actor_id;
  END IF;
  SELECT r.data->'permissions' INTO v_permissions FROM public.roles r WHERE r.role_id = v_role;
  IF COALESCE(v_permissions, '[]'::jsonb) ? '*' OR COALESCE(v_permissions, '[]'::jsonb) ? p_permission THEN
    RETURN v_actor_id;
  END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا تملك صلاحية % لإدارة إعدادات القيود.', p_permission;
END;
$function$

export function createFinanceRepository(pool: Pool): FinanceRepository {
  return {
    async listAccounts(input) {
      const [limit, offset] = page(input);
      const search = input.search ? `%${input.search}%` : null;
      const count = await pool.query<{ total: string }>(
        'SELECT count(*)::text AS total FROM public.accounts WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR account_code ILIKE $1 OR acc_name_ar ILIKE $1 OR acc_name_en ILIKE $1) AND is_active IS TRUE',
        [search],
      );
      const rows = await pool.query(
        `SELECT ${accountColumns} FROM public.accounts WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR account_code ILIKE $1 OR acc_name_ar ILIKE $1 OR acc_name_en ILIKE $1) AND is_active IS TRUE ORDER BY account_code NULLS LAST, account_id LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3`,
        [search, limit, offset],
      );
      return { items: rows.rows, total: Number(count.rows[0]?.total ?? 0) };
    },
    async getAccount(accountId) {
      const result = await pool.query(`SELECT ${accountColumns} FROM public.accounts WHERE account_id = $1 LIMIT 1`, [
        accountId,
      ]);
      return result.rows[0] ?? null;
    },
    async listAccountMovements(accountId, input) {
      const [limit, offset] = page(input);
      const count = await pool.query<{ total: string }>(
        'SELECT count(*)::text AS total FROM public.account_trans WHERE account_id = $1',
        [accountId],
      );
      const rows = await pool.query(
        `SELECT ${movementColumns} FROM public.account_trans at JOIN public.main_entry me ON me.main_entry_id = at.main_entry_id WHERE at.account_id = $1 AND me.posting_status = 'posted' ORDER BY at.created_at DESC, at.line_no DESC LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3`,
        [accountId, limit, offset],
      );
      return { items: rows.rows, total: Number(count.rows[0]?.total ?? 0) };
    },
    async listAllAccountMovements(input) {
      const [limit, offset] = page(input);
      const count = await pool.query<{ total: string }>(
        "SELECT count(*)::text AS total FROM public.account_trans at JOIN public.main_entry me ON me.main_entry_id = at.main_entry_id WHERE me.posting_status = 'posted'",
      );
      const rows = await pool.query(
        `SELECT ${movementColumns} FROM public.account_trans at JOIN public.main_entry me ON me.main_entry_id = at.main_entry_id WHERE me.posting_status = 'posted' ORDER BY at.created_at DESC, at.main_entry_id DESC, at.line_no DESC LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2`,
        [limit, offset],
      );
      return { items: rows.rows, total: Number(count.rows[0]?.total ?? 0) };
    },
    async listEntryModules() {
      const result = await pool.query(
        'SELECT entry_module_id AS "moduleId", code, name_ar AS "nameAr", name_en AS "nameEn", note, is_active AS "isActive" FROM public.entry_module WHERE is_active IS TRUE ORDER BY code, entry_module_id',
      );
      return result.rows;
    },
    async listEntryTypes(moduleId) {
      const result = await pool.query(
        'SELECT entry_type_id AS "entryTypeId", code, module_id AS "moduleId", name_ar AS "nameAr", name_en AS "nameEn", note, is_active AS "isActive" FROM public.entry_type WHERE is_active IS TRUE AND ($1::text IS NULL OR module_id = $1) ORDER BY code, entry_type_id',
        [moduleId ?? null],
      );
      return result.rows;
    },
    async listEntries(input) {
      const [limit, offset] = page(input);
      const search = input.search ? `%${input.search}%` : null;
      const count = await pool.query<{ total: string }>(
        'SELECT count(*)::text AS total FROM public.main_entry WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR entry_number ILIKE $1 OR description ILIKE $1)',
        [search],
      );
      const rows = await pool.query(
        `SELECT ${entryColumns} FROM public.main_entry WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR entry_number ILIKE $1 OR description ILIKE $1) ORDER BY effective_at DESC, main_entry_id DESC LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3`,
        [search, limit, offset],
      );
      return { items: rows.rows, total: Number(count.rows[0]?.total ?? 0) };
    },
    async getEntry(entryId) {
      const entry = await pool.query(`SELECT ${entryColumns} FROM public.main_entry WHERE main_entry_id = $1 LIMIT 1`, [
        entryId,
      ]);
      if (!entry.rows[0]) return null;
      const lines = await pool.query(
        `SELECT account_trans_id AS "transactionId", main_entry_id AS "entryId", line_no AS "lineNo", trans_type AS "transType", account_id AS "accountId", account_cur_no AS "accountCurrencyNo", amount, amount_original AS "amountOriginal", currency_original_no AS "currencyOriginalNo", currency_price_id AS "currencyPriceId", currency_price_seq AS "currencyPriceSeq", payment_method AS "paymentMethod", entity_type AS "entityType", entity_id AS "entityId", order_id AS "orderId", shipment_id AS "shipmentId", custody_id AS "custodyId", auto_rule_id AS "autoRuleId", automation_key AS "automationKey", description, note, created_at AS "createdAt" FROM public.account_trans WHERE main_entry_id = $1 ORDER BY line_no`,
        [entryId],
      );
      const payments = await pool.query(
        `SELECT entry_payment_detail_id AS "paymentDetailId", allocation_no AS "allocationNo", payment_method AS "paymentMethod", account_id AS "accountId", amount_original AS "amountOriginal", currency_original_no AS "currencyOriginalNo", bank_reference AS "bankReference", due_at AS "dueAt", note FROM public.entry_payment_details WHERE main_entry_id = $1 ORDER BY allocation_no`,
        [entryId],
      );

7:export function requirePermission(useCases: AuthUseCases | undefined, permissionCode: string): RequestHandler {
import type { NextFunction, Request, RequestHandler, Response } from 'express';
import { sendFailure } from '../http/response';
import type { AuthPrincipalDto, AuthUseCases } from '../../modules/auth/auth.contracts';

const PERMISSION_CODE_PATTERN = /^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{1,127}$/;

export function requirePermission(useCases: AuthUseCases | undefined, permissionCode: string): RequestHandler {
  if (!PERMISSION_CODE_PATTERN.test(permissionCode)) {
    throw new TypeError('A canonical permission code is required.');
  }

  return async (_request: Request, response: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    const requestId = String(response.locals.requestId ?? '');
    const principal = response.locals.authPrincipal as AuthPrincipalDto | undefined;
    if (!useCases || !principal?.userId) {
      sendFailure(response, 401, 'AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'بيانات المصادقة غير صحيحة.', requestId);
      return;
    }

    try {
      const permissions = await useCases.listPermissions({ userId: principal.userId });
      if (!permissions.includes(permissionCode)) {
        sendFailure(response, 403, 'AUTH_FORBIDDEN', 'لا تملك الصلاحية المطلوبة.', requestId);
        return;
      }
      next();
    } catch (error) {
      next(error);
    }
  };

```json
{
  "content": "/**\n * Shared SQL record helpers used by repository modules.\n * المساعدات المشتركة لبناء أعمدة السجلات في طبقة المستودعات.\n */\n\n/**\n * Keep only fields the caller explicitly provided (undefined = unchanged,\n * null = clear the column) and map them through a camelCase→snake_case whitelist.\n * تُدخل الحقول المرسلة صراحة فقط (undefined = بدون تغيير، null = مسح القيمة) عبر قائمة أعمدة معتمدة.\n */\nexport function presentColumnEntries(\n  input: object,\n  columnMap: Record<string, string>,\n): Array<[string, unknown]> {\n  const entries: Array<[string, unknown]> = [];\n  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(input)) {\n    const column = columnMap[key];\n    if (column !== undefined && value !== undefined) entries.push([column, value ?? null]);\n  }\n  return entries;\n}\n\n/**\n * Run a callback on a dedicated pooled connection inside a transaction where\n * request.jwt.claims is set to the acting user, so legacy SECURITY DEFINER RPCs\n * that resolve auth.uid() keep working when invoked through the API runtime role.\n * تنفيذ داخل معاملة على اتصال مخصص مع ضبط request.jwt.claims بمعرّف المستخدم المنفّذ\n * لتبقى دوال RPC الآمنة (auth.uid) تعمل عند استدعائها عبر حساب تشغيل alx_api.\n */\nexport async function withActorClaims<T>(\n  connect: () => Promise<ActorClaimClient>,\n  actorId: string,\n  run: (client: ActorClaimClient) => Promise<T>,\n): Promise<T> {\n  const client = await connect();\n  try {\n    await client.query('BEGIN');\n    await client.query(\"SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', $1, TRUE)\", [JSON.stringify({ sub: actorId })]);\n    const result = await run(client);\n    await client.query('COMMIT');\n    return result;\n  } catch (error) {\n    await client.query('ROLLBACK');\n    throw error;\n  } finally {\n    client.release();\n  }\n}\n\nexport interface ActorClaimClient {\n  query: (sql: string, params?: unknown[]) => Promise<{ rows: unknown[] }>;\n  release: () => void;\n}\n",
  "file_path": "F:\\system\\swiftship-tracker\\swiftshift2\\SWIFTSHIP_SYSTEM\\alx_api\\src\\core\\db\\record-columns.ts"
}
```

#### Thinking

Wait: for maintenance_logs' jsonb parameter — pg sends JS strings as text. Assigning text to a jsonb column in an INSERT VALUES ($n) context might fail ("column maintenance_logs is of type jsonb but expression is of type text")? With an untyped $n parameter, pg infers the parameter type from the target column → works without a cast if you pass a JS string (valid JSON). In practice, node-pg sends parameters as text with unspecified type, and the server infers the parameter type from the column → strings containing JSON work. Good — pass JSON.stringify(value) for maintenance_logs, and the rest as scalars.

Also `pkValue === '' ? '' : $1` — filter(Boolean) breaks the placeholder when pk is ''... pk should always be required. Simplify: pk is always $1. Fix: remove this condition.

Bugs that need to be fixed:
1. updateAsset contains a garbage line: `if (entries.length === 0) return this.getAccount ? null : null;` — delete it (updateStatement already returns empty). Also `this` inside the object literal doesn't have proper typing. Fix it.
2. createAsset/updateAsset: the input contains an actorId key — presentColumnEntries ignores keys that aren't in the map (actorId isn't in the map → ignored). No problem.
3. createHierarchyNode: input contains nodeId and actorId keys. They aren't in the column map → ignored. No problem.
4. createDefaultAccount: contains defaultAccountId/actorId — not in the map (the map has defaultKey, accountId...). Wait, is `defaultAccountId` in the map? The keys of defaultAccountRecordColumns: defaultKey, accountId, accNameAr, accNameEn, curNo, isActive — defaultAccountId isn't there. Good.
5. createFinancialAccount: input contains accountId — the key accountId is also not included in financialAccountRecordColumns. Good.
6. The withActorClaims helper's client.query signature returns {rows: unknown[]} — the actual pg returns QueryResult. Assignability: is pool.connect() a Promise<PoolClient>, and does it structurally match ActorClaimClient? PoolClient.query has overloads returning QueryResult — QueryResult.rows: any[] → assignable to unknown[]; release(): void. `connect: () => Promise<ActorClaimClient>` — is a Promise<PoolClient> assignable to a Promise<ActorClaimClient>? The query property: PoolClient.query is an overloaded function type. Does it accept (sql: string, params?: unknown[]) and return Promise<QueryResult>? The params of pg's QueryConfig values is any[] — is unknown[] assignable to any[]? Contravariance of parameters... TS methods are bivariant, so it's probably OK. If it's not, we'll know from the compilation.
7. listSalaryHistory is ordered by paid_at — no problem.
8. recalculate: `recalculate_accounting_hierarchy(NULL)` is ambiguous between the text and text[] overloads! When no accountIds are given, the intent is "recalculate everything"? Overloads: (text) is a single one, (text[]) is — what did the legacy recalculateAllBalances do? Probably calls the array version with all account IDs, or a variant with no arguments? Ambiguity of NULL → error. Better approach: if accountIds is empty → SELECT the array of all account_ids and call the text[] version. Fix it: cast to `SELECT public.recalculate_accounting_hierarchy((SELECT array_agg(account_id) FROM public.accounts))` — subselect of text[]. Good.
9. The jsonb placeholder in createSalaryHistory: the order of columns: salary_history_id, entry columns..., data, created_at... placeholders: $1, then the entries' $2..$n+1, then data is $entries.length+2 ::jsonb, NOW(), NOW(), actorId $entries.length+3. My params array: [salaryHistoryId, ...entries..., JSON.stringify(extra), actorId] — length = 1 + n + 1 + 1 = n+3; the last param uses $n+3 twice (created_by/updated_by) = actorId — but params[n+2] is actorId? The index of params: 0:$1 id; entries n (params 1..n → $2..$n+1); extra → $n+2; actorId → $n+3. params array length = 2+n+1 = n+3. Correct.
10. `if (empty) return null` in updateHierarchyNode — but when entries is empty, it returns null without checking existence. The route returns 404. Edge case is acceptable.
11. deleteAsset etc. — direct DELETE requires a GRANT (migration 0023). Documented.
12. importHierarchyNodes withActorClaims: BEGIN is already executed inside the helper; the client queries are within a transaction. RETURNING '1'. OK. But `imported` increments — no problem.
13. updateAsset: delete the garbage line.

  return (response.locals.authPrincipal as { userId?: string } | undefined)?.userId;

function presentColumnEntries(input: object, columnMap: Record<string, string>): Array<[string, unknown]> {
  const entries: Array<[string, unknown]> = [];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(input)) {

    if (column !== undefined && value !== undefined) entries.push([column, value ?? null]);

  return entries;
